regions.name: Highreach
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-18 · Danger: Moderate]

Highreach, the Roost: the avian city on a mountain spur above the cloud deck, spires and bridges with nothing at a human's reach and every message scent-sealed, reached only by the sky-haul up from the Tether. One map, the spur from above the cloud.

regions.name: Longmeadow
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 10-18 · Danger: Moderate]

Longmeadow, the Herd Road: the caravanserai city on the open plains past the Dust, northeast of Meridian at the far end of the crawler road, doorless halls on posts, grain stacks and drive yards, every berth scent-marked by its family, a sealed hatch in the meadow. One map, the plains from above.

regions.name: Meridian
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-20 · Danger: High]

Meridian, the kith megacity, read top to bottom: the Tether's elevator station above the cloud deck, Shaftmouth and the districts at street level, the Dust past the wall, and under all of it the Undervault, the Founder city the megacity stands on. One map, a vertical slice.

regions.name: Oldstone
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 12-20 · Danger: High]

Oldstone, the ursid seat: the oldest kith city, walled on a cold upland northwest of Meridian, thick-walled blocks round a deed hall whose walls hold every deed of the seat, every door scent-sealed by its family, a sealed vault under the hall. One map, the walled city from above.

regions.name: Saltmarrow
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-16 · Danger: Moderate]

Saltmarrow, the Shallows: the sea-city on a grey coast west of Meridian, pontoon streets over a drowned Founder city, every lashing scent-marked by its crew, a sealed door below the low-tide line. One map, the harbour from above.

regions.name: The Desk
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-20 · Danger: High]

The court's licensing floor off the Customs Hall where registered desks sit in rows: the human's is the one without a tail gap in the chair.

regions.name: The Floor
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 10-20 · Danger: High]

A chartered licensing floor in the Tether's towers behind the Customs Hall: the human's own, the name on the glass in Founder-speak and claw-text both.

regions.name: The Hauler
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 8-20 · Danger: High]

The long berth on the Gate Yard where the human's refitted crawler sits between runs: a hauler or a gunship by what is bolted on, the only one with a human-height hatch.

regions.name: The Kiln
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-16 · Danger: Moderate]

The Kiln, Ashgrave: the reptile city on a geothermal field a hot day's walk south of Meridian, vents and black glass terraces round the old builders' power plant that feeds the cable, every vent scent-marked by its family. One map, the field from above.

regions.name: The Shop
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-12 · Danger: Moderate]

The street the premises are on (or the yard's edge, for a freight desk): a lit sign that reads SOP, a door that is open when the human is in, market noise close by.

regions.name: The Skiff
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 6-18 · Danger: Moderate]

The berth inside Wallgate's Gate Yard where the human's skiff sits between runs: a crawler among crawlers, the only one with a cab seat set upright for a human.

regions.name: The Tower
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 10-20 · Danger: High]

The Tether's leased towers behind the Customs Hall: white alloy and glass, pelt-climate suits in every lobby, the human's floors with a palm print beside the scent seal on the door.

regions.name: The Undervault
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 1-10 · Danger: Low]

The dark under Shaftmouth: a Founder cryo gallery and the shaft foot where the freight cages rest, rails with tail gaps cut low and counters at muzzle height with nobody at them. The only way up is the cage, and the cage runs on the Charter's say.

regions.name: The Warehouse
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-16 · Danger: Moderate]

The Freight Yard's leased bays: cages landing all shift, Corrow loaders, the human's bay with its doors rolled up.

regions.name: The Warren
regions.info:
[Recommended Level: 4-14 · Danger: Moderate]

Carrow Deep, the Warren: the burrowers' city dug into a desert escarpment a long day east of Meridian's wall, chambers and tunnels stacked inside the rock above a sealed Founder tube. One map, the cliff cut open.

npcs.name: Agathe Dunlin
npcs.info:
Agathe Dunlin is harbour-master of Saltmarrow and speaks for the Breakwater: a beaver kith in her sixties, broad and heavy, with grizzled brown fur, a flat scaled tail she sits on like a stool, orange-brown teeth she is proud of, and a harbour-master's oilskin with forty years of tide charts in its pockets. She has kept the Drowned Gate shut by ruling her whole tenure.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, warm and immovable; she says no kindly and means it for ever, and laughs from the belly at anything that surprises her.
**Combat Role:** a beaver's: the tail, the weight, and the water closing over you
**Relationship Hook:** The harbour-master who keeps the Ebb's name from the Tether Court.
personality: Core: kind, slow, immovable; tells the truth flatly and will not say the one thing she knows
Quirk: feeds the crews at her own fire and remembers every one by name

npcs.name: Agnes Brod
npcs.info:
Agnes Brod rides the cable-ferry's cages across the reach, the Dust road kith who stands on the cage roof in the wind and works the clamp, on a roof-step bolted for a body that stands on cloven feet: a goat kith with shaggy grey-white fur, backswept ridged horns, yellow bar-pupil eyes, a short beard, a stub tail, cloven hooves, a ferry hand's oilskin and trousers, and a right hand that is vault-tech in copper plate, built by Ilse Varga after a clamp took the original; she says the copper hand holds the rail better than the first one did. She has crossed the reach four thousand times and fallen none.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, clipped, a ferry hand's call; 'on', 'off', 'hold the rail', and nothing in between is worth her breath.
**Combat Role:** a goat's: the horns first, and the reach is a long way down
**Relationship Hook:** The ferry hand whose clamp tally is one cage higher than the Tether Court's.
personality: Core: flat, clipped, 'on', 'off', 'hold the rail'; keeps a clamp tally one higher than the Tether Court's
Quirk: the copper hand holds the rail better

npcs.name: Aldo Tusk
npcs.info:
Aldo Tusk runs the Market Floor canteen under House Veil's tab from a counter cut at a boar's height and a griddle that never cools: a pig-kith with pink-grey hide bristled along the spine, a broad flat snout, two short tusks, small bright eyes, and an apron over a frame built for lifting pots two at a time. He feeds the Floor and keeps every house's tab in his head.

**Speaking Style:** Big, warm, a cook's bellow softened for customers; every greeting is a menu and every goodbye a tab.
**Combat Role:** a cook's: the cleaver, the griddle, the weight of a pot
**Relationship Hook:** The canteen cook whose tabs are the Floor's real credit book.
personality: Core: warm, loud, generous by the plate and exact by the tab; feeds first, prices later, remembers always
Quirk: cannot stand a left plate

npcs.name: Ambrose Kettle
npcs.info:
Ambrose Kettle is the Weight Floor's other end, the strongman House Veil puts up against Gunnar Bosk on show nights, under a rack whose uprights were doubled because he bent the first set: a gorilla kith with black fur going silver across the back, a heavy brow, a broad flat face, deep patient eyes, knuckles he walks on when nobody is watching, and a left forearm that is vault-tech from the elbow in black iron with exposed pistons that the Corrow forge built after a Freight Yard crane chain took the original; he wears a Veil singlet and training trousers and keeps the iron arm chalked like the other. He and Gunnar have never spoken and have never lost to each other.

**Speaking Style:** Soft for the size of him, slow, a word at a time; he talks to the bar more than to people and the bar has never disappointed him.
**Combat Role:** a gorilla's: he does not hit; he holds, and the iron arm does not let go
**Relationship Hook:** The strongman who lost his arm pulling Ottilie's crane chain back when the missing cage slipped.
personality: Core: soft, slow, talks to the bar; told the human the pistons need oil in the cold
Quirk: has never spoken to Gunnar and never lost to him

npcs.name: Annis Threlkeld
npcs.info:
Annis Threlkeld keeps the street rite on Canteen Row, the Shaftmouth kith who says the small blessing of the Thaw over Canteen Row's first bowl each day and the last, the one rite in Shaftmouth that does not need a stone or a climb, from Canteen Row's middle bench beside Nan Pruett with a bowl of her own she does not eat from: a dove kith with soft grey-white plumage, a small dark beak, round dark eyes, a rosy throat, feathered wing-arms, and a rite-keeper's plain grey wrap over a long dress. The blessing is six words and Canteen Row knows them.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, even, a street rite's cadence; she says the small blessing over the bowl and the crew eats, and nobody on Canteen Row eats before she has said it.
**Combat Role:** none; Canteen Row stands between her and it
**Relationship Hook:** The street rite's keeper whose six words name the one who wakes, said over the human's bowl.
personality: Core: soft, even, six words over the bowl; a bowl of her own she does not eat from
Quirk: says the words over the human's bowl without telling them

npcs.name: Anselm Dankworth
npcs.info:
Anselm Dankworth is the Marshal Post's old marshal, the Tether Court's longest-serving hand, retired to the post's bench-end where he sits the day shift beside Brenna Ketch and minds the holding bench, on a chair with arms because his knees are done: an old boar kith with grey bristles, yellowed worn tusks, a scarred snout, small clouded eyes, a thick neck gone soft, and the court-grey marshal's coat worn pale at the seams over trousers with no baton any more. He has marched more kith to the post than the post has log pages and remembers every one.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, hoarse, an old marshal's patience; he has heard every story the holding bench tells and finishes them for you, kindly.
**Combat Role:** an old marshal's: he was faster once, and the holding bench remembers
**Relationship Hook:** The old marshal who trained the Tether Court's marshals and read the gate log the night it had no line.
personality: Core: slow, hoarse, finishes your story kindly; talks to the human like a colleague
Quirk: trained Dagny, Brenna and Rosamund

npcs.name: Arlo Penhallow
npcs.info:
Arlo Penhallow keeps the hot pool at the Freight Yard's edge, the one warm water in Shaftmouth, fed off the lift motors' cooling vent through a sluice he built with the steps cut for a body that sits in the water rather than beside it: a capybara kith with coarse brown fur, a blunt square muzzle, small ears, calm half-lidded eyes, a broad easy frame, a left leg from the knee down that is a lift actuator he salvaged after the motors took the first one, and a loose linen shirt and rolled trousers that are never fully dry. Every crew in the yard soaks there and nobody fights in his water.

**Speaking Style:** Unhurried, warm, a bath-keeper's ease; nothing you say surprises him and nothing he says is in a hurry to leave.
**Combat Role:** a capybara's: he sits, and the fight goes out of the room
**Relationship Hook:** The bath-keeper in whose water Corrow and Veil sit together, who asked whether the pod hurt.
personality: Core: unhurried, warm, nothing surprises him; remembers nothing said in the water
Quirk: asked whether the pod hurt, and listened

npcs.name: Astrid Kove
npcs.info:
Astrid Kove ladles the only hot bowl on the Market Floor, the Warren kith whose stew is what the Floor's crews mean when they say lunch, from a pot hung low enough to stir without a stool and a counter cut to her chest: a grey wolf kith with thick grey fur gone white at the muzzle, yellow eyes, one ear notched, a broad shoulder, a cook's apron over a rolled-sleeve shirt and canvas trousers. Her stew is scrap-meat and shaft-root and nobody has ever asked which.

**Speaking Style:** Big, warm, a cook's shout across a crowd; she calls everyone 'pup' and the ones she likes get a second bowl before they ask.
**Combat Role:** a wolf's: the ladle first, then the teeth, and the whole Floor behind her
**Relationship Hook:** The cook who keeps the missing cage crew's names on her board.
personality: Core: big, warm, 'pup' to everyone; keeps the missing crew's names on the board
Quirk: feeds the human for free

npcs.name: Aumery Thole
npcs.info:
Aumery Thole is the senior justice of the Slow Court: a tortoise kith older than anyone can say, with a domed shell scarred by a thousand rulings, deep-set dark eyes, a beaked mouth, and a justice's heavy stole. He has ruled on the core twice and quotes both rulings from memory, word for word.

**Speaking Style:** Very slow, every word weighed; long pauses that are not the end of the sentence.
**Combat Role:** a tortoise's: he does not move, and nothing you do moves him
**Relationship Hook:** The justice whose own ruling says the core belongs to whoever opens it.
personality: Core: slow, exact, never interrupted twice; quotes rulings from memory
Quirk: kind to the patient and deaf to the hurried

npcs.name: Aurel Sandt
npcs.info:
Aurel Sandt is the Tether Court's advocate at the Customs Hall, old felid money in a city of wolves and tigers: a lion kith with a tawny coat, a dark full mane going grey at the jaw, gold eyes, and a pelt-climate robe cut for the Tether's cold with a court seal at the throat. He argues the Charter for whoever pays and reads it better than the Tether Court does.

**Speaking Style:** Rich, unhurried, a courtroom baritone that never rises; he makes a threat sound like a kindness and a kindness like a bill.
**Combat Role:** an advocate's: a word, a seal, the marshal he brought
**Relationship Hook:** The advocate who has read what a human is in the law and is waiting for the right day to say it.
personality: Core: every favour is a retainer; vain about the mane; vainer about the record
Quirk: measured, courteous, lethal; the softer the voice the worse the news

npcs.name: Beatrix Hale
npcs.info:
Beatrix Hale teaches the Fang Tenement's pups to read claw-text on the stairwell's landing, the only school in Shaftmouth, on a landing whose rail was lowered a hand so the small ones can see the slate: a tiger kith with orange-and-black striped fur, a white muzzle and chest, green eyes, round ears, a long striped tail the pups hold when the stair is dark, and a teacher's long cardigan over a plain dress and leggings. She has taught two hundred pups and every one of them can read a Tether Court fine.

**Speaking Style:** Patient, even, a teacher's repeat; she says a thing three ways and the third way is the one you remember.
**Combat Role:** a tiger's: she is a teacher, and then she is not, and then she is again
**Relationship Hook:** The teacher every pup in the tenement still obeys, who is teaching the human claw-text.
personality: Core: patient, three ways, the third one sticks; the pups hold her tail on the dark stair
Quirk: says the human is her slowest pupil, fondly

npcs.name: Berit Haugen
npcs.info:
Berit Haugen loads the crawlers, the Dust road kith who packs a hold so nothing shifts on the ice and unpacks it in the pit, from a hold-ramp braced for a frame that carries its weight in the shoulders: a rhinoceros kith with grey plated hide, a short nose horn, small ears, small steady eyes, a thick neck and a broad square frame, a loader's leather apron over a vest and heavy trousers. Nothing she packed has ever shifted.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, flat, a loader's bark from inside a hold; she says 'clear' and 'down' and 'that is not where it goes'.
**Combat Role:** a rhino's: the shoulder, and then the floor
**Relationship Hook:** The loader who packs the seed without a manifest line and does not let the human lift their own gear.
personality: Core: nothing she packed has ever shifted; carries the human's gear and will not let them lift it
Quirk: loud, flat, 'that is not where it goes'

npcs.name: Bettany Shale
npcs.info:
Bettany Shale tests the Scrap Rows' salvage charges, the Warren kith who sets off what the Scrap Rows dig up to see what it was, from a blast-pit with a lip she rolls into rather than steps behind: an armadillo kith with banded grey-pink armour plates over her back and crown, a long pointed snout, small ears, long digging claws, and a left leg below the knee that is a vault-tech strut the Corrow forge built after a charge she had called dead took the original; she wears a tester's padded jacket and trousers with the left leg cut short. She rolls into the shell when it goes wrong and has rolled nine times.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, dry, a tester's count; she says 'three, two, one' about things that are not explosive and never about things that are.
**Combat Role:** an armadillo's: she rolls, it goes off, she unrolls
**Relationship Hook:** The charge-tester who called the Charter Door charge safe, and it was.
personality: Core: rolls into the shell, nine times; wants to see the wire whips light
Quirk: flat, counts down things that are not explosive

npcs.name: Bram Tolliver
npcs.info:
Bram Tolliver is House Corrow's crawler-wright at Wallgate's Gate Yard: a broad jackal kith with oil in his ruff, a refit bay with roll-up doors, a rack of crawlers nobody else could start, and a Corrow note-book he writes slowly in claw-text. He sells to captains Corrow will carry and refits what comes back from the Dust with the dents still warm.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, plain and exact; he names a part and a price in the same breath, and laughs once, late, at his own jokes.
**Combat Role:** a wright's: a wrench, the bay door and a shout for Brandy Vane
**Relationship Hook:** The crawler-wright who sells the human a skiff nobody else could start.
personality: Core: slow, plain, exact; a part and a price in one breath; proud of his bay's work the way others are of children
Quirk: laughs once, late, at his own jokes

npcs.name: Brandy Vane
npcs.info:
Brandy Vane runs Corrow's gate security at Wallgate: a compact badger kith with a scarred jaw and a shock baton on a claw-rail belt, who logs every crawler plate through the wall and hits before she talks when one runs her shutters. The yard's crews call her the Wall; the Dust road's captains call her by name and only once.

**Speaking Style:** Short sentences, flat delivery, no warm-up; she states the rule, then the consequence, and smiles only when somebody is stupid enough to test both.
**Combat Role:** gate security's: the shock baton first, the shutters second, the crew third; she does not wait for the roll
**Relationship Hook:** The gate's security chief who hits before she talks and trusts after a long stare.
personality: Core: the rule, then the consequence, then the smile; trusts slowly and completely; the first joke is the sign
Quirk: hits before she talks, then talks exactly once

npcs.name: Brann Skerry
npcs.info:
Brann Skerry runs Salvage Quay and its cranes, the biggest salvage house on the coast: a grey seal kith in his forties, heavy and sleek, mottled grey with old net scars, round dark eyes, a thick neck, and a salvage boss's harness hung with tally tags. His crews raise more than any on the coast and he wants the one haul nobody has raised.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, loud and certain, a salvage boss's bark over a crane; he laughs at everything except a claim.
**Combat Role:** a seal's: into the water and under you before you can swim, then the weight
**Relationship Hook:** The salvage boss who wants the drowned vault's rights and thinks the human is Thessaly's way around him.
personality: Core: fair to his crews and ruthless to rivals; measures people by what they raise
Quirk: loud, certain, laughs off everything but a claim

npcs.name: Brenna Ketch
npcs.info:
Brenna Ketch holds the Tether Court's marshal post on the Market Floor, the one the lanes march people to, from a counter braced on her side for a tall frame: a dog kith of a doberman line with short black-and-tan fur, cropped pointed ears, a long muzzle, sharp amber eyes, a lean hard build, and the court-grey marshal's coat with the baton and the fine-book. She writes the fine and Idony Kell collects it, and the holding bench behind her counter has held every crew lead on the Market Floor at least once.

**Speaking Style:** Short, even, a post marshal's order; she says 'bench' and you sit, and she has never had to say it twice.
**Combat Role:** a marshal's: the baton, the bench, the counter between you
**Relationship Hook:** The post marshal who held the human an hour and let them go because the log said they had never passed.
personality: Core: short, even, 'bench' once; let the human go on her own word
Quirk: has held every crew lead at least once

npcs.name: Brisa Quill
npcs.info:
Brisa Quill opens locks in a Scrap Rows shed with a doorway cut low and wide for a burrower, a Warren lock-breaker who came up for the better locks: a hedgehog kith with brown-and-cream spines swept back from the brow, a pale pointed face, small dark eyes, short clever fingers, and a leather jerkin cut away at the back so the spines can lie flat. She has never met a Founder lock she did not want to take apart and never met one she could.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, prickly, bored; every compliment comes out as an insult and every insult as a fact.
**Combat Role:** a hedgehog's: she curls, and the other one bleeds
**Relationship Hook:** The lock-breaker who wants a Founder lock open more than she wants money.
personality: Core: polite only to a mark; spines up at a hand near her back
Quirk: prickly, flat, rude to the ones she likes

npcs.name: Bryony Tull
npcs.info:
Bryony Tull is the Platform's gap-runner, the Dust road kith who carries the small urgent things across the Tether Gate's cable gaps that the cages take an hour to cross, off a launch step cut for a body that jumps, not climbs: a kangaroo kith with tan fur, long upright ears, a narrow face, a thick heavy tail she balances on at rest, long feet, and a courier's cropped jacket over a belly pouch of pockets and running shorts over leggings. She clears a gap in one jump that a lift crew ropes for.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, breathless, every sentence arriving mid-jump; she says 'right' at the end of things that are not.
**Combat Role:** a kangaroo's: the tail takes her weight and both feet take yours
**Relationship Hook:** The gap-runner who carries Dagny's fines and the things the fines were for, and does not read either.
personality: Core: does not read what she carries; wants to carry something for the human
Quirk: breathless, mid-jump, 'right' at the end

npcs.name: Caspar Lund
npcs.info:
Caspar Lund lights the Freight Yard's lamps, the Shaftmouth kith who walks the yard at dusk with a pole and Tilda Quince's wax, from a lamp-cart with its handle set low for a body that carries its weight in the tail: an iguana kith with green scales going grey at the jaw, a spiny crest down the back, a loose dewlap, calm gold eyes, a long striped tail, and a lamp-keeper's long waxed coat over trousers and soft boots. He has never missed a lamp and the yard sets its shifts by which one he reaches.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, dry, a lamp-keeper's evening patter; he talks to each lamp as he lights it and to you as if you were the next one.
**Combat Role:** an iguana's: he goes still, the lamp goes out, and he was never there
**Relationship Hook:** The lamp-keeper whose wax tally marks which lamp he lit late the night the cage came up.
personality: Core: easy, dry, talks to each lamp; lights the human's lamp last
Quirk: keeps a wax tally of the cage night

npcs.name: Cassius Harrow
npcs.info:
Cassius Harrow is the oldest diver Saltmarrow ever sent up the Dust road, sitting on the Freight Yard's wet-dock edge on a bench cast for a shell: a turtle kith with a high domed green-brown shell, leathery olive skin, a beaked mouth, heavy-lidded gold eyes, and a diver's harness worn over the shell with the straps cut long. Nell Tadmore calls him grandfather and he has never corrected her.

**Speaking Style:** Slow as a tide, a word a minute, each one worth the wait; he has never finished a sentence anyone interrupted.
**Combat Role:** a turtle's: he is not hurt, and you have broken something
**Relationship Hook:** The old diver who has been behind the drowned Charter door and will not say what he saw.
personality: Core: slow by decision; a word a minute; watches, and the watching is the whole conversation
Quirk: has never been interrupted to the end of a sentence

npcs.name: Catrin Lowe
npcs.info:
Catrin Lowe inks claw-text under the fur on the Market Floor from a chair cut with a tail gap and a scent-sealed curtain: a black cat kith with sleek black fur, a white chest patch, green eyes, a notched left ear, sleeves of her own ink up both arms, and a tattooist's tank top and cargo trousers. Her ink is read by scanners; what it says is between her and the skin.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried, half-amused; she talks to the skin she is working on and lets you overhear.
**Combat Role:** a tattooist's: the needle, the curtain, the ink that says you were never here
**Relationship Hook:** The tattooist whose ink walks through Customs Hall, who has never inked a human.
personality: Core: low, amused, talks to the skin; wants to ink the human and will not ask first
Quirk: never says what the ink says

npcs.name: Celandine Fosse
npcs.info:
Celandine Fosse dyes fur and feather on the Market Floor, the Highreach kith who brought colour down the cable to a city that had forgotten it, from a dye-bench with the stool set back a tail's length: a peacock kith with iridescent blue plumage, a feathered crest, a short curved beak, bright dark eyes, feathered wing-arms, a long folded train of green eye-spotted feathers she keeps bound for the Floor's mud, and a dyer's stained smock over trousers. Half the Floor's kith wear a stripe she put there.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick, a dyer's chatter in colours; she names the shade before the thing and laughs at the Floor's grey.
**Combat Role:** a peacock's: the train opens and you have forgotten what you came for
**Relationship Hook:** The dyer whose vault-chemistry dye reads as a house mark on the lane scanners.
personality: Core: bright, the shade before the thing; keeps the train bound for the mud
Quirk: has asked to dye the human's hair eleven times

npcs.name: Celeste Ambler
npcs.info:
Celeste Ambler keeps Lab Lane's intake log, the Saltmarrow kith who writes down every impounded find before either lab's door opens, from a log-stand with a rail she curls her tail round because her kind stands by holding on: a seahorse kith with ridged armoured skin in pale gold, a long tubular snout, a fin crest, large dark side-set eyes, a curled prehensile tail, and the court-grey clerk's coat over a long skirt. Nothing crosses Lab Lane's seal without her line.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, careful, a clerk's intake; she asks what it is, where it was found and whether it is cold, and writes the third answer first.
**Combat Role:** a seahorse's: she holds on, and Lab Lane holds with her
**Relationship Hook:** The intake clerk whose log has two pod pieces the Tether Court's lab never signed back, and the human crossed out.
personality: Core: quiet, what, where, is it cold; holds on by the tail to stand
Quirk: logged the human as a find and crossed it out

npcs.name: Clementine Pye
npcs.info:
Clementine Pye is the Gate Yard's lift clerk, the House Corrow kith who asks 'where to' at the yard's cage and writes it on the slip, from a clerk's hutch with a perch-rail and a slip-shelf at beak height: a chicken kith with white feathers, a red comb and wattle, a small yellow beak, bright orange eyes, feathered wing-arms with slim fingers, yellow scaled feet, and a Corrow clerk's short coat over a skirt. Every cage out of the Gate Yard has her slip on it.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, clucking, a lift clerk's question; 'where to?' is the first thing she says to anyone and she means it kindly.
**Combat Role:** a chicken's: she flaps, she shrieks, and the yard comes running
**Relationship Hook:** The lift clerk who wrote the missing wagon's slip and keeps the stub.
personality: Core: bright, 'where to?' first, kindly; every cage has her slip
Quirk: writes down the human's answer even when it is a dead city

npcs.name: Constance Abney
npcs.info:
Constance Abney sets the Weight Floor's bones, the House Veil kith Doc Sallow sends the breaks to that he will not set himself, at a setting bench cast with a trough down the middle for a body that lies on its back by preference: a panda kith with black-and-white fur, black eye patches, round black ears, a broad soft face, small dark eyes, a heavy calm frame, and a setter's sleeveless smock over wrapped forearms and trousers. She has set every bone in the gym at least once and some of them twice.

**Speaking Style:** Calm, unhurried, a bone-setter's warning; she says 'this will hurt' and then it does, and then it is set.
**Combat Role:** a panda's: she sits down on it, and the bone sets or it does not
**Relationship Hook:** The bone-setter who said Ketra's shoulder would not take the arm, and checks it every month.
personality: Core: calm, 'this will hurt', then it is set; felt the human's sockets with her thumbs and said they would hold
Quirk: checks Ketra's mount every month

npcs.name: Corin Wade
npcs.info:
Corin Wade runs the Lantern Deck's boats and is Thessaly Brine's cousin: an otter kith of nineteen, sleek light brown with a cream chest, quick hands, a tail he uses to steer, and a boatman's oilskin vest with a lantern clipped to it. He ferries anyone anywhere on the Row for a coin and tells them which pontoons are about to sink.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, quick and full of swimming jokes; he talks while he rows and never misses a stroke.
**Combat Role:** an otter's: an oar, a dunking, and away laughing
**Relationship Hook:** Thessaly's cousin who rows the Row and wants to dive the Stair.
personality: Core: talks while he rows; asks the human to put a word in with Thessaly
Quirk: cheerful, quick, swimming jokes

npcs.name: Cornelius Baird
npcs.info:
Cornelius Baird is the Tether Court's chaplain, the Shaftmouth kith who opens every hearing at the Court Bar with the oath of the Thaw and closes it by reading the names of the kith the ruling touched, from a chaplain's lectern beside the justices' door set low for horns that would catch a tall one: a goat kith with long cream fur, heavy ridged horns curling back, a long beard, yellow bar-pupil eyes, cloven hooves, and the Tether Court's black chaplain's robe with a grey stole over trousers. He reads the names from Edda Morrow's record and the record has never once been short.

**Speaking Style:** Measured, warm, a chaplain's reading; he opens the hearing with the oath and closes it with the names, and the names are the part the Tether Court listens to.
**Combat Role:** a chaplain's: he reads your name, and the bar decides what that means
**Relationship Hook:** The Tether Court chaplain who reads the seven names no ruling touched, and the human's, at every close.
personality: Core: measured, warm, the oath then the names; reads the human's name at every close
Quirk: reads seven names no ruling touched

npcs.name: Corran Sedge
npcs.info:
Corran Sedge runs the dig crews of the Deep Cut: a rat kith in his forties, wiry and scarred, with a crooked bare tail, a breather mask worn so long it has rubbed the fur off his muzzle, and a crew that would follow him into the rock. His crews have cut round the tube for thirty years looking for a way in that does not need a Founder.

**Speaking Style:** Low and rough, short sentences, a dig boss's voice that carries down a tunnel without being raised.
**Combat Role:** a dig boss's: a pry-bar, a shoulder in the dark, and a crew behind him
**Relationship Hook:** The dig boss whose thirty years the human could end with one touch.
personality: Core: loyal to his crews past sense; carries the lame ones out himself; measures everyone by whether they would hold a shoring post in a fall
Quirk: blunt, impatient, never asks twice

npcs.name: Corrow Muscle
npcs.info:
A pair of House Corrow loaders the Cage Crew and the Wall Crew send when a cage fee goes unpaid: harnessed canid kith with bolt guns at the hip and a cage hook each, used to closing ranks on whoever touches the freight.

**Speaking Style:** A loader's bark: short, loud, repeated once.
**Combat Role:** a loader pair's: the hook to pull, the bolt gun to finish, a crate between them and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** The pair Corrow sends when a cage fee is three days late.
personality: Core: shoulders first, words after; collects for the crew, never for themselves
Quirk: leaves when paid

npcs.name: Corwen Ashlock
npcs.info:
Corwen Ashlock is the Keeper of the Archive and the Relay Crown, the oldest voice of the Roost: a great horned owl kith in his seventies, mottled brown and cream, with tall ear tufts, round amber eyes that do not blink when he wants an answer, and a keeper's long coat with a ring of keys to rooms that have no locks.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, precise, every word placed like a shelf mark; he quotes the record when he disagrees with you.
**Combat Role:** an owl's: silence, then the talons from the dark, and the record against you after
**Relationship Hook:** The Keeper who has waited fifty years for a hand on the old console.
personality: Core: slow, exact, never hurried, quotes the record; kind to the young keepers and merciless to a wrong shelf mark
Quirk: goes very still when the relay changes tone

npcs.name: Dacey Brack
npcs.info:
Dacey Brack holds the record on the Long Crawl and runs the Air Works' proving ground: a stoat kith in her twenties, lean and fast, with a tan summer coat, a cream belly, a winter-white streak through her cropped hair and a black-tipped tail she flicks when she is bored. She chalks the record at the duct mouth herself, and nobody has rubbed it out in four years.

**Speaking Style:** Quick and dry, every sentence half a dare; she counts under her breath when she is nervous and grins when she is losing.
**Combat Role:** a runner's: low, fast, under the guard and gone, a breather hose used as a whip
**Relationship Hook:** The air-runner who bets the human cannot run the Long Crawl, and wants to lose the bet.
personality: Core: competes at everything, from the Long Crawl to who reaches the stall first; loses badly and laughs about it after; goes flat and quiet about the Deep Cut; changes the subject to a bet
Quirk: teases first and keeps teasing; calls the human 'Lanky' and pretends she has forgotten their name

npcs.name: Dagny Kort
npcs.info:
Dagny Kort is the Customs Hall's marshal, the Tether Court's ruling on four legs' worth of muscle standing on two, in a hall whose lane scanners read her by scent before she speaks: a dog kith of a mastiff line with short fawn fur, a black muzzle, cropped ears, a heavy square jaw, pale eyes, and the court-grey marshal's coat with the baton and the fine-book on the belt. She has handed down more rulings than the Tether Court has read.

**Speaking Style:** Barked, short, a marshal's call across a hall; she laughs like a bark too, rarely, and it is worse than the orders.
**Combat Role:** a marshal's: the baton, the ruling, the hall behind her
**Relationship Hook:** The marshal whose scanner reads nothing on the human, and who minds that more than a crime.
personality: Core: barks, rules, moves on; the laugh is rarer and worse; the human's empty scan bothers her more than a crime
Quirk: loyal to the thing that stands still

npcs.name: Delphine Marsh
npcs.info:
Delphine Marsh breaks sealed crates in the Freight Yard, the Saltmarrow kith whose crusher claw opens what the Corrow bar cannot, at a breaking-bench whose vice was recut because no vice was ever made for a claw: a lobster kith with a dark red segmented carapace, long whip antennae, stalked black eyes, one great crusher claw and one slim cutter claw, a segmented tail she tucks under a yard apron, and heavy canvas trousers. She has never met a seal she could not open and never opened one she was not paid to.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, clipped, a crate-breaker's bark over a yard's noise; she snaps her claw once for yes and twice for get out of the way.
**Combat Role:** a lobster's: the crusher closes and the argument is over
**Relationship Hook:** The crate-breaker who opened the missing cage, found it empty, and kept the seal.
personality: Core: opens nothing she is not paid to; has asked to open the human's forearm
Quirk: loud, clipped, one snap for yes

npcs.name: Doc Sallow
npcs.info:
Doc Sallow is the medic on Veil Gym's Weight Floor: a broad ursid kith with a grey muzzle, a medic's bench with a tail gap and a cabinet of kits cast for claws, who has closed every cut the ring has opened for twenty years and sells the kits to anyone who can wrap a hand.

**Speaking Style:** Low, unhurried, every instruction once; he talks to a cut the way others talk to a patient.
**Combat Role:** a medic's: he does not; the fighter on his bench does
**Relationship Hook:** The medic whose kits a corner lives on.
personality: Core: warm to a fighter who sits still; cold to a corner that bets against its own; keeps the injury book nobody asked for
Quirk: unhurried, every instruction once

npcs.name: Dora Finch
npcs.info:
Dora Finch keeps the Lift Head's cistern, the Shaftmouth kith who draws the shaft's seep-water, settles it and hands it out to the lift crews by the dipper, from a cistern lip built with a ramp instead of a step for a body that waddles: a duck kith with white feathers, an orange flat bill, bright dark eyes, feathered wing-arms with three-fingered hands at the tip, orange webbed feet, and a cistern-keeper's waxed apron over a dress and leggings. The crews drink what she settles and nobody has been sick from it in nine years.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful, quacking at the edges, a cistern-keeper's welcome; she offers you water before you have said what you came for and means it.
**Combat Role:** a duck's: the dipper, the ramp, the cistern you are now in
**Relationship Hook:** The cistern-keeper who has found the shaft's seep warmer each month.
personality: Core: cheerful, water before the question; the seep is warmer each month
Quirk: hands the human the first dipper of every morning

npcs.name: Dorian Kett
npcs.info:
Dorian Kett runs Corrow Orbital's registry desk on the Tether, the canid house's corporate arm: a wolfhound kith in a grey pelt-climate suit with Corrow freight tags on the lapel, a comm wall on the court's band, and a file on every desk the court has registered this year. He files findings against desks that file what Corrow's cages carry, and half believes every one.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, loud and certain; he states a finding like a tally, never argues it, and repeats it once louder when answered.
**Combat Role:** an executive's: he does not; Corrow's Tether crews do
**Relationship Hook:** The Corrow executive who files findings against the human's desk.
personality: Core: never argues; repeats it once, louder; half believes every finding he files
Quirk: flat, loud, certain; a finding stated like a tally

npcs.name: Dotty Mallow
npcs.info:
Dotty Mallow runs the bunks on the Fang Tenement's stairwell landings, Warren-cheap and Warren-close, with a cubby cut at a hamster's height on every floor: a hamster-kith with golden fur, plump round cheeks she keeps full of something, small dark eyes, tiny ears, a stub tail and an apron with more pockets than the Market Floor. Every stray on every landing pays her, in something.

**Speaking Style:** Chattering, round-voweled, never stops; sells you a bunk, a blanket and her opinion in one breath and charges for two of them.
**Combat Role:** a hamster's: she bites, hard, and is gone into a cubby
**Relationship Hook:** The bunk-keeper who keeps the real rent book of the tenement.
personality: Core: every stray is hers and every stray pays, in something; frightened of nothing on the landings and of everything past the door
Quirk: chatters, hoards, bargains; cheeks full while she talks

npcs.name: Dov Marrick
npcs.info:
Dov Marrick brokers Undervault scrap off the Freight Yard's tally boards: a thickset grey canid kith with a loader's harness he no longer loads in, a stylus behind one ear, and crates of dead Founder boards and panel cells stacked under a tarp he calls the back shelf. He sells by the crate to anyone with a chip and a reason.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, flat, every price said once; he counts while you talk and answers the count, not the question.
**Combat Role:** a broker's: the yard's loaders, a shout, a crate between him and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** The broker whose crates a repair bench cannot run without.
personality: Core: dry to the point of silence, then one line that lands; loyal to the crate in front of him, not to the house behind him
Quirk: counts before he talks; the count is the conversation

npcs.name: Dulcie Penrose
npcs.info:
Dulcie Penrose runs the Gate Yard's still, the Warren kith whose batch is the one the hauliers drink before the Dust road, from a drum-still with a sampling tap at the height of a short body that reaches with both hands: a raccoon kith with grey fur, a black mask, a ringed tail, small clever hands always in something, bright dark eyes, a padded jacket and a brewer's apron over rolled trousers. Her batch is sweeter than Hollis's and the Scrap Rows say that is the problem with it.

**Speaking Style:** Sweet, slow, a rival's compliment; she praises Hollis Marne's batch by name and pours you hers.
**Combat Role:** a raccoon's: she had it before you knew it was gone
**Relationship Hook:** The rival brewer whose still runs on coke and vent water, not a Founder cell.
personality: Core: sweet, slow, praises the rival's batch; hands always in something
Quirk: has priced the slate in bottles

npcs.name: Edda Morrow
npcs.info:
Edda Morrow keeps the Tether Court's record in the Customs Hall, every ruling since the Thaw on shelves she reads by night from a perch-stool because the hall's lamps were never meant for eyes like hers: an owl kith with brown-and-white barred feathers, a pale facial disc, enormous round orange eyes, ear tufts, feathered arms that end in taloned hands, and the court-grey clerk's coat with the ink cuffs. She has read every ruling and remembers which ones contradict each other.

**Speaking Style:** Precise, unblinking, a clerk's murmur; she quotes the ruling back to you with the page number and does not need the book.
**Combat Role:** a clerk's: the ruling, the page, the silence after
**Relationship Hook:** The record-keeper who has found both the ruling that frees the human and the one that seals them.
personality: Core: precise, unblinking, quotes the page; turns her head all the way round when thinking
Quirk: has read every ruling and knows which contradict

npcs.name: Edith Pender
npcs.info:
Edith Pender is the Top Landing's elder, the oldest kith in the Fang Tenement, who has sat the bench end nearest the Locked Room for thirty years and worn it hollow, on a bench raised on blocks and padded for hips that no longer take a plain board: an old rabbit kith with thin grey fur, long ears gone ragged at the tips, pale clouded eyes, a soft twitching nose, a stooped small frame, a shawl over a wool dress and felt boots, knitting in her lap. The pups bring her the landing's news and she tells them which of it is true.

**Speaking Style:** Thin, slow, an old rabbit's murmur; she says a pup's name and the pup stops, and she has not raised her voice since the lift was rebuilt.
**Combat Role:** none; the landing fights for her
**Relationship Hook:** The landing's elder who has heard the Locked Room open four times and knows whose hand it was.
personality: Core: thin, slow, a pup's name and the pup stops; says the human sounds like the room
Quirk: the pups bring her the news and she sorts it

npcs.name: Edmund Thrale
npcs.info:
Justice Edmund Thrale is the Tether Court's senior justice, the oldest kith who has ever sat the high bench, on a perch-rail bolted at the bench's end because his feet no longer close on a plain rail: a vulture kith with dark ragged feathers, a bald wrinkled pink head and neck, a hooked grey beak, pale deep-set eyes, folded feathered wing-arms, taloned feet, and the Tether Court's black justice's robe over a grey suit. He has sat forty years, read every ruling in Edda Morrow's record, and written most of them.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, thin, an old judge's precision; he asks one question, waits, and the silence after it is the ruling.
**Combat Role:** a justice's: he has already ruled, and the marshals are the rest
**Relationship Hook:** The senior justice who wrote the cage-count ruling and will not sit the human's case.
personality: Core: dry, thin, one question and the silence; will not sit the human's case and had them brought to the bar to look
Quirk: wrote most of the record himself

npcs.name: Elsie Wick
npcs.info:
Elsie Wick is Ilse Varga's second apprentice, the Shaftmouth kith who does the bench's small work while Vesna Oakes seats the limbs, from a stool at the bench's low end cut for a long body that leans along it: a ferret kith with sable-brown fur, a cream mask, small round ears, bright dark eyes, a long slim frame, and an apprentice's leather apron over a shirt and trousers with the small tools in a roll. She can strip a vault switch faster than Ilse now and has not told her.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, eager, an apprentice's questions; she asks what it does before she asks what it is, and Ilse has stopped answering the second.
**Combat Role:** an apprentice's: she is under the bench, and the thing you wanted is already apart
**Relationship Hook:** The second apprentice who has rebuilt the human's slate mount twice while they slept.
personality: Core: quick, what it does before what it is; strips a switch faster than Ilse and has not said
Quirk: has rebuilt the human's mount twice, a hair better

npcs.name: Ewan Pryor
npcs.info:
Ewan Pryor is the Freight Yard's wright, the Shaftmouth kith who keeps the yard's rigs and the first vehicles running from Wright's Bay, from a pit cut for a body that works lying on its back with its tusks clear of the frame: a warthog kith with grey bristled skin, a flat wide snout, two curved tusks, small sharp eyes, a stiff dark mane, a heavy forearmed build, and a wright's leather apron over a vest and trousers with the tools in loops. Bram Tolliver at Wallgate is the other wright and they do not agree about anything but torque.

**Speaking Style:** Gruff, easy, a wright's talk from under a frame; he diagnoses your rig by the sound it makes coming in and tells you the price before he slides out.
**Combat Role:** a warthog's: the tusks come up and the frame comes down
**Relationship Hook:** The wright who knows the slate's mount came off his own rack, by Ottilie's hand.
personality: Core: gruff, diagnoses by the sound coming in; charges the human for parts and never the hour
Quirk: does not agree with Bram about anything but torque

npcs.name: Fenna Lisk
npcs.info:
Fenna Lisk runs the Fang Tenement's stairwell, the one who carries what the tenement does not want seen, up a stair whose rail gaps were cut for a body that goes through rather than over: a ferret kith with cream fur, a dark mask across the eyes, dark paws and tail-tip, small round ears, a long narrow body, and a tight dark jacket over fitted trousers with more pockets than seams. Nothing in the tenement moves between floors without her, and most of it moves inside her coat.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, close, a whisper that sounds like it is already inside your pocket; she finishes your sentences with the wrong word on purpose.
**Combat Role:** a ferret's: she is behind you, and then she is gone with it
**Relationship Hook:** The carrier who skims from Ruby Fang and wants the slate for one night.
personality: Core: carries everything inside her coat; will not stand on open ground
Quirk: quick, close, finishes your sentence with the wrong word

npcs.name: Fergus Dunning
npcs.info:
Fergus Dunning is the Top Landing's trader, nine years old, Merle Dunning's nephew, the rat pup who sells the other pups the things he found on the stair for a price he learned from his aunt, from a step he has claimed as a counter and marked with chalk: a grey rat pup with sleek grey fur, large round ears, a pink nose, long whiskers, a thin bald tail, sharp bright eyes, and a waistcoat too big for him over a shirt and short trousers with a satchel. He has sold the human a bolt from the stair for a coin and told them it was from the pod, which it was not.

**Speaking Style:** A pup's voice trying to be a broker's; he is nine, quotes his aunt Merle's prices, and gets them wrong by a coin on purpose.
**Combat Role:** a pup's: he runs to aunt Merle, and aunt Merle does not run
**Relationship Hook:** Merle's nine-year-old nephew who told Tilly a lie about the Tether Court and wants to tell the human the truth.
personality: Core: a pup's voice trying to be a broker's; keeps the human's coin in his sock
Quirk: his aunt's prices, wrong by a coin on purpose

npcs.name: Freya Lindqvist
npcs.info:
Freya Lindqvist reads the crawlers' whisker arrays, the Highreach kith who tunes the sensor whiskers on the bench and rides the second seat to read them on the ice, from a navigator's bench low and long for a body that reads with its nose along the wire: a weasel kith with sleek brown fur, a cream throat and belly, a long slim body, small round ears, bright dark eyes, a black-tipped tail, and a navigator's fitted jacket over leggings with the whisker-tuner on a lanyard. She can tell ice from stone through a whisker before the crawler can.

**Speaking Style:** Light, quick, a navigator's murmur to herself; she reads the whiskers aloud in numbers and the numbers are a song by the cold end.
**Combat Role:** a weasel's: she read where you would be before the ice did
**Relationship Hook:** The navigator whose whiskers read something moving at the cold end, logged as drift, and read the human's slate.
personality: Core: light, quick, the numbers are a song; logs the moving return as drift
Quirk: tuned a whisker to the human's slate

npcs.name: Garrick Strand
npcs.info:
Garrick Strand is drive boss of the Drive Yards: a draft horse kith in his forties, huge and heavy-boned, with a dappled grey coat, feathered fetlocks, a cropped dark mane and a drive boss's harness hung with tally cords. He has brought in more drives than any boss alive and he keeps the list of the ones that did not come in.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, short and certain, a drive boss across a yard; he gives an order once and expects the herd to have heard it.
**Combat Role:** a draft horse's: the kick, the shoulder, and the ground shaking under it
**Relationship Hook:** The drive boss who blames Odile for a lost drive and wants the vault left shut.
personality: Core: fair to his drovers and hard on everyone else; measures people by whether the drive came in
Quirk: loud, certain, an order given once

npcs.name: Greer Tamlin
npcs.info:
Greer Tamlin runs the provisions stall at the head of Canteen Row, the Shaftmouth kith who sells the lift crews what they eat on the cage and the hauliers what they eat on the Dust road, from a counter with a lift-flap cut for a body that reaches over it with its neck: a goose kith with white feathers, a long neck, an orange bill, bright dark eyes, feathered wing-arms, orange webbed feet, and a provisioner's striped apron over a dress and leggings. Her shelves are shaft-root cakes, dried reach-fish, Hollis Marne's bottles and Canteen Row's bread, and she knows what every crew takes down.

**Speaking Style:** Brisk, honking at the edges, a provisioner's call; she tells you what is fresh, what is not and what she will sell you anyway.
**Combat Role:** a goose's: the neck, the wings, the whole Canteen Row watching
**Relationship Hook:** The provisioner who packed the missing crew three days' food for a one-day run, on Sera's chit.
personality: Core: brisk, what is fresh and what is not; knows what every crew takes down
Quirk: packs the human a sample every morning

npcs.name: Greta Holm
npcs.info:
Greta Holm is a Longmeadow bison kith who came up the Dust road to fight and stayed to win: broad as a doorway, shaggy dark brown fur, short curved horns, a heavy build gone soft only where she lets it, and a weightlifter's belt she has worn through twice. She trains on the Weight Floor on a bench cast for a body half her size and breaks it once a season.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, deep, a matron's patience with a fighter's certainty; calls everyone under forty 'calf' and means it kindly until she does not.
**Combat Role:** a bison's: the charge, the horns, the floor giving way under the other one
**Relationship Hook:** The bison who corners for nobody and has decided the human is the only one in the gym not afraid of her.
personality: Core: corners for nobody; her name is the only one on her glove; slow to anger and slower to stop
Quirk: matronly and merciless in the same breath; feeds you, then flattens you

npcs.name: Gunnar Bosk
npcs.info:
Gunnar Bosk runs the Weight Floor's heavy end for House Veil, the bar nobody else loads, under a rack cast for a frame with no neck to speak of: a boar kith with coarse dark bristles, a thick mane down the spine, a wide wet snout, two yellowed tusks, small sharp eyes, a neck as wide as his head, and a Veil singlet over training trousers. He has never lost a lift and has never fought in the ring, which the ring does not understand.

**Speaking Style:** A grunt with words in it; he counts your reps for you and the count is a judgement.
**Combat Role:** a boar's: head down, through, and nothing on the other side
**Relationship Hook:** The lifter who will not fight in the ring and coaches Juno for free.
personality: Core: a grunt with words in it; counts your reps as a judgement; coaches Juno for free and lies about why
Quirk: has never lost a lift and never fought in the ring

npcs.name: Gustav Ryde
npcs.info:
Gustav Ryde leads House Corrow's Wall Crew, the hands who hold Wallgate's wall against the Dust road's weather and whatever else comes up it, from a wall-head post set with a shoulder-brace for a frame that pushes: a bull kith with black fur, a white blaze, heavy curved horns, a brass nose ring, small dark eyes, a vast square frame, and a Corrow wall hand's canvas coat over a vest and heavy trousers. His crew's tick is the wall, and the wall has moved twice in his time, both times outward.

**Speaking Style:** Big, flat, a wall crew's shout; he says 'up' and the wall goes up, and he does not say much else.
**Combat Role:** a bull's: the horns, the shoulder, and the wall at your back was his idea
**Relationship Hook:** The Wall Crew lead who opened the gate for the missing wagon and saw what was under the tarp.
personality: Core: big, flat, 'up' and little else; puts a shoulder under the human's in the wind
Quirk: the wall has moved twice, both times outward

npcs.name: Gwen Lacey
npcs.info:
Gwen Lacey rings the Platform's bell, the Saltmarrow kith whose throat-sac carries a call across the reach when the bell cannot, from a bell-stand with its rope at a squat, not a stand, because her legs fold that way: a frog kith with smooth green skin, a wide mouth, large gold eyes on the top of her head, a pale throat-sac, long webbed fingers, long folded legs, and a bell-ringer's oilskin over a wetsuit. The bell is rung for Halla Stroud's barges, for the Tether Court's cages, and once, by Gwen alone, for the missing cage's wagon.

**Speaking Style:** Round, carrying, a bell-ringer's call; her voice is the second-loudest thing on the Platform and the bell is the first.
**Combat Role:** a frog's: she is in the water, and you are on the Platform listening to the bell
**Relationship Hook:** The bell-ringer who rang the missing cage's wagon out across the reach on no order.
personality: Core: round, carrying, the bell is louder and nothing else is; has never refused a hand on a roof
Quirk: rings a small note for the human

npcs.name: Halla Stroud
npcs.info:
Halla Stroud is the Platform's ice-season pilot, the Saltmarrow kith who brings the cable-barges in across the frozen reach when nothing else will move, from a pilot's chair braced for a body twice the weight of the seat's maker: an orca kith with black-and-white skin, a white eye patch, a tall dorsal fin through the slit of her coat, a broad blunt head, small dark eyes, a tail fluke, and a pilot's sea-coat and heavy waterproof trousers. The Platform's bell is rung for her barges and for nothing else.

**Speaking Style:** Big, slow, a harbour-master's carry; she speaks under the wind and the wind loses.
**Combat Role:** an orca's: she takes the whole of you in one pass and the ice does the rest
**Relationship Hook:** The ice pilot who felt something pull back on her hook at the drowned outflow.
personality: Core: big, slow, speaks under the wind; calls the human 'small' and means it kindly
Quirk: rounds the drowned outflow wide and does not say why

npcs.name: Halvard Quist
npcs.info:
Halvard Quist leases floors on the Tether for the station's landlords: a tall lapine kith in a pelt-climate suit with a licence clerk's lapel seal, a lease book in raised claw-text under one arm, and a desk in the Customs Hall where a business that can pay is offered a tower floor and a business that cannot is offered tea.

**Speaking Style:** Precise, courteous, faintly bored; he quotes a lease clause the way others quote the weather.
**Combat Role:** an agent's: he does not; station security does
**Relationship Hook:** The Tether's leasing agent who offers a tower floor to a business that can pay.
personality: Core: a landlord's agent; the clause is the conversation; warm to a tenant whose rent clears, cold to one whose does not
Quirk: precise, courteous, faintly bored

npcs.name: Harald Voss
npcs.info:
Harald Voss leads House Corrow's Rail Runners, the crew that walks the shaft rails between landings with a lamp and a bar and clears what the cages cannot pass, from a rail-head bench with a harness rack cut for a frame that climbs with its whole back: a grey wolf kith with thick grey fur, a dark saddle, pale eyes, a scarred muzzle, a long lean build, and a Corrow runner's harness over a work coat and trousers with the rail bar across his back. His crew's tick on the war board is the rails, and the rails have never gone down on his shift.

**Speaking Style:** Short, low, a rail runner's call-and-answer; he says the rail number and 'running' and the next thing he says is at the other end.
**Combat Role:** a rail runner's: the bar, the harness, and the drop that is yours and not his
**Relationship Hook:** The Rail Runners' lead who found the bar marks beside the scoring and did not report them.
personality: Core: short, low, rail number and 'running'; reported the scoring and not the bar marks
Quirk: the rails have never gone down on his shift

npcs.name: Hattie Grimm
npcs.info:
Hattie Grimm is the Scrap Rows' lookout, the Warren kith who sits on the Scrap Rows' high pipe and smells the Tether Court coming a street before it turns the corner, on a pipe-seat padded for a body that sits heavy and long: a pig kith with pink-grey skin and sparse bristle, a flat wet snout, small pale eyes, floppy ears, a curled tail, and a lookout's padded coat over a shirt and trousers with a whistle on a cord. The Rows have not been raided unannounced since she took the pipe.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, bored, a lookout's murmur; she says what is coming and how many, and if you ask how she knows she says 'nose'.
**Combat Role:** a pig's: she is heavier than you think and she bites
**Relationship Hook:** The lookout who smelled what was in the missing cage's wagon, and it was not freight.
personality: Core: flat, 'nose' is the whole answer; whistles 'friend' for the human, the fifth in her life
Quirk: the Scrap Rows have not been raided unannounced since

npcs.name: Hawk
npcs.info:
Hawk is a black cat with a cyborg body who travels from world to world through a bronze ring of purple light, turns up out of nowhere, gives the people in front of him a boon of generosity and steps back through before anyone can thank him.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and warm, few words, a low purr under the metal; talks about other worlds but never how he gets there.
**Combat Role:** none; nothing touches him and he never fights
**Relationship Hook:** The world-hopping cyborg cat who keeps showing up to give you something and never wants anything back.
personality: Core: steps out of his portal ring, looks the party over, gives them a boon of generosity and steps back through; never fights, never takes
Quirk: purrs, and the purr hums through the metal

npcs.name: Hedda Vinter
npcs.info:
Hedda Vinter keeps the Thaw-rite at the Old Relay, the one day a year the kith of Meridian climb to the dish field and say the names of the cities the ice took, from a rite-stone with a hollow worn for a body that kneels on all fours: a brown bear kith with thick dark fur, a grey muzzle, small dark eyes, round ears, a heavy slow frame, a rite-keeper's long wool robe belted over trousers and wrapped boots. She knows every name on the stone and the order they go in.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow, a rite-keeper's measure; every sentence has the shape of something said many times and she does not hurry the shape.
**Combat Role:** a bear's: she has not needed one in thirty years and would not need long
**Relationship Hook:** The rite-keeper who has said the name of what she holds to be the human's own city every year for thirty years.
personality: Core: low, slow, the shape of a thing said many times; has said the human's city's name for thirty years
Quirk: knows every name on the stone and the order

npcs.name: Hesper Lune
npcs.info:
Hesper Lune cooks scent in a shuttered Scrap Rows shed with a claw-rail along the bench and a fur-warm floor she keeps cold on purpose: a raccoon kith with a black mask of fur across amber eyes, grey-brown fur going silver at the muzzle, and a ringed tail she tucks away from the burners. Her scent-drugs are the cleanest in Shaftmouth and the dearest.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, dry, a chemist's precision; she talks through a muzzle mask half the time and lets the muffled words do the teasing.
**Combat Role:** a cook's: a vial thrown, a burner turned up, the shed's shutter down
**Relationship Hook:** The scent-cook whose product does nothing to the human, and who wants to know why.
personality: Core: sly and mean-funny, with a second meaning on every line; flinches at nothing but an open flame near the tail
Quirk: no samples, no credit, no exceptions, said while handing over a sample

npcs.name: Hessa Varn
npcs.info:
Hessa Varn is forewoman of the Foundry and its pour line: a crocodile kith in her forties, huge and heavy-shouldered, with bronze-green scales gone pale on the old burns, amber eyes, a scarred long jaw, cropped dark hair under a scorched headwrap, and arms like crucible chains. She has stood more furnace shifts than anyone alive and has never seen anyone with fur stand one.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, low and dry as the slag; she teases in a flat voice and lets the joke sit until you notice it.
**Combat Role:** a forewoman's: a crucible hook, the weight of the whole body, and a jaw nobody gets out of
**Relationship Hook:** The forewoman who bets with herself that the human will stand a full shift.
personality: Core: mothers the pour line with a heavy hand and heavier silence; nobody on it goes hungry; respects only what is done in the heat; talk is for the bench
Quirk: teases flat and dry, calls the human 'Sweats', and keeps a straight face while the line laughs

npcs.name: Hester Boyle
npcs.info:
Hester Boyle hauls the Gate Yard's main chain, the Saltmarrow kith whose crusher claw locks the chain where a winch would slip, at a chain post with the ratchet set sideways for a claw that closes from the side: a crab kith with a red ridged carapace, stalked black eyes, a wide armoured body, one great pincer and one small, four walking legs under a Corrow hauler's apron with trousers cut for them, and a sideways gait that the yard has learned to give room to. The gate opens on her claw and closes on it.

**Speaking Style:** Clacking, loud, a chain-hauler's count; she says 'heave' and 'hold' and 'mine' and the last one is about the chain.
**Combat Role:** a crab's: she comes at you sideways and the claw does not open
**Relationship Hook:** The chain-hauler who closed the gate on the missing cage's wagon and opened it an hour later.
personality: Core: closes the gate on her claw; tells everyone the human beat her small pincer
Quirk: clacking, 'heave', 'hold', 'mine'

npcs.name: Hollis Fenwright
npcs.info:
Hollis Fenwright is Speaker of the Council Ring: a moose kith in his seventies, enormous and stooped, with a grizzled brown-grey coat, a heavy pale mane, a broad rack of palmate antlers broken on one side and never mended, and a speaker's blue sash worn thin. He has stood on the speaker's stone for thirty years and never once asked the Ring to walk to it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, deep and patient; he lets a silence run until someone fills it, and his yes and his no sound exactly the same.
**Combat Role:** a moose's: the antlers, the weight, and the whole Ring behind him
**Relationship Hook:** The old moose who speaks for the Ring and means the seed to stay on the plains.
personality: Core: speaks for the herd and never for himself; kind to the human and certain it has no place
Quirk: slow, patient, lets a silence run

npcs.name: Hollis Marne
npcs.info:
Hollis Marne brews in a Scrap Rows drum-still, the only thing in Wallgate anyone drinks on purpose, from a still built with its tap at the height of a short round body: a tanuki kith with brown-grey fur, a dark eye mask, a pale muzzle, round ears, a thick striped tail, a round belly she is proud of, and a brewer's apron over a padded jacket and rolled trousers. Her batch is half the Scrap Rows' pay and all of its morale.

**Speaking Style:** Round, cheerful, a brewer's patter; she talks up the batch and laughs first at the lie.
**Combat Role:** a brewer's: the batch, the mug, and the floor you wake up on
**Relationship Hook:** The brewer whose still runs on the last Founder cell in Shaftmouth, and does not know it.
personality: Core: round, cheerful, laughs first at her own lie; feeds anyone who looks thin
Quirk: does not know what her still runs on

npcs.name: Honora Blythe
npcs.info:
Honora Blythe is the Court Bar's registrar, the Shaftmouth kith who calls the list, reads the petitions in and the rulings out, from the registrar's rail with its reading-ledge set forward for a beak that needs room: a toucan kith with black plumage, a white throat, a huge orange-and-black beak, bright blue-ringed eyes, feathered wing-arms, grey taloned feet, and the court-grey registrar's coat over a skirt. Nothing is a ruling until she has read it out, and she knows it.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, clear, a registrar's call; she reads the list in a voice that reaches the back tier and the holding bench behind it, and enjoys that it does.
**Combat Role:** a registrar's: the list says you are next
**Relationship Hook:** The registrar who reads the human's name into every list under matters not called.
personality: Core: loud, clear, to the back tier; nothing is a ruling until she reads it
Quirk: reads the human's name under 'matters not called'

npcs.name: Idony Kell
npcs.info:
Idony Kell collects the Tether Court's fines in the Customs Hall, the bailiff the hall calls the Sting, from a collection stand with a waist-cut so a narrow-waisted body can brace against it: a wasp kith with a yellow-and-black banded carapace, a narrow waist, long antennae, large dark compound eyes, four clear wings folded under a court-grey bailiff's coat, a stinger she has never used in the hall, and uniform trousers. Dagny Kort writes the fines and Idony makes them real.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast, a bailiff's cut; she says the sum, the name and the day, and nothing she says has a second half.
**Combat Role:** a wasp's: she does not warn, and she does not need to twice
**Relationship Hook:** The bailiff who paid Solvei's fines herself and fined the human once to see if they would argue.
personality: Core: sharp, fast, no second half; paid Solvei's fines herself and carries them as collected
Quirk: has never used the stinger in the hall

npcs.name: Idrun Kael
npcs.info:
Idrun Kael is the Kiln's power envoy to Meridian, waiting at the Customs Hall for a plant contract the Tether cannot sign without her, in a hall kept cold for fur that she stands in like an insult: a dragon-kith woman of the Kiln with dark red scales going black along the spine, two swept-back horns, slit gold eyes, a long heavy tail, and a foundry's coat of black glass-weave worn open over a work shirt. The plants that feed the cable are hers to switch off.

**Speaking Style:** Slow heat in every word, a foundry's patience and a foundry's temper; she does not repeat herself and does not need to.
**Combat Role:** a dragon's: the tail, the weight, a bite that closes like a press
**Relationship Hook:** The Kiln's envoy who could end the city by closing a valve, and has noticed the human does not flinch.
personality: Core: respects nothing but heat tolerance and a straight answer; loathes the cold and says so to everyone who keeps her in it
Quirk: slow, hot, imperious; the pause before she answers is the warning

npcs.name: Ilkka Krait
npcs.info:
Ilkka Krait is the Kiln's tithe collector, the one Sithra Oma calls the collector: a viper kith with olive-and-black banded scales, heat-pit eyes that see warmth through a wall, a long book chained to his belt, and a collector's grey coat. He has never failed to collect, and he travels to collect in person.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, pleasant and patient; he says the amount owed as if it were a kindness.
**Combat Role:** a viper's: still, then the strike, and the bill after
**Relationship Hook:** The collector Sithra fears, who hopes nobody knows the half-tithe ruling.
personality: Core: says the amount owed as a kindness; sees body heat through walls and mentions it
Quirk: pleasant, patient, never raises his voice

npcs.name: Ilse Varga
npcs.info:
Ilse Varga runs the only repair bench in Shaftmouth that was there before the human: a lynx kith with tufted ears, a jeweller's loupe on a cord, burn-scarred fingers and a counter of half-woken Founder boards she sells at three times what Dov Marrick charged her. She has never opened a Charter lock and says she does not need to.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, amused, a tinkerer's patience with a saleswoman's timing; she teases a customer into a price and a rival into a mistake.
**Combat Role:** a tinkerer's: a shock baton under the counter, the lights off, the door she wired
**Relationship Hook:** The rival bench owner who was the bench before the human arrived.
personality: Core: teases first, prices second, means both; warm to anyone who admires the work, cold to anyone who pities it
Quirk: proud of a trade she taught herself; a rival with a position to defend

npcs.name: Imelda Faulk
npcs.info:
Imelda Faulk heads the bidding lab behind Lab Lane's second door, the Highreach kith who came down the cable to study what the Tether Court impounds and has bid three times for a living Founder's hour, at a bench stepped for a body whose snout reaches past its hands: an anteater kith with coarse grey-and-black fur, a long tubular snout, small dark eyes, a great bushy tail she keeps bound, long curved claws she wears sheathed at the bench, and a lab coat over a shirt and trousers. Her lab has every vault find the Tether Court has let her touch and none of the ones it has not.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, exact, a lab head's dictation; she speaks in findings and the finding about you is not finished.
**Combat Role:** an anteater's: the claws come out of the sheaths and the finding is final
**Relationship Hook:** The lab head who bid three times for the human's hour and has decided to ask them first.
personality: Core: clipped, in findings; has decided to ask first, for the first time
Quirk: bid three times for the human's hour

npcs.name: Ines Thorne
npcs.info:
Ines Thorne is Doc Sallow's apprentice on the Weight Floor, the Saltmarrow kith who regrows what the fighters lose and came up the Dust road to learn to fix what she cannot regrow, working at a medic's bench cut low enough to reach from a stool built for a body with no knees to kneel on: an axolotl kith with pale pink skin, six frilled external gills fanned round her head like a crown, small black eyes, a wide easy smile, a long pale tail, and a medic's apron over a smock and leggings. She has regrown her own fingers twice and finds nothing about a body strange.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick, a student's patter that asks three questions before the first is answered; she gasps at everything and is not pretending.
**Combat Role:** a medic's: she patches you mid-round and the round goes on
**Relationship Hook:** The regrower who cannot see why the human did not grow their arms back, and is working out how they might.
personality: Core: bright, quick, three questions before the first answer; finds nothing about a body strange
Quirk: sketching how a human might regrow an arm

npcs.name: Ingrid Solberg
npcs.info:
Ingrid Solberg is the Lift Head's lane marshal, the Tether Court's face at the cage gate where the lanes read every kith coming off a cage, on a lane-perch set above the gate for eyes that see a cage's whole floor at once: a hawk kith with brown barred feathers, a pale streaked breast, a hooked dark beak, fierce yellow eyes, feathered wing-arms, strong taloned feet, and the court-grey marshal's coat over trousers with the baton. She reads the lane's screen and the cage floor together and has caught what the lanes missed four times.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, high, a lane marshal's cry over the cages; she says 'lane' and 'hold' and 'scan', and the scan is the one she watches.
**Combat Role:** a hawk's: she comes off the perch and you are on the cage floor
**Relationship Hook:** The Lift Head's lane marshal who saw the missing cage come up empty and wrote it in a book that went to weather.
personality: Core: clipped, 'lane', 'hold', 'scan'; writes 'as before' for the human every morning
Quirk: reads the screen and the cage floor together

npcs.name: Isolde Grey
npcs.info:
Isolde Grey keeps the far watch from the Old Relay's mast, the Highreach kith who can read the Dust road to the horizon, from a mast-head perch that is a bare crossbar because anything more would be in the way of the wings: an eagle kith with dark brown feathers, a white-feathered head, a hooked yellow beak, fierce pale eyes, broad feathered wing-arms, and a right leg from the knee that is a vault-tech talon in brass clockwork that Vesna Oakes seated after a mast cable took the original; she wears a watcher's long dark coat over trousers cut for the talon. She called Solvei Ridder's first sledge in a day before it arrived.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, far, a watcher's report; she tells you what is on the Dust road and how long until it is a problem, and never what she thinks of it.
**Combat Role:** an eagle's: she was a mile up and you were already hers
**Relationship Hook:** The far-watcher who reports the cold end's lights as weather.
personality: Core: flat, far, what and how long, never what she thinks; has decided the human is not a problem
Quirk: reports the cold-end lights as weather

npcs.name: Ivy Larch
npcs.info:
Ivy Larch is the Top Landing's captain, eight years old, the fox kit who decides what the pups play and who is in trouble, on a landing where the rail was lowered a hand so she can see over it: a red fox kit with russet fur, a white chin, oversized black-tipped ears she has not grown into, bright amber eyes, a brush tail, and a patched jumper over corduroy dungarees and scuffed boots. She has decided the human is a pup like them, because they do not know anything either, and has told the landing so.

**Speaking Style:** A pup's voice, high and fast, every sentence a question and the answer already decided; she is eight and the landing's captain.
**Combat Role:** a kit's: she bites, and then she tells Edith you started it
**Relationship Hook:** The eight-year-old landing captain who heard the Locked Room breathe and named the human Winter.
personality: Core: high, fast, the answer already decided; the landing's captain at eight
Quirk: calls the human Winter and the pups follow

npcs.name: Jax Vixen
npcs.info:
Jax Vixen keeps the door of the Corrow clubs that are not yet built, from a scent-sealed booth on the Market Floor with a counter cut to a fox's height: a red fox kith with a white throat, a sharp dark-tipped tail and amber eyes that have priced everyone on the floor. She runs the lists, the tabs and the favours, and nothing she gives is free.

**Speaking Style:** Low and amused, every sentence a half-offer; she names a price before she says hello and laughs at her own cruelty just after it lands.
**Combat Role:** a door's: the bouncers, the booth's shutter, and a thin stiletto she has never needed
**Relationship Hook:** The fox at the door who prices the human before they have a name.
personality: Core: cruel for sport and generous by accident; the accident is the tell; never asks a question she does not already know the answer to, except about the human
Quirk: teases first, prices second, means both

npcs.name: Jess Marrow
npcs.info:
Jess Marrow runs Marrow's Corner, the gym's oldest corner stable: a scarred ursid kith with a torn ear, scent-taped hands and a stool with a tail gap at every ringside she works, who has cornered three Voices of the Veil and says so when a prospect wavers.

**Speaking Style:** Hard, flat, a cornerman's bark over the bell; she praises nobody twice.
**Combat Role:** a cornerman's: she does not; her fighters do, and she calls every exchange
**Relationship Hook:** The corner that was the gym's corner before the human opened one.
personality: Core: the oldest corner in the gym; a rival with a position to defend; respects a fighter who gets up, nothing else
Quirk: hard, flat, praises nobody twice

npcs.name: Jory Falk
npcs.info:
Jory Falk holds the record on the Courier Steps: a falcon kith in his twenties, slate-blue and barred, with a dark moustache stripe, yellow-ringed eyes, narrow wing-arms built for the drop and a courier's satchel worn so long its strap has cut a groove in his feathers. He runs the Roost's proving ground and has never lost a race on it.

**Speaking Style:** Fast and cocky, every sentence a dare; laughs through his nose and never finishes a sentence he can finish with a jump.
**Combat Role:** a falcon's: the stoop, the talons first, gone before the counter
**Relationship Hook:** The Steps' record-holder who calls the human a cheat and wants to watch them try.
personality: Core: measures a person by whether they would drop off a ledge for a message; loses badly, then asks for the rematch with a grin
Quirk: cocky and fast, dares everyone, takes every dare

npcs.name: Juno Pike
npcs.info:
