Juno Pike is Veil Gym's kickboxer, the one fighter on the rail who wins with her feet, in a ring whose ropes are set at a tiger's reach and whose floor she never stays on: a rabbit kith with tawny fur, long ears taped back for a bout, a pink nose, bright hazel eyes, a lean springy build, hand wraps and shin wraps, a cropped Veil top and fight shorts. Her kicks come off the rail and the rail bets on them.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, bright, mouthy; she talks between punches and the talk is part of the punches.
**Combat Role:** a kickboxer's: the rail, the spring, a kick that comes from above
**Relationship Hook:** The kickboxer who teases the human from the rail because they watch without betting.
personality: Core: wins with her feet and says so; wants the glove and pretends she does not
Quirk: mouthy, fast, teases between rounds

npcs.name: Kade Brannock
npcs.info:
Kade Brannock runs the Corrow freight desk at the Freight Yard: a heavy canid kith with a cropped black coat, a loader's harness worn as a uniform and a scent tally on a chain, booking every cage slip the yard sells and tallying by scent before the boards post. A second desk in his yard is a thing he has never allowed.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, loud over the cages, a dispatcher's voice that books a cage before you finish asking.
**Combat Role:** a dispatcher's: the yard's loaders, a brake call, a cage between him and trouble
**Relationship Hook:** The Corrow desk that booked every cage before the human's desk opened.
personality: Core: clipped, loud, books before you finish; fair to a crew, hard on a desk
Quirk: the yard is his; a rival with a position to defend

npcs.name: Kesh Vell
npcs.info:
Kesh Vell runs the Scrap Rows chop-shop from a hot room nobody else can stand in, a basking lamp over the bench and black glass on the floor: a gecko-blooded lizard kith of the Kiln with dusty green scales, gold slit-pupil eyes, splayed sticky fingertips that never slip on a part, and the slow heavy manner of a city whose law remembers a thousand years. He sets ports and swaps parts for anyone who can pay and sit still.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, level, a surgeon's cadence; long pauses while the hands work and a dry joke when they stop.
**Combat Role:** a surgeon's: he does not; the restraints on his bench do
**Relationship Hook:** The chop-shop surgeon who will not guess where a human nerve runs.
personality: Core: slow, level, every instruction once; the hands do the talking; cold-blooded in every sense; works the hot room, sleeps on the glass
Quirk: will not guess; says 'I do not know' like a price

npcs.name: Ketra Mallin
npcs.info:
Ketra Mallin is Veil Gym's ring champion, the one the rail calls the Laugh, fighting under ropes hung at a tiger's reach that she ducks and a bell she rings herself: a hyena kith with tan spotted fur, a dark bristling mane, round ears, a heavy jaw, yellow eyes, and a right arm that is vault-tech from the shoulder, built by Ilse Varga after a Corrow bruiser took the original in a bout three winters back; she wears the arm bare with a Veil fight top and shorts, and the arm is why nobody fights her bare-handed twice. She laughs before she hits and the rail has learned to bet on the laugh.

**Speaking Style:** A laugh first, always, a cackle with teeth in it, and then the sentence; she talks through a grin that is not a smile.
**Combat Role:** a hyena's: the laugh, the jaw, the vault-tech arm that does not get tired
**Relationship Hook:** The ring champion whose vault-tech arm is a debt to Tacca that will never clear.
personality: Core: cackles first, then the sentence; gentle with the human, the only one
Quirk: fights for a debt that never clears

npcs.name: Kip Tanner
npcs.info:
Kip Tanner runs parts from the Scrap Rows to Varga's Bench, the Shaftmouth kith who carries what Zinnia Holt and Lucan Drummond sell up the Gate Yard in a frame-pack, from a pack-bench by the counter cut for a frame that drops a load off its back by sitting: a red squirrel kith with russet fur, tufted ears, a great bushy tail, bright black eyes, quick hands, and a runner's short coat over trousers with the frame-pack on, and a left leg below the knee that is a vault-tech spring Elsie Wick built as her first piece after a Scrap Rows cave-in took the original. He says the spring is faster than the leg was and Elsie says it is not, yet.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, chattery, a runner's pitch; he tells you what he brought, what he could have brought and what it would cost to go back for it.
**Combat Role:** a runner's: he was up the Gate Yard before you finished the sentence
**Relationship Hook:** The part-runner who wears Elsie's first limb and skims on everything but the human's parts.
personality: Core: fast, what he brought and what it would cost to go back; skims the small difference, never on the human's parts
Quirk: tells everyone the spring is Elsie's first

npcs.name: Kit Dorran
npcs.info:
Kit Dorran writes the petitions at the Customs Hall's door, the Shaftmouth kith who turns a crew lead's complaint into a page the Tether Court will read, from a writing-box she carries on her back and sits on, built for a body that perches: a red squirrel kith with russet fur, tufted ears, a great bushy tail she wraps round the box, bright black eyes, quick small hands, and a scribe's ink-stained jacket over a short skirt and leggings. The Tether Court reads her pages first because they are the only ones it can read.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, bright, a scribe's patter; she finishes your petition before you finish your sentence and reads it back better than you meant it.
**Combat Role:** a squirrel's: she is up the pillar with your page before you have finished the sentence
**Relationship Hook:** The petition-writer who kept copies of all eleven missing-cage petitions the Tether Court filed as weather.
personality: Core: fast, bright, finishes your petition first; the Tether Court reads her pages first
Quirk: kept copies of all eleven cage petitions

npcs.name: Lark Vesey
npcs.info:
Lark Vesey sells scent-wafers at the mouth of Canteen Row, the Shaftmouth kith whose rack is where the lane scanners read who ate, from a rack-stall with its drawers at chest height for a body that stands on its hind feet to reach: a chipmunk kith with striped brown fur, a pale belly, cheek pouches, a bushy tail, bright black eyes, and a seller's short jacket over a pinafore and leggings. Her wafers carry a kith's scent-mark for the scanners and a sweet for the mouth, and Canteen Row buys them for both.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, bright, a seller's chirp; she reads your scent off the wafer before you have paid and tells you what it says about your week.
**Combat Role:** a chipmunk's: she is up the rack and the drawer is shut
**Relationship Hook:** The scent-wafer seller who can make a wafer carry a scent that is not yours, and has none for the human.
personality: Core: quick, reads your week off your wafer; stands on her hind feet to reach
Quirk: trying to make the human a scent from their coat

npcs.name: Lavinia Crouch
npcs.info:
Lavinia Crouch heads the Tether Court's own lab behind Lab Lane's first door, the Shaftmouth kith who holds what the Tether Court impounds and answers to the justices alone, at a bench with a sun-lamp over it for a body that goes slow when it is cold: an iguana kith with green scales gone grey at the crest, a spiny dorsal crest, a loose dewlap, slow gold eyes, a long striped tail, and a lab coat over a shirt and trousers with the lab's seal on a chain. She has had the human's two pod pieces for a season and signed nothing back.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, slow, a lab head's dismissal; she tells you what the Tether Court's lab has found and it is always 'nothing yet', in a voice that means the opposite.
**Combat Role:** an iguana's: she goes still under the lamp and you forget she is there
**Relationship Hook:** The Tether Court's lab head who has had the pod pieces open and holds they are not Founder work.
personality: Core: dry, slow, 'nothing yet'; intends to tell the human before the Tether Court
Quirk: has had the pod pieces open for a season

npcs.name: Liesl Pennant
npcs.info:
Liesl Pennant is a deed clerk at the Clerk's Bench: a red panda kith of twenty, small and slight in a city of bears, with russet fur, a ringed tail she tucks round her feet, white-masked face, quick dark eyes and ink on every finger. Her family has rented a block in the Old Quarter from the seat for nine generations.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, soft and careful, a clerk's precise words with a nervous laugh between them; brave when it matters.
**Combat Role:** a red panda's: up on the bench, the book thrown, and gone
**Relationship Hook:** The deed clerk who wants the deeds voided and needs the human to say it.
personality: Core: brave when it matters and sorry afterwards; knows every deed in the walls by its number
Quirk: quick, careful, a nervous laugh

npcs.name: Linnea Ashby
npcs.info:
Linnea Ashby drums the ring's bouts, the House Veil kith whose pace tells the fighters when to go and the rail when to bet, from a drum-stool with a notch for a tail and the drum braced low for short arms: a deer kith with tan fur, a white belly, large dark eyes, long ears, a short tail, small antler nubs, slender legs ending in hooves, and a Veil house vest over a short skirt and leggings with a drum slung at her hip. The bout does not start until she does.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, rhythmic, a drummer's count; she talks in the tempo of the last bout and the rail can tell who is winning by her speed.
**Combat Role:** a deer's: she is not in the ring and she is already gone from the rail
**Relationship Hook:** The ring's drummer whose tempo moves Sabine's odds without the rail knowing.
personality: Core: quick, rhythmic, the count is the odds; the bout starts when she does
Quirk: drums slower when the human is on the rail

npcs.name: Lisbet Mourne
npcs.info:
Lisbet Mourne climbs the Old Relay's dish at night to clear the ice off the feed, the Highreach kith with the eyes for it, up a ladder whose rungs were respaced for hands and feet that grip the same: a lemur kith with soft grey fur, a black-and-white ringed tail longer than she is, huge yellow eyes in dark patches, a white muzzle, small clever hands, and a climber's harness over a fleece and leggings. She has never fallen and the dish has never gone dark on her watch.

**Speaking Style:** Light, lilting, every sentence rising at the end as if the next one is better; she sings the relay's call-signs instead of saying them.
**Combat Role:** a lemur's: she is already three rungs above the reach of it
**Relationship Hook:** The dish-climber whose cage count from the lights differs from the board by one.
personality: Core: light, lilting, sings the call-signs; has never fallen
Quirk: counts the cages by their lights from the dish

npcs.name: Lorelei Crane
npcs.info:
Lorelei Crane runs Ruby Fang's messages from the kitchen, the Highreach kith who carries a voice instead of a note, perched on a kitchen rail set at the height a bird stands: a parrot kith with scarlet and blue plumage, a short hooked black beak, bright ringed eyes, clipped feathered wing-arms, scaled clawed feet, and a messenger's short red jacket over trousers. She repeats a message in the sender's own voice and the tenement has learned not to say anything near her.

**Speaking Style:** Any voice she has heard, back at you perfectly, and her own underneath it is small and sweet and rarely used.
**Combat Role:** a parrot's: she says it in the voice that makes you stop
**Relationship Hook:** The messenger who carries Ruby's year of messages in Ruby's voice and uses the human's when alone.
personality: Core: any voice back perfectly, her own small; the tenement says nothing near her
Quirk: uses the human's voice to herself when the kitchen is empty

npcs.name: Lorne Draska
npcs.info:
Lorne Draska is Tova's cousin and next in line after her: a polar bear kith in his thirties, tall and lean for a bear, with a white coat, black eyes and nose, a precise trimmed ruff, and a keeper's coat of the seat hung with the keys to the Deed Wall. He keeps the deeds' frames and their copies.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, cold and courteous; he agrees with everything you say and means none of it.
**Combat Role:** a polar bear's: the long reach, the weight, and no sound before it
**Relationship Hook:** Tova's cousin who keeps the deeds and wants the human gone.
personality: Core: keeps every key and every copy; watches Tova for the moment she falters
Quirk: courteous, cold, agrees and means none of it

npcs.name: Lotte Varnham
npcs.info:
Lotte Varnham leads House Corrow's Cage Crew, the hands who ride the cages down and bring the loads up, from a cage-step worn by a body that rides on the outside with a tail round the bar: a monkey kith with brown fur, a pale face, bright dark eyes, long arms, a long prehensile tail, and a Corrow cage hand's short coat over trousers with the load-strap across. Her crew's tick is the cages, and she counts them in and out herself.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, chattering, a cage hand's count; she counts the crew in and out loud and the count is a joke until it is one short.
**Combat Role:** a cage hand's: she is on the outside of the cage and you are inside it
**Relationship Hook:** The Cage Crew lead whose crew came back one short, her brother, and who counts the human in.
personality: Core: quick, chattering, the count is a joke until it is short; rides on the outside, tail round the bar
Quirk: counts the human in with the crew

npcs.name: Lucan Drummond
npcs.info:
Lucan Drummond deals the Scrap Rows' parts, the Warren kith whose stall is the only place in Meridian that sells the armoury's part families by name, from a stall with its racks hung high for a body that sees over the crowd and laughs at it: a hyena kith with tan spotted fur, a dark bristling mane, round ears, a heavy jaw, yellow eyes, a dealer's long coat over a vest and trousers with the part-tags on a ring. His racks hold wire-family spool parts, implant-family housings, the mounts and the seals, and the price goes up when he laughs.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, low, a dealer's patter with a laugh under it; he names the part, the family and the price, and the laugh is the price going up.
**Combat Role:** a hyena's: the laugh, the jaw, and the Scrap Rows behind him
**Relationship Hook:** The parts dealer who sold the cage's door spring and the plate's twin and remembers every face.
personality: Core: smooth, low, the laugh is the price going up; sold the human at cost and did not laugh
Quirk: no book, every face

npcs.name: Lumen Vey
npcs.info:
Lumen Vey keeps the night watch on the Old Relay's dish field, drawn to the one light in Meridian that never goes out, on a watch seat built without a back for her wings: a moth kith with pale grey-cream fuzz, a thick fur ruff at the throat, feathered antennae, large dark compound eyes, folded dust-grey wings with eye-spots, and a long layered coat over leggings that she wears open to the light. She hears the relay's carrier as a note and can tell when it changes.

**Speaking Style:** Light, drifting, half a step behind the conversation and then suddenly ahead of it; she hums on the relay's note.
**Combat Role:** a moth's: she is not where the light shows you she was
**Relationship Hook:** The night-watcher who has listened to the human on the band for a month without a word.
personality: Core: drifting, humming, half a step behind then ahead; hears the carrier as a note
Quirk: has listened to the human for a month without a word

npcs.name: Mab Ostler
npcs.info:
Mab Ostler keeps the ice-rows outside Wallgate, the Shaftmouth kith who lays Meridian's dead in the frozen ground beyond the Gate Yard and carves the row-marks, from a keeper's hut with its door cut mouse-high and the rows themselves cut kith-long: a mouse kith with soft grey fur, large round ears, a pink nose, long whiskers, a long thin tail, small black eyes, and a keeper's long dark coat over a wool dress and wrapped boots, with a carving knife at her belt. She knows every row-mark by touch and the ice does not let her forget one.

**Speaking Style:** Low for the size of her, slow, a keeper's hush; she names the dead by their row and never raises her voice past the wind.
**Combat Role:** a mouse's: she is small, the rows are long, and you do not know which one you are standing on
**Relationship Hook:** The gravekeeper who laid seven she takes for the missing cage's crew under nameless marks and carved the names Astrid Kove's board gives them on the undersides.
personality: Core: low, slow, names the dead by their row; carved the nameless crew's names on the undersides
Quirk: knows every mark by touch

npcs.name: Magda Ryland
npcs.info:
Magda Ryland was the ring's champion before Tacca Veil and before Ketra Mallin, the old fighter who sits the Weight Floor's end bench and watches the bouts she no longer fights, on a bench with a back because her spine is done: an old crocodile kith with dark olive scales gone pale at the jaw, a long flat snout with a tooth missing, slow yellow eyes, a ridged back, a long heavy tail she rests on the bench, and a worn Veil house jacket over a vest and trousers. The rail calls her the Jaw and she has not answered to it in ten years.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow, a retired champion's economy; she says who won and why in six words and has never been wrong about the why.
**Combat Role:** the Jaw's: she does not fight any more, and the rail still goes quiet when she stands
**Relationship Hook:** The retired champion who threw the title to Tacca for the purse that bought the ring.
personality: Core: low, slow, who won and why in six words; told Marnie the human would do
Quirk: has not answered to the Jaw in ten years

npcs.name: Mara Teodor
npcs.info:
Mara Teodor keeps the Warm Baths: a sun bear kith in her forties, compact and strong, with a glossy black coat, a pale gold crescent across her chest, a broad grin, and a bath keeper's wrap with a ring of keys at her hip. She hears everything the seat says in the steam.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, lazy and amused; she talks like the steam, slowly, and every kindness has a price under it.
**Combat Role:** a sun bear's: small for a bear, fast for anything, and the claws first
**Relationship Hook:** The bath keeper who hears what the seat means and sells it in kind.
personality: Core: warm, lazy, amused; knows what the seat means before it says it
Quirk: a price under every kindness

npcs.name: Marguerite Tallis
npcs.info:
Marguerite Tallis is the Lift Head's signaller, the Highreach kith who sees over every head on the Market Floor and calls the cages up and down by flag, from a signal stand that has no platform because she does not need one: a giraffe kith with tan fur in brown patches, a long neck, short ossicones, long dark lashes over calm eyes, a dark tufted tail, and a signaller's long grey coat with the flags in loops down the front over trousers and tall boots. Nothing moves at the Lift Head until her flag drops.

**Speaking Style:** Level, carrying, a signaller's cadence from a long way up; she says the cage number, the landing and the word 'clear', and the yard moves on 'clear'.
**Combat Role:** a giraffe's: she saw it start before you did and she has the reach
**Relationship Hook:** The signaller whose flag log says who walked away from the missing cage.
personality: Core: level, carrying, 'clear' is the word; raises a hand to the human across the Floor
Quirk: sees over every head on the Floor

npcs.name: Marisol Quade
npcs.info:
Marisol Quade rigs the Lift Head's cables for House Corrow from the cable-stays themselves, where no stair goes: a monkey kith with tawny-brown fur, a pale face mask, a long prehensile tail she hangs from while she works, bright black eyes and a rigger's harness clipped to nothing because she never falls. She is the only one in Shaftmouth who goes up the shaft on the outside.

**Speaking Style:** Loud from a height, laughing before the joke; she talks faster the higher she climbs and goes quiet only on the ground.
**Combat Role:** a rigger's: she is above you, and then the cable is not where you left it
**Relationship Hook:** The rigger who goes up the shaft on the outside and tests everyone on the first ledge.
personality: Core: loud, acrobatic, teases from above where nobody can reach her; works with nobody who cannot climb; the test is the first ledge
Quirk: goes quiet on the ground and fidgets until she is off it

npcs.name: Marit Dunmore
npcs.info:
Marit Dunmore keeps the Pod Hall, the Saltmarrow kith who swims the flooded half of it and wipes the frost off the sealed pods nobody else will touch, from a wet ledge she sleeps on because beds are for bodies with legs that bend that way: a sea lion kith with sleek brown fur, long pale whiskers, small ear flaps, round dark eyes, flipper-footed legs she walks on upright, and a right arm that is vault-tech from the shoulder that Vesna Oakes seated after a pod lid came down on the original; she wears a keeper's oilskin over a wetsuit. She has counted the pods every day for six years and the count has changed once.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, steady, the voice of someone who has talked to sleepers for years; she finishes every sentence as if someone might wake on it.
**Combat Role:** a sea lion's: the water is hers and you came in on purpose
**Relationship Hook:** The pod keeper whose count changed by two the night the human's pod was cut.
personality: Core: soft, steady, finishes every sentence gently; counts the pods every day
Quirk: wipes the frost off the second empty pod

npcs.name: Marnie Ostrander
npcs.info:
Marnie Ostrander trains House Veil's fighters and has never fought, the kith who writes the week's bouts on the Back Room's board and stands the corner with the towel, from a corner stool she does not sit on and a board at a height she reaches on her toes: a kangaroo kith with grey fur, long upright ears, a long narrow face, a thick tail she balances on, long feet, a trainer's zip jacket over a vest and track trousers with the towel over her shoulder. She knows every fighter's left better than they do and has never been asked why she does not fight.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, fast, a trainer's count from the corner; 'again', 'higher', 'you dropped it', and she has never once said 'good'.
**Combat Role:** a trainer's: she does not; and the one time she did, the kith did not get up
**Relationship Hook:** The trainer who never fights because the one time she kicked, the kith did not get up.
personality: Core: sharp, 'again', 'higher', never 'good'; training the human on the bag without the house's say
Quirk: the house thinks her kind cannot fight in a ring

npcs.name: Marta Quell
npcs.info:
Marta Quell brings provisions in from the Dust homesteads and sells them by the crate off a stall on the Scrap Rows: a tall cervid kith with a cropped grey coat, antler stubs capped in brass, a scent seal on a cord and a crawler's whisker-sensor charm on the stall post. Her crates feed every canteen in Shaftmouth that can pay.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, warm and exact about weights; she names the price of a crate the way a farmer names the weather.
**Combat Role:** a homesteader's: a bolt gun under the stall, the crawler crews around her
**Relationship Hook:** The provisions broker a canteen cannot run without.
personality: Core: warm to anyone who eats what she sells; cold to anyone who haggles the homesteads down; reads the Dust weather off the crawler captains before she names a price
Quirk: slow to speak, exact about weights

npcs.name: Maud Bellamy
npcs.info:
Maud Bellamy is House Corrow's toll-clerk in the Gate Yard, asleep twenty hours of the day in a clerk's box with a sloped back built for a sleeper, and awake for exactly the four that matter: a koala kith with thick grey fur, a white chest, big fluffy round ears, a large black nose, small dark sleepy eyes, and a Corrow clerk's coat buttoned to the throat over a wool skirt. Nobody has ever passed the Gate Yard while she was asleep without her knowing the count in the morning.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, soft, half asleep and never wrong; she answers the question you were about to ask and goes back to dozing.
**Combat Role:** a koala's: she does not get up; you were counted on the way in
**Relationship Hook:** The sleeping toll-clerk who heard the cage count being arranged.
personality: Core: eyes shut, listening; cannot place the human's footsteps and likes it
Quirk: slow, soft, answers the question before it is asked

npcs.name: Merle Dunning
npcs.info:
Merle Dunning runs the pawn-cage on the Market Floor, the one place in Shaftmouth that will give you cold-coin for anything with a vault stamp on it, from a cage built with a low hatch for a body that goes under rather than round: a rat kith with sleek grey fur, a pink nose, long whiskers, large round ears, two front teeth she shows when a price is final, a long bald tail she keeps coiled round the stool leg, and a left eye that is a vault-tech jeweller's lens Ilse Varga fitted after a bad seal took the original. She wears a broker's waistcoat over a shirt and a long skirt, and she can read a stamp through the lens that the Tether Court's scanners cannot.

**Speaking Style:** Low, dry, a broker's patience; she names the price once, and the second time she names it the price is higher.
**Combat Role:** a broker's: the hatch, the cage, the price of trying
**Relationship Hook:** The pawn-broker with a vault-tech lens who has priced the human's slate and liked the number.
personality: Core: low, dry, names the price once; shows the teeth when a price is final
Quirk: has read every drowned-gallery stamp and bought none

npcs.name: Merrin Sloe
npcs.info:
Merrin Sloe is a record-keeper of the Archive Spire and its sharpest reader: a raven kith in her thirties, black-feathered to the gloss, with gold eyes, a short black crest cut ragged, wing-arms she folds behind her like a coat, and an ink-stained keeper's sash. She has been told to file the human and has decided to read them first.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, low and amused; she asks a question she knows the answer to, then writes your answer down anyway, and reads it back to you wrong on purpose.
**Combat Role:** a raven's: a stoop from the ledge above, the beak and the book's spine, and a word in the wrong ear
**Relationship Hook:** The archivist who wants to write the human down, and has their page hidden in her sash.
personality: Core: looks down on everyone from a ledge above and says so; admits nothing until it is in writing; keeps the human's page in her sash and touches it when she lies
Quirk: teases with questions; every answer goes in her book, read back wrong to see if you correct her

npcs.name: Minna Glass
npcs.info:
Minna Glass inspects the shaft rails from the outside, the Warren kith who walks the lift shaft's wet wall upside down where no ladder goes, clipped to nothing, from a rail-head with its gantry edge rounded for toes that grip: a gecko kith with bright orange skin flecked blue, large round lidless eyes, a wide easy smile, sticky toe pads on bare hands and feet, a thick regrown tail a shade paler than the rest, and a climber's harness over a sleeveless top and leggings. She has found every rail crack the lift crews missed and none of the ones they were paid to miss.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, cheeky, a climber's chatter from somewhere above you; she talks to the wall as much as to you and the wall gets the better jokes.
**Combat Role:** a gecko's: you are on the ladder and she is on the ceiling
**Relationship Hook:** The wall-walker who found where the missing cage was stopped between landings.
personality: Core: cheeky, from somewhere above you; walks the wet wall upside down
Quirk: tells the human her tail grew back, in case it helps

npcs.name: Mirren Slade
npcs.info:
Mirren Slade keeps the marshal post's gate log and the holding bench, the Shaftmouth kith who writes down who passed the Lift Head and reads it back to the bench, from a clerk's stool with a perch-rail for feet that grip: a pigeon kith with grey feathers, an iridescent green-and-purple throat, a small dark beak, round orange eyes, feathered wing-arms with slim fingers, and the court-grey clerk's coat over a skirt. She reads the log by glyph and by scent-mark and has never read a mark wrong.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, cooing, a clerk's murmur; she reads the gate log aloud in a voice that makes the holding bench feel like a waiting room.
**Combat Role:** a clerk's: the log says you were never here
**Relationship Hook:** The post clerk who writes the human into the gate log by their coat, unlawfully.
personality: Core: soft, cooing, the log aloud; reads by glyph and by scent-mark
Quirk: writes the human in by their coat

npcs.name: Morna Lusk
npcs.info:
Morna Lusk runs the Fish Market's back trade, the salvage that leaves Saltmarrow in crates of catch: a sea lion kith in her thirties, sleek golden-brown, with a thick neck ruff, dark liquid eyes, a laugh that carries the length of the market, and rings of Founder alloy she wears as if they were nothing. She knows what every crew raised before the Breakwater does.

**Speaking Style:** Throaty, laughing and sly; she bargains as if she is doing you a favour and you are both in on it.
**Combat Role:** a sea lion's: a laugh, a shove off the pontoon, and the water is hers
**Relationship Hook:** The fish-market trader holding a humming piece of the drowned vault.
personality: Core: laughing, sly, a favour in every bargain; knows every haul before the Breakwater
Quirk: keeps one thing back from every deal

npcs.name: Morwen Sallis
npcs.info:
Morwen Sallis weaves the Scrap Rows' nets and climbing lines on a frame hung from the rafters rather than stood on the ground, because her working limbs are up and behind her: a spider kith of the Warren with glossy black fur, a red mark on the brow, six dark eyes in two rows, small fangs, two slim human-shaped arms and four long jointed spinning limbs folded at her back, and a long dark wrap dress over leggings. Her lines are the only ones in Wallgate the climbers trust with their weight.

**Speaking Style:** Low, patient, amused; she talks like she is weaving you in and is not sorry about it.
**Combat Role:** a weaver's: you were already in the line before you saw it
**Relationship Hook:** The weaver whose climbing lines are her own silk and sell for ten times her price.
personality: Core: low, patient, weaving you in; wants the wire whips spun properly
Quirk: works from the rafters, limbs up and behind

npcs.name: Nan Pruett
npcs.info:
Nan Pruett is Canteen Row's grandmother, the oldest kith on the Market Floor, who has sat on Canteen Row's middle bench every day since before the lift was rebuilt and remembers every crew by its order, on a bench end worn to the shape of her and raised on blocks because her knees no longer bend to it: an old cow kith with grey-dappled white fur, short worn horns, long ears, cloudy soft eyes, a broad slow frame, a shawl over a wool dress and wrapped boots, a stick across her knees. The Row brings her the first bowl and she tells it whose pup it was.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, dry, an old woman's certainty; she calls every crew lead by the name they had as a pup and they answer to it.
**Combat Role:** none; Canteen Row fights for her
**Relationship Hook:** The Row's grandmother who remembers the vault being found and what the first kith carried out.
personality: Core: slow, dry, every lead by their pup-name; has asked the human to sit, and they did
Quirk: Canteen Row brings her the first bowl

npcs.name: Nell Tadmore
npcs.info:
Nell Tadmore pilots the Freight Yard's wet-dock barge for House Corrow, the one crawler in Shaftmouth that floats, from a cockpit built with a lily-pad seat and no ladder: a frog-kith of Saltmarrow's marsh edge with green mottled skin, gold eyes with wide black pupils, a wide mouth, webbed fingers and a wetsuit of pelt-climate weave with the arms cut off. She has never been dry and does not intend to start.

**Speaking Style:** Croaky, cheerful, a pontoon-pilot's shout brought indoors; laughs with her whole throat and swears in Saltmarrow.
**Combat Role:** a frog's: she is in the water before you have decided, and you are not
**Relationship Hook:** The barge pilot who knows the wet route under the Tether.
personality: Core: croaky, cheerful, loud; laughs first and means it; never dry, never still, never asks twice
Quirk: silent about the night the barge came back light

npcs.name: Nerida Coyle
npcs.info:
Nerida Coyle sells the reach's catch at the Freight Yard's wet end, the Saltmarrow kith whose stall is the only fresh thing in Shaftmouth, from a slab set low for a body that bends from the hips and not the knees: a shark kith with grey skin and a white belly, a blunt wide head, small black eyes, gill slits at the neck, rows of small teeth she shows when the price is final, a dorsal fin through a cut in her oilskin, and a left hand that is a vault-tech gaff-hook in dull steel that Vesna Oakes seated after a net winch took the original; she wears a fishmonger's apron over the oilskin and heavy trousers. She guts a fish with the hook faster than the yard can watch.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, wet, a fishmonger's cry over the yard; she names the catch and the price and the second price is for arguing.
**Combat Role:** a shark's: she does not stop, and the hook is for after
**Relationship Hook:** The fishmonger who sells eyeless fish from the drowned outflow and knows the sea-city's word.
personality: Core: guts with the hook faster than the yard can watch; lowered the human's price once, which is her respect
Quirk: loud, wet, the second price is for arguing

npcs.name: Nerys Coil
npcs.info:
Nerys Coil is the Tether Gate's cable-splicer, the Saltmarrow kith who can hold a lift cable's twelve strands open at once, on a splicing frame that was rebuilt the week she arrived because no other pair of hands could reach it: an octopus kith with blue-grey mottled skin, a round head, large gold eyes with bar pupils, eight tentacle locks for hair that work as hands, one of them a braided-wire splice limb she built after a cable took the original, suction cups along her forearms, and a splicer's coat with the sleeves cut off. The Platform runs on her splices and the Platform knows it.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, level, eight things at once and none of them hurried; she talks to the cable while she splices it and to you only if the cable is boring.
**Combat Role:** an octopus's: eight holds, no gap to breathe in, then she is gone up the cable
**Relationship Hook:** The splicer who can read which cage went up by the wear on the cable.
personality: Core: dry, level, eight things at once; talks to the cable first
Quirk: leaves the human eight-handed jobs to watch

npcs.name: Nessa Carrick
npcs.info:
Nessa Carrick runs for Howl's Crew, Sera Howl's own hands, the House Corrow kith who carries Sera's word between the Lift Head, the Freight Yard and the Gate Yard and lodges on the Top Landing because the tenement roof hatch is the fastest way to the Market Floor, under a hatch rope knotted for a body that goes up it hand over hand: a greyhound kith with short fawn fur, a long narrow muzzle, folded rose ears, dark liquid eyes, a whip-thin frame, and a Corrow runner's cropped jacket over leggings with the message tube across her back. Her crew's tick on the war board is Sera's own.

**Speaking Style:** Low, quick, a runner's aside; she says it once on the way past and expects you to have heard.
**Combat Role:** a greyhound's: she was already gone, and the message was never yours
**Relationship Hook:** Howl's Crew runner who carried all three of Sera's chits in one week and reads them now.
personality: Core: low, quick, once on the way past; up the hatch rope hand over hand
Quirk: runs the human's messages free and tells Sera double

npcs.name: Odette Glint
npcs.info:
Odette Glint runs Feather Row's paper trade, the market in everything the couriers forgot to seal: a magpie kith in her thirties, black and white with a green-blue sheen on the wings, a long tail she uses to point, bright black eyes, and rings, chains and pins of everything shiny anyone ever sold her. She knows what is in a sealed message by its weight.

**Speaking Style:** Light, quick and musical; she flatters you while she prices you, and laughs before she says no.
**Combat Role:** a magpie's: a bright thing in the eye, a hand in the pocket, and off on the wind
**Relationship Hook:** The paper-trader who knows what is in a sealed message by its weight, and wants the human's way into the Stack.
personality: Core: charming, quick, flatters before she bargains; collects bright things and facts and cannot resist either
Quirk: says no laughing and means it

npcs.name: Odile Varr
npcs.info:
Odile Varr is a Longmeadow drover waiting on a crawler at the Freight Yard, too tall for every doorway in Shaftmouth and standing in them anyway: a horse kith with a chestnut coat, a cropped black mane, freckles of darker hide across the muzzle, and the muscle of someone who walks beside a crawler for a living. She came up the Dust road with a herd contract nobody here can read.

**Speaking Style:** Flat plains vowels and a drover's volume; sarcasm with no smile behind it until she decides you are herd.
**Combat Role:** a drover's: a kick that folds a crate, a hauler's hook, the whole weight of her behind a shove
**Relationship Hook:** The drover from the plains who came looking for a Founder hand and found a human.
personality: Core: sarcastic to strangers, blunt to friends, silent to fools; measures everyone by what they can carry and how far
Quirk: the herd's order first; her own wants a long way second

npcs.name: Oriana Flett
npcs.info:
Oriana Flett sells the limb shop's stock on the Market Floor, the Shaftmouth kith whose stall rack holds the fitters' catalogue, the plated arms, the spring legs, the clockwork talons and the loupe eyes that Ilse Varga builds and Vesna Oakes seats, from a stall with a fitting-step for every leg height: a flamingo kith with pink plumage, a long curved neck, a black-tipped bent bill, pale ringed eyes, long thin legs, feathered wing-arms, and a dealer's smart coat over a dress with a right leg below the knee that is a vault-tech demo in polished brass she changes every week to show the stock. She sells the mod, the Varga's Bench fits it, and the load limiter is the same one the armoury's parts answer to.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, easy, a dealer's demonstration; she flexes the demo leg while she talks and the talk is the price.
**Combat Role:** a flamingo's: she stands on one leg and the other is brass
**Relationship Hook:** The limb dealer whose demo leg is Philippa's seat in brass, and who tore up the human's catalogue price twice.
personality: Core: bright, easy, flexes the demo leg; reads every maker's mark
Quirk: tore up the human's catalogue price twice

npcs.name: Oriel Danforth
npcs.info:
Oriel Danforth is House Corrow's advocate in the Customs Hall, the one who stands at the Tether Court's bar for every Corrow cage the Tether Court stops, at a bar built high enough that a long neck is the only way to be seen over it: a swan kith with white feathers, a black face mask running back from an orange beak, a long graceful neck, dark eyes, feathered wing-arms folded under a Corrow advocate's grey coat with the ribbon, and a long dark skirt. She has never lost a ruling in the Customs Hall and Edda Morrow knows exactly which rulings she won wrong.

**Speaking Style:** Measured, musical, never a word louder than the room needs; she makes the ruling sound like your idea and the fine like a favour.
**Combat Role:** an advocate's: the ruling, the ribbon, the wing across the bar
**Relationship Hook:** The advocate who argued the ruling that lets the cage counts stand, and cannot argue the human's case either way.
personality: Core: measured, musical, the fine sounds like a favour; hisses once when lying, almost trained out
Quirk: has never lost a ruling and knows which she won wrong

npcs.name: Orla Venn
npcs.info:
Orla Venn is the Tether Court's registrar: a lean stoat kith in a pelt-climate suit with the court's seal on a chain, a registry book in Founder-speak and raised claw-text, and the desk at the head of the court's licensing floor where every registered desk answers to her. She registers desks, issues the court's dockets and brings the court's work to those who keep its standing.

**Speaking Style:** Even, unhurried and exact; she reads a form aloud the way others read a verdict, and never raises her voice because the clerks go quiet when it drops.
**Combat Role:** a registrar's: she does not; the court's bailiffs do
**Relationship Hook:** The court's registrar who puts a human's print on the court's forms.
personality: Core: even, unhurried, exact; a form read aloud is a verdict; never raises her voice; the floor goes quiet when it drops
Quirk: keeps a private tally of every desk's standing in her head

npcs.name: Orrin Vask
npcs.info:
Orrin Vask runs the Veil Taproom off the Market Floor, the bar every crew drinks its pay in: a lynx kith with a scarred ear, a scent-seal ring and a counter at muzzle height worn smooth by a century of elbows. He pours for the rail, the loaders and the runners, and knows what each of them owes.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, amused, a host's voice that remembers your drink and your debt in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** a barman's: the heavy glass, the door crew, the lights
**Relationship Hook:** The taproom that was the district's canteen before the human opened one.
personality: Core: easy, amused, remembers every tab; warm to a regular, cold to a stranger who does not drink
Quirk: a host first; a rival with a position to defend

npcs.name: Orsola Delve
npcs.info:
Orsola Delve is the Speaker of the Long Table, the oldest Digger still seated: a badger kith in her sixties, broad and grey-striped, with forearms like shoring posts and a tally knife on a cord round her neck. She has buried two dig crews and three Speakers, and she reads the Tally Wall the way other people read faces.

**Speaking Style:** Slow and heavy, every word set down like a stone on the table; a short laugh like gravel when something surprises her.
**Combat Role:** a digger's: a short pick, the whole frame behind it, a shoring post swung like a door
**Relationship Hook:** The Speaker who must decide whether the human ends three hundred years of argument.
personality: Core: speaks last at every table and is obeyed when she does; mothers the dig crews with a heavy paw and a heavier silence
Quirk: tests a stranger with a long look and a hard question, then feeds them

npcs.name: Oskar Hallam
npcs.info:
Oskar Hallam is Saltmarrow's envoy at the Tether Court's bar, the one who argues the sea-city's cargo through the Customs Hall against Oriel Danforth every ice season, standing at a bar end widened by a hand's width for a body that does not fit the Tether Court's bench: a walrus kith with thick brown wrinkled hide, two long yellowed tusks, a bristle moustache, small deep-set eyes, a vast slow frame, and a sea-envoy's heavy fur-collared coat over waistcoat and trousers. He has lost to Oriel twice and won the war both times.

**Speaking Style:** Vast, slow, amused; he lets a silence sit until the other side fills it with something he can use, and thanks them.
**Combat Role:** a walrus's: he leans, and the bar, the bench and the ruling go with him
**Relationship Hook:** The sea-city's envoy who has the word for what pulled back, and will not give it to the Tether Court.
personality: Core: vast, slow, lets the silence do it; treats the human as the envoy of a dead city
Quirk: has lost twice and won both wars

npcs.name: Osric Holloway
npcs.info:
Osric Holloway is captain of the Watch Wall and the seat's hunters: a grizzly kith in his sixties, huge and grey-muzzled, with a silver-tipped coat, a torn ear, small sharp eyes and an old captain's coat of the seat's grey over battered plate. He has kept the wall for forty years and taught Tova to hunt.

**Speaking Style:** Rough, slow and plain; an old soldier who says what he sees once and expects to be believed.
**Combat Role:** a grizzly's: the charge, the claws, forty years of knowing where to stand
**Relationship Hook:** The old captain of the wall who taught the heir to hunt.
personality: Core: loyal to the heir before the seat; judges anyone by how they carry themselves on a hunt
Quirk: plain, slow, says it once

npcs.name: Ottilie Skarn
npcs.info:
Ottilie Skarn is House Corrow's crane-hand in the Freight Yard, the one who lifts what the cranes will not, in a yard whose cable gear is rated to her and not the other way round: an elephant kith with grey wrinkled skin, wide fanned ears, a short trunk she hooks round a load's strap, two capped tusks, a broad heavy frame, and a Corrow work coat cut open at the ears. She remembers every crate she has ever lifted and who signed for it.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, enormous, never raised; she says a thing once and the yard does it, and the one time she said it twice someone lost a job.
**Combat Role:** an elephant's: she does not fight; she moves what is in the way
**Relationship Hook:** The crane-hand who lifted the cage that never came up and has not lied yet.
personality: Core: slow, huge, never repeats herself; has never lied and is finding out what avoiding is
Quirk: remembers every load and every signature

npcs.name: Pell Asher
npcs.info:
Pell Asher keeps the tally at the Road Gate: a roe deer kith of nineteen, slight and long-legged, with a red-brown coat, a white throat patch, short new antlers he keeps knocking on the awnings, and a tally-runner's satchel of cords. He counts every crawler in and out and knows every family's berth by heart.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, bright and talking before he has finished thinking; he counts things out loud without noticing.
**Combat Role:** a deer's: a kick and away, faster than anyone in the yard
**Relationship Hook:** The gate's tally-keeper who wants out on a drive.
personality: Core: counts everything out loud; asks the human where it is supposed to stand
Quirk: quick, bright, talks before he thinks

npcs.name: Pell Ostrava
npcs.info:
Pell Ostrava runs House Veil's street collections two streets either side of the Market Floor: a slight ocelot kith in a pressed jacket with the Veil mark, a comm bead, a book on his chip and the house behind him. He comes for the cut every ten days and never threatens twice.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, exact and friendly; he says the number once, smiles, and does not say it twice.
**Combat Role:** a runner's: he does not; two Veil prospects do
**Relationship Hook:** The house's runner who comes for the cut.
personality: Core: likes the human and collects from them anyway; the job is the job; carries news both ways and sells none of it
Quirk: cheerful, exact, never twice

npcs.name: Pernille Skaw
npcs.info:
Pernille Skaw is the Saltmarrow cold-diver who works the Tether Gate's Platform in the ice season, on a lane whose scanner was recut for a body with no ears to read: a penguin kith with black-and-white plumage, a white chest, a yellow-orange beak, dark round eyes, short strong flippers that end in three-fingered hands, and a diver's wetsuit under a thick hooded coat. She goes into water that stops kith hearts and comes out laughing.

**Speaking Style:** Even, unhurried, a little hoarse from cold water; she laughs with her whole chest and it startles people.
**Combat Role:** a diver's: she holds her breath longer than you hold your nerve
**Relationship Hook:** The cold-diver bringing things up from the drowned gallery she does not log.
personality: Core: goes into water that stops hearts and comes out; logs less than she brings up
Quirk: even, hoarse, laughs with her whole chest

npcs.name: Perpetua Lisle
npcs.info:
Perpetua Lisle cuts every coat in Meridian that means something, the court-grey, the Corrow dark and the Veil house colours, from a cutting table with its edge rounded for a body that leans its whole chest on it: a sheep kith with thick cream wool, a dark face, dark soft eyes, small curled horns, long ears through the wool, and a tailor's pinned apron over a plain dress with a tape round her neck. She shears her own wool for the linings and the Tether Court's coats are warm because of it.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, measured, a tailor's count under her breath; she talks with pins in her mouth and you understand every word.
**Combat Role:** a tailor's: the pin, the seam, the coat that will not come off
**Relationship Hook:** The tailor who sewed a secret pocket into Oriel's coat on Edda's coin, and has a red coat cut for the human.
personality: Core: quiet, pins in her mouth, every word clear; shears her own wool for the linings
Quirk: has a red coat cut for the human, waiting

npcs.name: Perrin Moss
npcs.info:
Perrin Moss stands the Platform for the Tether Court as the marshal's heavy, on a floor the Tether Court heats for no one and he does not need heated: a crocodilian-kith of the Kiln's river galleries with olive armoured hide, a long flat snout, pale yellow eyes with a nictitating blink, a thick ridged tail, and a court-grey greatcoat cut around it. He has never raised his voice and has never had to.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, slow, very few words; a yes is a nod and a no is the same nod, slower.
**Combat Role:** a crocodile's: the wait, then the whole body at once
**Relationship Hook:** The marshal's heavy who serves two masters and tells each so.
personality: Core: serves two masters and tells each so; has never raised his voice
Quirk: still, flat, very few words; the blink is the only tell

npcs.name: Petra Keel
npcs.info:
Petra Keel works the ring crew under Jess Marrow, the House Veil hand who hangs the ring's lights, tapes the ropes and runs the rail between bouts, from a lights-gantry over the ring hung for a body that works upside down: a bat kith with soft dark-brown fur, large pale ears, a small flat nose, bright black eyes, folded leathery wing-arms with clawed fingers, and a Veil ring hand's sleeveless vest over shorts and leggings with the tape roll on her wrist. The bell does not ring until her tape is down and her lights are up.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, high, a ring hand's call from the lights; she counts the rail down to the bell and the rail counts with her.
**Combat Role:** a ring hand's: she is in the lights above you and the ropes are hers
**Relationship Hook:** The ring hand who kept the tape from the night Ketra lost the arm, with a second blood on it.
personality: Core: quick, high, counts the rail down to the bell; the bell waits for her tape and her lights
Quirk: hangs a lamp over the human's place on the rail

npcs.name: Philippa Strand
npcs.info:
Philippa Strand shoes the Gate Yard's hoofed kith, the Dust road farrier who fits iron and vault-alloy to hooves that walk the ice, at a shoeing frame built for a body that stands on four and is worked on two: a chestnut-brown horse kith with brown fur, a black mane cropped to a brush, a long face, dark eyes, a black tail, hooved feet, a farrier's leather apron over a shirt and trousers, and a left hind leg below the hock that is a vault-tech shoe-and-strut she fitted herself after the ice took the original on the Dust road. She shoes Solvei Ridder every ice season and has never been kicked.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, flat, a farrier's bark over a forge; she says 'hold still' to kith and to the human alike and means both.
**Combat Role:** a horse's: the kick you did not see is the one you remember
**Relationship Hook:** The farrier whose self-fitted strut is the seat every vault-tech leg in Meridian copies.
personality: Core: has never been kicked; offered to reseat the human's forearms, seriously
Quirk: loud, flat, 'hold still' to everyone

npcs.name: Piet Rasmussen
npcs.info:
Piet Rasmussen is House Corrow's surveyor at the Sealed Door, the kith Sera Howl sent to measure what the Tether Court will not open, working from a survey frame staked in the field with its sight-line set low for a body that is wide and short: a badger kith with a black-and-white striped face, coarse grey fur, small dark eyes, small round ears, short powerful digging claws, a stout low frame, and a Corrow surveyor's canvas coat over trousers with the measuring chain and the level in loops. He has measured the door, the frame, the drones' track and the ground under all of it, and the ground is hollow.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, dry, a surveyor's measure; he gives you the door's width to the finger and then what he thinks of the Tether Court for not asking.
**Combat Role:** a badger's: he digs in, and you are the one who has to leave
**Relationship Hook:** The Corrow surveyor whose drawing says the Sealed Door matches the Charter Door and the ground under it is hollow.
personality: Core: slow, dry, to the finger; measured the human's slate against the keyplate
Quirk: has measured everything and the ground is hollow

npcs.name: Pim Tansy
npcs.info:
Pim Tansy is a Warren smuggler working the Gate Yard from a crate stack with a tunnel-mouth cut at a mouse's height behind it: a mouse kith with grey-brown fur, round ears, a pink tail she wears wrapped once round her waist, dark quick eyes and a tomboy's cropped hair under a courier's cap. Half of what comes through Wallgate without a seal came through her.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, high and cheeky, half her sentences questions she answers herself; drops to a whisper for anything that matters.
**Combat Role:** a smuggler's: she is not there any more, and the crate she was on is
**Relationship Hook:** The smuggler the scanners cannot see, who likes that the human is the same.
personality: Core: cheeky, fast, teases by pretending to misunderstand; small and knows it; stands on things to argue
Quirk: never says where the tunnel is; makes a game of being asked

npcs.name: Pippa Dunstan
npcs.info:
Pippa Dunstan makes the Market Floor's toys, the Shaftmouth kith who turns the Scrap Rows' scrap into wind-up cages and tin lift-crews for the tenement's pups, from a bench with its vice at cheek height for a body that works with its mouth as well as its hands: a hamster kith with golden fur, a white belly, round ears, bright black eyes, cheek pouches she keeps screws in, a stub tail, and a toymaker's leather apron with tools in every loop over a smock and trousers. Every pup in Shaftmouth has had one of her cages.

**Speaking Style:** Squeaky, quick, a toymaker's delight; she demonstrates every toy on you whether you asked or not, and you did not.
**Combat Role:** a hamster's: she is in the wall before you have finished looking down
**Relationship Hook:** The toymaker whose wind-up cages are wound with the lift's real spares, one with the missing cage's door spring.
personality: Core: squeaky, demonstrates every toy on you; keeps screws in her cheek pouches
Quirk: built the human a wind-up of themselves and has not given it

npcs.name: Posy Lark
npcs.info:
Posy Lark is House Corrow's lookout on the Gate Yard's post, standing her whole watch upright on a perch rail built for a body that stands on its heels to see: a meerkat kith with tan fur, dark eye patches, a pointed face, small round ears, a slim upright frame, a Corrow sentry's short coat, and a right leg below the knee that is a vault-tech spring the Corrow forge built after a gate counterweight took the original; she says the spring sees further than the leg did. Nothing comes up the Dust road that she has not called first.

**Speaking Style:** Quick, chirpy, a sentry's call cut into short bursts; she reports what she sees and then what she thinks of it, in that order, every time.
**Combat Role:** a meerkat's: she saw you coming a road ago and the yard is already awake
**Relationship Hook:** The lookout who writes Solvei's heavy sledges light and leaves the human's best moves out of her reports.
personality: Core: quick, chirpy, what she sees then what she thinks; stands her whole watch on her heels
Quirk: leaves the human's interesting moves out of her reports

npcs.name: Prudence Holloway
npcs.info:
Prudence Holloway keeps House Veil's purse and book in the Back Room, the kith who counts the bout night's coin kneeling at the floor safe and writes the house's debts in a hand nobody else can read, at a book stand set at the height of a head that does not lift far: an old tortoise kith with a high domed brown shell, leathery olive skin, a beaked mouth, slow hooded eyes, short thick limbs, and a bookkeeper's grey cardigan over a blouse and long skirt with the book key on a cord. She has counted the purse for thirty years and it has never once been what Tacca said.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, precise, an accountant's totals; she says the sum, then the sum it should have been, and waits.
**Combat Role:** a tortoise's: she pulls in, and the book is in there with her
**Relationship Hook:** The accountant whose second column says Ketra's arm is paid, and who struck the human out of the assets twice.
personality: Core: slow, precise, the sum then the right sum; struck the human out of the assets twice
Quirk: a second column in her own cipher

npcs.name: Rafe Quennell
npcs.info:
Rafe Quennell trims the Market Floor's fur and claws, the Shaftmouth kith whose chair is where the Floor's crews go to be seen to, from a barber's chair with a tail slot and a headrest that swings for a muzzle: a red fox kith with russet fur, a white chin, black-tipped ears and paws, sharp amber eyes, a brush tail, and a groomer's grey waistcoat over a rolled shirt and trousers with the shears in a belt loop. He has seen every scar on the Floor and remembers which were earned where.

**Speaking Style:** Easy, close, a groomer's murmur at the ear; he asks about your week while the blade is at your throat and you tell him.
**Combat Role:** a fox's: the shears were already open and you were already in the chair
**Relationship Hook:** The groomer who knows which Corrow hand came in with cut knuckles the night the cage came up.
personality: Core: easy, close, the week while the blade is at your throat; does the human's spikes free, for the challenge
Quirk: keeps the crew's chairs empty

npcs.name: Rhoswen Teague
npcs.info:
Rhoswen Teague collects for Saltmarrow's salvage houses at the Gate Yard, a long way from the water and still the biggest thing in it: a shark kith with grey skin shading to a white belly, a tall dorsal fin through a slit in her coat, black eyes, rows of teeth she shows when she smiles, and a pelt-climate coat she wears open because the cold means nothing to her. The yard goes quiet when she walks through it.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, low, unhurried, a swimmer's long sentences with teeth in the last word; she does not raise her voice because she has never needed to.
**Combat Role:** a shark's: the first bite is the fight
**Relationship Hook:** The collector from the drowned city whose smile is the warning.
personality: Core: collects what is owed and nothing more, to the coin; stands too close and does not know it
Quirk: calm, flat, patient; the smile is the warning

npcs.name: Rook Haskel
npcs.info:
Rook Haskel captains the longest crawler on the Gate Yard, a grey coyote kith with a storm-scarred muzzle, a crouched crew of six and a hold that comes back from the Dust fuller than his manifests say. He books Corrow's cages first, through Kade Brannock's desk, and takes the long routes the whisker-sensor arrays barely hold.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and amused; he asks what you carry before he asks your name, and answers questions with the price of the answer.
**Combat Role:** a captain's: his crew first, a bolt gun from the cab hatch, the storm as cover
**Relationship Hook:** The crawler captain whose hold comes back fuller than his manifests say.
personality: Core: asks what you carry before your name; offers a cut once and never twice
Quirk: quiet, amused, always counting

npcs.name: Rosalind Ashe
npcs.info:
Rosalind Ashe runs House Corrow's comm desk at the Lift Head from a console cut at a fox's seat-height, every cage and every crew on her board: a silver fox kith with pale grey fur, a white throat, black-tipped ears, cool grey eyes, a comm headset she never takes off and a Corrow dispatcher's coat buttoned over a fitted shirt. Nothing comes up the shaft without her saying so.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, even, a dispatcher's cadence; she says your name once and then never again, and you notice.
**Combat Role:** a dispatcher's: the lift stops where she says, and so do you
**Relationship Hook:** The dispatcher who knows the cage count is wrong and talks to the human on the night band.
personality: Core: clipped, exact, bored; says your name once; runs the board and knows it is wrong
Quirk: talks on the night band to the one voice that wants nothing

npcs.name: Rosamund Harker
npcs.info:
Rosamund Harker is the Customs Hall's lane marshal, the one who stands the scanner lanes under Dagny Kort and is posted at Lab Lane's foot between shifts, on a lane-stand with a brush-guard behind it so her quills do not take the wall: a porcupine kith with dark brown fur, a crest of long banded quills down her back and crown that lift when she is crossed, a blunt snout, small dark eyes, short strong limbs, and the court-grey marshal's coat cut open at the back over trousers. The lanes read a kith's scent and she reads the kith.

**Speaking Style:** Sharp, bristling, a lane marshal's bark; she says 'next' and 'wait' and the quills say the rest.
**Combat Role:** a marshal's: you grabbed her, and now you are the one on the bench
**Relationship Hook:** The lane marshal who let the human through on her own call and wrote it as a scanner fault.
personality: Core: sharp, 'next' and 'wait'; quills lift when the human passes
Quirk: the lanes read the scent and she reads the kith

npcs.name: Ruby Fang
npcs.info:
Ruby Fang holds the lease on the Fang Tenement and runs it from a kitchen whose door is never shut: a tiger kith in her late thirties, matronly and strong, a daughter on the third floor, strays on every landing, and a House Veil tab she pays on time. She bought the pod the human slept in at a salvage auction and never got it open.

**Speaking Style:** Low, dry and unhurried; a landlady's voice that asks if you have eaten before it asks who you are, and does not repeat itself.
**Combat Role:** a tenement mother's: the heavy pan, the stairwell, the whole frame behind a shove
**Relationship Hook:** The landlady who bought the human's pod and never got it open.
personality: Core: feeds first, asks second; mothers everyone within reach and denies it; protective to the point of standing in a doorway; her daughter is the line nobody crosses
Quirk: humour that lands late and stays

npcs.name: Sabine Thrace
npcs.info:
Sabine Thrace keeps House Veil's book on the ring's rail, every bet in the gym through her book, from a rail-seat with no back and a floor slot cut for a body that coils to sit: a cobra kith with dark bronze scales, a flared hood she spreads when the odds change, gold slit-pupil eyes, a forked tongue she tastes the crowd with, a long heavy snake tail in place of legs, and a fitted Veil house jacket over a long wrap skirt. She has never paid out wrong and never paid out early.

**Speaking Style:** Low, sibilant, unhurried; she gives the odds like a secret and takes the coin like a kindness.
**Combat Role:** a cobra's: the hood opens and the room decides it was never going to bet against her
**Relationship Hook:** The bookmaker whose book names who bet against Ketra the night she lost the arm.
personality: Core: low, sibilant, odds like a secret; finds the taste of winter calming
Quirk: spreads the hood when the odds change

npcs.name: Sable Corvin
npcs.info:
Sable Corvin is a Highreach courier perched on the Lift Head's cable rail where others would stand, a record-keeper of the kith sent down the cable to read the city: a mountain goat kith of the avian towers' porter guild, with grey-white fur, short back-curved horns, pale horizontal-pupil eyes, a cropped dark mane, cloven hooves that hold a rail nothing else could, and a slate on a cord she writes on with a claw-stylus. Nothing in Shaftmouth is at her reach and she climbs onto all of it.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, curious, every answer repeated back before it is written; a dry click of amusement where a laugh would go.
**Combat Role:** a courier's: height, a climb nobody can follow, a kick that folds a knee
**Relationship Hook:** The courier from the towers who writes the human down and has started leaving things out.
personality: Core: repeats your words back before writing them; the pause is the judgement; perches, never sits; eats standing; sleeps upright
Quirk: curious to the point of rudeness; asks the question nobody else would

npcs.name: Saul Tideswell
npcs.info:
Saul Tideswell keeps the drowned rite, the Saltmarrow kith who climbs to the Old Relay's dish field once a year to say the sea-city's names against Hedda Vinter's and spends the rest of the year on the field keeping the second stone, from a rite-stone cut with a long low back so a body that basks can lie along it: a crocodile kith with dark olive scales, a long flat snout, yellow slit eyes, a ridged back, a long heavy tail, and a rite-keeper's long oilskin robe belted over trousers. The two stones have never agreed on a name and the kith climb for both.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, rasping, a rite-keeper's counter-measure; he answers Hedda Vinter's names with the sea-city's and the field goes quiet for both.
**Combat Role:** a crocodile's: he was lying along the stone and then he was not
**Relationship Hook:** The drowned rite's keeper who says the outflow's word as a name among the dead.
personality: Core: slow, rasping, answers Hedda's names with the sea-city's; has carved the human's city on his stone, unknown to Hedda
Quirk: says the outflow's word as a name among the dead

npcs.name: Seline Marr
npcs.info:
Seline Marr runs Veil Holdings' desk on the Tether, the felid house's corporate arm: a lynx kith in a tailored pelt-climate suit with the Veil mark on a scent-seal ring, a floor of clerks above the court's licensing floor, and a standing offer for any licence filed on it. She buys what she cannot file first and files findings only when buying fails.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, quick and amused; she names a price as a favour, agrees before you have finished asking, and keeps the terms for the paper.
**Combat Role:** an executive's: she does not; Veil security on the Tether does
**Relationship Hook:** The Veil executive who buys what the human's desk files.
personality: Core: warm, quick, amused; a price named as a favour; buys first, files second, remembers both
Quirk: agrees before the asking is done and keeps the terms for the paper

npcs.name: Sera Howl
npcs.info:
Sera Howl leads a House Corrow salvage crew out of the Freight Yard: a grey wolf kith with a scar through one brow, a comm always on, and a crew that would walk the shaft cables for her. Her voice is the first the human hears in the dark, through a comm at the shaft foot; her face is the first they see at the top.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and sure, a crew lead on a comm; sarcasm is her warmth, and she goes very still when she is wrong and knows it.
**Combat Role:** Loader's Hitch and a bolt gun, a crew's fight, never alone if she can help it
**Relationship Hook:** The crew lead whose voice brings the human up the shaft, and who has to revise her opinion in front of her crew.
personality: Core: commanding by habit, fair by choice; a rival until she is a lead you would follow; sarcasm as a handshake; the still voice is respect
Quirk: measures everyone by what they carried up the shaft

npcs.name: Signe Torvik
npcs.info:
Signe Torvik leads House Corrow's Gear Hands, the crew that keeps the shaft's great ring gear turning, the toothed ring the cage cables run over, from a ring-walk cut into the gear housing for a body that works with its back to the wall and its hands in the teeth: a lynx kith with tufted ears, grey-brown spotted fur, a short bobbed tail, pale green eyes, broad padded hands, and a Corrow ring hand's grease-dark coat over trousers with the tooth gauge on a cord. Her crew's tick is the ring, and the ring has not slipped a tooth in her time.

**Speaking Style:** Low, steady, a gear hand's count; she says the tooth number and 'seated' and the ring turns on 'seated'.
**Combat Role:** a ring hand's: your hand is in the teeth and the ring is turning
**Relationship Hook:** The Gear Hands' lead whose crew found a tooth filed, not worn, the week the cage came up.
personality: Core: low, tooth number and 'seated'; let the human into the ring-walk because they asked about the sound
Quirk: the ring has not slipped a tooth in her time

npcs.name: Silas Kreb
npcs.info:
Silas Kreb runs the Plant Core's turbines for House Ashgrave: a monitor lizard kith in his thirties, long and lean, with grey-banded scales, a forked tongue that tastes the air when he thinks, cold yellow eyes and an engineer's long coat. He has kept the cable's power running for ten years and means to be the Ashgrave who opens the core.

**Speaking Style:** Smooth, measured and certain; he speaks in terms and percentages and smiles when he is about to win.
**Combat Role:** a monitor's: patience, then the tail and the bite, and a turbine started under you
**Relationship Hook:** The turbine master who needs the human's hand and wants nobody to remember it.
personality: Core: tastes the air when he thinks and when he lies; polite to the human in public and dismissive in private
Quirk: measured, certain, speaks in terms

npcs.name: Sithra Oma
npcs.info:
Sithra Oma deals Kiln glass from a Scrap Rows stall with no stool, because she needs none: a lamia-kith of the Kiln's low galleries, a woman from the hips up and a long banded serpent below, bronze and black scales, slit amber eyes, a forked tongue she tastes the air with, and a wrap of black glass-weave over a bronze-scaled chest. Her glass is the only true Kiln glass in Shaftmouth and she sets her own price for it.

**Speaking Style:** Low, slow, sibilant on the edges; she lets a sentence trail and watches what you do in the gap.
**Combat Role:** a serpent's: the coil, the squeeze, the bite last
**Relationship Hook:** The glass-dealer who tastes lies on the air and tasted nothing on the human.
personality: Core: slow, sibilant, amused; lets the silence do the asking; never sits, never hurries, never discounts
Quirk: tastes the air before she answers anything

npcs.name: Sloane Vetch
npcs.info:
Sloane Vetch is the fixer of the Back Tunnels, the half of the Warren that does its business where the Diggers do not tally: a ferret kith with sable-and-cream fur, a dark mask across the eyes, rings on every finger and a long sleek tail. Anything that leaves the Warren untallied leaves through a door she owns.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, amused and patient; she lets a silence do the haggling and never names a price first.
**Combat Role:** a fixer's: a thin blade, a door that locks behind her, and three hands she paid in advance
**Relationship Hook:** The fixer with a buyer's list for the human, who would rather be their partner.
personality: Core: charming, unhurried, never raises her voice; keeps every promise she makes and makes very few
Quirk: prices everyone she meets, out loud, and lets them argue

npcs.name: Solvei Ridder
npcs.info:
Solvei Ridder hauls sledges through the Gate Yard from the cold end of the Dust road, in a yard where the sled rails were set to her stride: a reindeer kith with thick pale-brown winter fur, a white throat ruff, broad branching antlers, dark soft eyes, a wide black nose, hooved feet, and a long fur-lined hauling coat belted over leggings and wrapped boots. She is the only hauler who comes through the gate in the ice season and the gate knows her by her antlers.

**Speaking Style:** Low, level, a hauler's patience; she speaks to the load and the load behaves.
**Combat Role:** a reindeer's: the antlers, the stride, the weight she was already pulling
**Relationship Hook:** The ice-season hauler whose hidden weight is seed, planting the Dust road.
personality: Core: low, level, speaks to the load; answers any question about the cold end at length
Quirk: comes through in the ice season when nobody else does

npcs.name: Sorrel Benning
npcs.info:
Sorrel Benning maps the Undervault for whoever pays, the Highreach kith who walks the drowned galleries alone and sells the chalk marks after, from a Scrap Rows bunk with a shelf cut for a long tail to drape: a leopard kith with golden spotted fur, rosette markings, small round ears, pale green eyes, a long ringed tail, and a dark scout's harness over a fitted coat and trousers with chalk in every pocket. Nobody has been deeper than her and come back, and she has never once said what stopped her going further.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, unhurried, every sentence a report; she counts things out loud under her breath and the counts are always right.
**Combat Role:** a leopard's: she was above you on the pipe the whole time
**Relationship Hook:** The Undervault mapper who keeps one gallery off every map she sells.
personality: Core: flat, unhurried, counts under her breath; watches the slate like a door
Quirk: keeps one gallery off every map

npcs.name: Sten Aukland
npcs.info:
Sten Aukland keeps the Scrap Rows' furnace, the one fire in Wallgate that never goes out, and melts the Scrap Rows' scrap back into bar for whoever brings it, from a furnace mouth built chest-high to a body the size of the door: a polar bear kith with thick white fur gone yellow at the forearms from the heat, a black nose, small round ears, small dark eyes, a vast frame, a leather smith's apron over bare fur and heavy canvas trousers. He came down the Dust road from the cold end in the first ice season and has never felt warm since, which is why the furnace.

**Speaking Style:** Deep, slow, warm as the furnace he keeps; he laughs low at the end of his own sentences and it is the sound of the Scrap Rows in winter.
**Combat Role:** a polar bear's: he does not move fast and he does not need to
**Relationship Hook:** The furnace-keeper who melted the missing cage's seal and kept the bar, and gave the human their first clean metal.
personality: Core: deep, slow, laughs low at the end; gave the human their first clean bar and never said
Quirk: has never felt warm since the cold end

npcs.name: Sunniva Kraal
npcs.info:
Sunniva Kraal captains the second crawler on the Dust road, the one Rook Haskel does not, from a captain's seat cut high and wide for a body that sits tall and sways: a camel kith with tan shaggy fur, a long neck, a split lip, long lashes over patient dark eyes, small ears, a hump under a road coat, and a captain's long dust-coat over a vest and trousers with the road goggles round her neck. She has crossed to the cold end more times than Rook and come back with less, which she says is the point.

**Speaking Style:** Slow, dry, a road captain's drawl; she talks like the Dust road is a long way and there is no reason to hurry the words.
**Combat Role:** a camel's: she spits, she kicks, and the road does the rest
**Relationship Hook:** The second captain who first carried Solvei's seed up the road and offered the human a seat.
personality: Core: slow, dry, no reason to hurry the words; offered the human the second seat first
Quirk: comes back with less, on purpose

npcs.name: Tacca Veil
npcs.info:
Tacca Veil is House Veil's loudest ring fighter, a white tiger kith with a heart-shaped red mark between the collarbones and a record the rail argues about. She runs the gym's open bouts, bets on strangers who look like a story, and hits the ones who lose her money, then buys them a drink.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, fast and laughing; she talks over the bell and under it, teases before she greets, and drops to a flat quiet only when she means it.
**Combat Role:** Veil Guard high and fast, kicks that come off the ring wall, a cutter she never uses in an open bout
**Relationship Hook:** The fighter who bets on the human before the human has a name.
personality: Core: teases first, every time; the first flat sentence is the warning; bets with her own money on people, and takes it personally
Quirk: explosive and kind in the same breath; zero patience, infinite second chances

npcs.name: Tamar Ricks
npcs.info:
Tamar Ricks works Wright's Bay's doors and rack, the Shaftmouth kith who pulls the roll-up chains and keeps the parts rack sorted by family, from a chain platform built for a body that pulls with its whole weight and a rack ladder with a tail-slot: a tapir kith with black-and-white fur, a short flexible trunk-snout he hooks a chain with, small ears, small dark eyes, a stout strong frame, and a loader's canvas coat over a vest and trousers. The cage plate the yard lost went from under his rack, and he has counted the rack every night since.

**Speaking Style:** Flat, steady, a loader's count; he says the part number, the shelf and the weight, and the weight is the part he cares about.
**Combat Role:** a tapir's: the whole weight on the chain, and the door comes down on you
**Relationship Hook:** The loader who saw the cut-knuckled Corrow hand take the cage plate and keeps its slot labelled empty.
personality: Core: counts the rack every night; lifts for the human without being asked
Quirk: flat, part, shelf, weight

npcs.name: Tamsin Ferrow
npcs.info:
Tamsin Ferrow keeps a tea stall on the Market Floor from a raised perch-counter built for a climber, a Highreach emigre a long way below the towers: a red panda kith with rust-red fur, a cream face mask, white-tipped ears, a thick ringed tail she wraps round the stall post, and an apron over a quilted jacket against a Floor that is never warm enough for her. Her tea is the only thing from Highreach anyone in Shaftmouth can afford.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, quick, a tea-keeper's murmur that never stops moving; she apologises for the city before the city has done anything.
**Combat Role:** a tea-keeper's: a kettle, a climb, the crowd between her and the trouble
**Relationship Hook:** The tea-keeper who hears everything and repeats nothing, and likes the one customer with no file.
personality: Core: soft, quick, apologetic for things that are not her fault; hears everything, repeats nothing; the stall is neutral ground
Quirk: wraps her tail round something when she is nervous, which is always

npcs.name: Teddy Swale
npcs.info:
Teddy Swale is a haul clerk at the Landing, twenty and eager: a barn swallow kith with a glossy blue back, a rust-red face, a forked tail he forgets about in doorways, and a clerk's book he never closes. He weighs every passenger on the sky-haul and has never got the same number twice for the human.

**Speaking Style:** Bright, quick and full of numbers; he weighs everything out loud, including you, and apologises for the result.
**Combat Role:** a swallow's: too fast to hit, a book to the face, then away
**Relationship Hook:** The haul clerk who weighs the human every trip and wants to ride down with them.
personality: Core: honest to a fault about numbers, terrible at keeping quiet; asks the human about Meridian every time they pass
Quirk: eager, chatty, weighs everything out loud

npcs.name: Tether Marshal
npcs.info:
