items.info: A blank Founder keycard the spine can write one door's code onto, once.

items.name: Body Feed
items.info: Feed, body: fitted, the implant draws on your own blood sugar: never dry, always slower, and you eat for two. 35 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Bolt Housing
items.info: Housing, bolt: fitted, the forearm throws a finger-long bolt the feed makes, a yard's width and quiet. 85 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Boss Badge
items.info: A lift boss's badge.

items.name: Braided Filament
items.info: Filament, braided: fitted, the wire holds a hanging weight and never cuts what it binds. 26 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Braided-Wire Tentacle (crated)
items.info: The Braided-Wire Tentacle in its crate, a tentacle of vault-tech, Ilse Varga's precision work: a coil round a rail, a lever out of reach, a pocket across a table, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 35. 300 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Brass Loupe Eye (crated)
items.info: The Brass Loupe Eye in its crate, an eye of vault-tech, Ilse Varga's precision work: a seal, a stamp or a part number read at a glance, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 15. 240 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Burst Mechanism
items.info: Mechanism, three-round burst: fitted, the rifle fires in threes. 45 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Business Licence
items.info: A Tether Court licence to trade on the station, filed under seal and print from the human's own desk; a Tether landlord reads it and lowers the lease. Found, never sold: The Floor.

items.name: Cage Slip
items.info: A booked cage slot on Corrow's boards, a scent-sealed slip of claw-text; the stock a freight desk lives on. 36 Credits, sold at Sera Howl at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Sera Howl at the Freight Yard

items.name: Cage-Runner Prototype
items.info: The Cage-Runner Prototype, a ride with a mind of its own it calls Runner: fast, proud, keeps a grudge; its one line comes up as text on its panel glass when spoken to; it keeps its counsel otherwise. Mounted it is the party's speed and 90 of armor; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: House Corrow's cage on the Gate Yard, the house's own.
items.where: House Corrow's cage on the Gate Yard, the house's own

items.name: Capacitor Feed
items.info: Feed, capacitor: fitted, the implant stores one big discharge and needs a turn to fill again. 60 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Carbon Spine
items.info: Spine, carbon: fitted, the blade is light, quick and whippy in a parry. 30 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Cell Feed
items.info: Feed, cell: fitted, the implant runs off a panel cell under the skin, strong and warm, and runs dry in a long fight. 40 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Chalk Bag
items.info: Chalk for the pads on a wet day; a dusted pad holds on glass.

items.name: Claw Stylus
items.info: A stylus cast for a claw, for the raised claw-text on every control face; a human holds it like a pen and reads the text by touch. 4 Credits, sold at any Market Floor stall.

items.name: Clerk's Seal
items.info: A clerk's seal for the day's filings.
items.where: Clerk of Record, The Tether Court

items.name: Climbing Hook
items.info: A folding hook on a cord for the rails the gyro keeps you level on.

items.name: Clockwork Talon (crated)
items.info: The Clockwork Talon in its crate, an arm of vault-tech, House Veil's cosmetic work: a fast raking strike, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 25. 260 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Clot Gel
items.info: A tube of the weave's own gel: smeared on a wound, it seals it in a breath.

items.name: Coded Grip
items.info: Grip, coded: fitted, the hilt locks dead in any hand but the one it was keyed to. 46 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Comm Bead
items.info: An ear bead on the city's open comm band: every crew lead, stall-holder and lift clerk is one call away.

items.name: Contact Book
items.info: Every name the vault keeps, written out by hand for the day it fails.

items.name: Contender's Tape
items.info: Ring tape in house colours.

items.name: Coolant Flask
items.info: A sealed flask of the core's own coolant: a swallow breaks a fever or a heatstroke.

items.name: Cooling Spray
items.info: A spray for the fins on a hot day when the sinks cannot dump it fast enough.

items.name: Copper-Plate Hand (crated)
items.info: The Copper-Plate Hand in its crate, a hand of vault-tech, Ilse Varga's precision work: a panel coaxed, a fine fitting done, a lock felt out, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 15. 230 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Corner Key
items.info: A key to the corners and the medic bench.

items.name: Corrow Crawler Note
items.info: The scent-sealed Corrow note for a Dust skiff with a human palm print beside the seal; the first crawler on the road with a human at the sticks. Found, never sold: The Skiff.

items.name: Courier's Satchel
items.info: A sealed satchel with the Roost's mark: its holder carries for the clan.

items.name: Court Bond
items.info: The Tether Court's bond for one registered desk with a human palm print beside the court's scent seal; the first registration the court has ever issued to an unscented name. Found, never sold: The Desk.

items.name: Court Docket
items.info: A scent-sealed docket of licence applications off the Tether Court's registry, a stack of claw-text forms a desk works through by touch; the work a registered desk lives on. 50 Credits, sold at the court registry at the Customs Hall (Orla Venn's desk, by comm).
items.where: the court registry at the Customs Hall (Orla Venn's desk, by comm)

items.name: Court Gate Licence
items.info: A Tether Court licence to carry arms through a gate of Meridian, filed under seal and print from the human's own desk; Bram Tolliver's bay reads it and opens the refit sooner. Found, never sold: The Floor.

items.name: Credits
items.info: Meridian's money, carried on a chip or a house tab. Credits buy air, food, a bunk, a lift fare and a stranger's time.

items.name: Crew Knot
items.info: A lashing knot on a cord: its holder's claim on a haul is honoured.

items.name: Cutter
items.info: A hand cutter off a scrap row: a short powered edge in a taped grip, built to open crates and used on everything. 10 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Cutting Filament
items.info: Filament, cutting: fitted, the wire parts rope, strap and flesh wherever it draws tight. 60 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Damper Cells
items.info: Two spare cells for the ankle dampers; a dead one makes a hard landing.

items.name: Damper Fob
items.info: A fob that turns the damper up for a fight and down for the bench.

items.name: Deed Key
items.info: A key to the Deed Wall's frames: its holder may read any deed.

items.name: Detox Tablets
items.info: Tablets that help the filter through a night that would poison anyone.

items.name: Disguise Kit
items.info: Hair dye, tinted lenses and notes for three faces the mesh can hold.

items.name: Diver's Knife
items.info: A dive knife with a crew's knot carved in the grip.

items.name: Drop Line
items.info: A courier's rope, scent-marked, cut to the Steps' length.

items.name: Drover's Hook
items.info: A drover's hook with a family's mark burned into the haft.

items.name: Dust Manifest
items.info: A scent-sealed Corrow manifest for one crawler hold of Dust freight, a stamped claw-text slip off Sera Howl's slate that is read by touch; the cargo a crawler lives on. 45 Credits, sold at the dispatch slate at the Gate Yard berth (Sera Howl's dispatch, by comm).
items.where: the dispatch slate at the Gate Yard berth (Sera Howl's dispatch, by comm)

items.name: Dust Skimmer
items.info: The Dust Skimmer, a ride with a mind of its own it calls Skim: quiet, patient, counts what it is owed; its one line comes up as text on its panel glass when spoken to; it keeps its counsel otherwise. Mounted it is the party's speed and 60 of armor; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: a wreck in the Scrap Rows, Bram's pit once it runs.
items.where: a wreck in the Scrap Rows, Bram's pit once it runs

items.name: Elder's Lantern
items.info: A small lantern from the Long Hall's end: its holder sits with the elders.

items.name: Family Tally
items.info: A family's tally cord: its holder walks with that family.

items.name: Fever Strips
items.info: Strips that read and cool a fever before the damper has to fight it.

items.name: Filter Cartridges
items.info: Spare cartridges for the chest filter; a fresh one clears a bad room's air for a day.

items.name: Flare Muzzle
items.info: Muzzle, flare: fitted, every shot throws a white flash into the eyes of whatever it faces. 26 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Flex Nerve
items.info: Nerve, flex: fitted, the implant fires on a set flex of the wrist; sure, slow, never by accident. 45 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Folding Spine
items.info: Spine, folding: fitted, the blade folds into the hilt and snaps out on a flick of the wrist. 34 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Folding Stock
items.info: Stock, folding: fitted, the rifle stows under a coat and jumps on the shot. 25 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Founder Board
items.info: A crate of dead Founder control boards off the Undervault's walls; the stock a repair bench lives on. 30 Credits, sold at Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Founder Cutter Hilt
items.info: A Founder-make cutter hilt with four empty fittings: the edge, the spine behind it, the grip and the charge cell in the pommel. What it cuts is what is fitted to it. 90 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Founder Keycard
items.info: A Founder keycard with no port in the city that reads it; collectors on the Tether pay for the pattern. Found, never sold: The Deep Gallery.

items.name: Founder Memory Chip
items.info: A Founder memory chip the lattice can read: a map, a manual, a list of names, whatever was left on it.

items.name: Founder Port
items.info: A Founder-make port a surgeon sets into the forearm, with three empty fittings under the skin: a housing for what comes out, a feed for what drives it and a nerve for what fires it. It is a weapon only once all of it is in. 150 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Founder Rifle Frame
items.info: A Founder-make rifle frame with six empty fittings for a barrel, a muzzle, a core, a cartridge, a stock and a firing mechanism. What it does is what is fitted to it. 120 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Founder Service Slate
items.info: A dead Founder service slate off the Pod Hall's rail, the screen the maintenance crew read the gallery's systems on. Mounted on a forearm it holds codes a lock can read, and never a scent. Found, never sold: the Pod Hall's manipulator rail (J's pod locker).
items.where: the Pod Hall's manipulator rail (J's pod locker)

items.name: Founder Wire Rig
items.info: A Founder-make wire rig worn on the forearm, with three empty fittings: a spool at the wrist, the filament it carries and an anchor on the filament's end. It throws what is fitted to it. 100 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Gaff-Hook Hand (crated)
items.info: The Gaff-Hook Hand in its crate, a hand of vault-tech, the Corrow forge's heavy work: hook a crate, a rail or a collar and pull, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 15. 150 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Gate Permit
items.info: Brandy Vane's gun-deck permit for one crawler, stamped at Wallgate's gate in claw-text; a human's name on it is a line her log has never carried. Found, never sold: The Hauler.

items.name: Gate Token
items.info: A black glass token stamped at the Vent Gate: its holder may cross the walkways.

items.name: Glare Visor
items.info: A visor that keeps glare and grit off the tracking eye. 6 Credits, sold at any Market Floor stall.

items.name: Glass Seal
items.info: A small black glass seal: its holder's word on a tithe is taken.

items.name: Glow Sticks
items.info: Sticks that glow a colour the lenses read and nobody else sees.

items.name: Grip Soles
items.info: Soft boots with grip soles for cable runs and shaft walls. 25 Credits, sold at the Freight Yard.

items.name: Grip Trainer
items.info: A sprung trainer that keeps the reinforced tendons from stiffening.

items.name: Grooming Kit
items.info: Combs, oils and a scent-neutral soap from a Market Floor grooming stall; sold to the human as a joke the first time, and bought. 6 Credits, sold at any grooming stall.

items.name: Guard Nerve
items.info: Nerve, guard: fitted, the implant fires on its own when something reaches for you. 70 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Guest Lamp
items.info: A lamp on a cord: the Warren lights a guest's way and marks their scent on the turnings.

items.name: Gyro Calibrator
items.info: A puck that re-levels the wrist gyro after a fall.

items.name: Hand Chip
items.info: A yard chip that opens the loading floors.

items.name: Hand Spool
items.info: Spool, hand: fitted, the wire pays out silent and far and comes back only by hand. 14 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Hand's Breather
items.info: A breather mask re-cut for the wearer's face, with the Air Works' mark.

items.name: Harbour Chit
items.info: A wooden chit stamped at the Lantern Deck: its holder may tie up and trade.

items.name: Hearth Pin
items.info: A copper pin from the Hearth Yard: its holder sits at the fire.
items.where: Guest of the Hearth, House Draska

items.name: Heavy Cartridge
items.info: Cartridge, heavy: fitted, six rounds that hit like a hammer. 20 Credits, sold at the Freight Yard.

items.name: Heavy Stock

items.name: Hook Anchor
items.info: Anchor, hook: fitted, the wire's end is a four-pronged hook that bites stone, wood and ledge. 24 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Hooked Edge
items.info: Edge, hooked: fitted, the blade catches a weapon, a strap or a rail and pulls it. 26 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: House Glove
items.info: A taped glove with the Veil's mark.

items.name: Hydraulic Forearm (crated)
items.info: The Hydraulic Forearm in its crate, an arm of vault-tech, the Corrow forge's heavy work: crush, hold or lift what a hand cannot, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 25. 140 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Jack Cable
items.info: A coil of Founder data cable with the jack's own plug on one end and a clamp for any panel on the other.

items.name: Justice's Signet

items.where: Justice of the Charter, The Tether Court

items.name: Kinetic Core
