items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Knuckle Wraps
items.info: Wraps that keep the plates from cutting the hand that throws them. 6 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow at Veil Gym.

items.name: Landing Pass
items.info: A haul token stamped at the Landing: the sky-haul takes its holder up.

items.name: Lift-Actuator Leg (crated)
items.info: The Lift-Actuator Leg in its crate, a leg of vault-tech, the Corrow forge's heavy work: a kick that moves a crate, a door or a man, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 30. 180 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Line Tap Clip
items.info: A clip that taps a lift's or a crawler's comm line straight into the bead.

items.name: Live Filament
items.info: Filament, live: fitted, the wire carries a charge that jolts whatever it wraps. 58 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Live Wire Probe
items.info: A probe for the wires the fingertips cannot reach.

items.name: Loader Frame
items.info: A Founder cargo exo a head and a half over a human: hydraulic legs, two lifting arms, a cradle to stand in. A mounted frame is the party's weight and shield; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: the gallery's freight rail (The Rig).

items.name: Loader's Harness
items.info: A freight harness with the Corrow mark.

items.name: Lockpick Set
items.info: Picks the magnets can hold steady in a lock while you work it.

items.name: Long Rifled Barrel
items.info: Barrel, long rifled: fitted, the rifle reaches far and swings slow. 40 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Lozenge Tin
items.info: Lozenges that stop the resonator buzzing through a long talk.

items.name: Mag Anchor
items.info: Anchor, mag: fitted, the wire sticks to plate, rail and hull and lets go on a word. 42 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Mantis Forearm (crated)
items.info: The Mantis Forearm in its crate, an arm of vault-tech, Ilse Varga's precision work: the folded claws unfold for one cut, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 25. 320 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Mantis Housing
items.info: Housing, mantis: fitted, two folding Founder-steel claws lie along the forearm and scissor out and shut on the nerve's word, a mantis's strike. 95 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Marked Deck
items.info: A marked deck: the damper keeps the face, the deck does the rest.

items.name: Medic Kit
items.info: A ringside medic kit cast for claws: tape, clamps, a sealant gun; the stock a corner lives on. 28 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow at Veil Gym.

items.name: Metal Strut (crated)
items.info: The Metal Strut in its crate, a leg of vault-tech, the Corrow forge's heavy work: stand through a shove, hold a door shut, carry a load up the stairs, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 20. 120 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Monomolecular Edge
items.info: Edge, monomolecular: fitted, the blade opens plate like cloth and chips on bone. 55 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Mood Log
items.info: A pocket book of every room the gland has read, and who in it was lying.

items.name: Muzzle Brake
items.info: Muzzle, brake: fitted, the kick is tamed and the report is loud. 18 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Muzzle Mask
items.info: An air-can mask cast for a muzzle; a human has to hold it to their face with both hands, which every crew notices. 5 Credits, sold at the Freight Yard.

items.name: Needle Cartridge
items.info: Cartridge, needle: fitted, forty flechettes that tear cloth and skip off plate. 22 Credits, sold at the Freight Yard.

items.name: Nerve Tonic
items.info: A tonic that stops the rewired nerve twitching when there is nothing to shoot.

items.name: Panel Cell
items.info: A Founder panel cell, dead until a human hand or a current tester wakes it; a bench sells them woken. 12 Credits, sold at Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Patchwork Rig
items.info: A rig welded from a Founder cradle's legs, crawler hydraulics and scrap-row plate, the tallest and loudest frame on the street. A mounted frame hits like a cage dropping; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: built by hand (The Rig).

items.name: Petitioner's Slip
items.info: A registry slip that lets its holder file at the court.

items.name: Pin Map Book
items.info: A book of every lock the reader has heard open, pin by pin.

items.name: Plasma Core
items.info: Core, plasma: fitted, the rifle fires a white bolt that burns through plate. 60 Credits, sold at Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Plate Sealant
items.info: A spray that seals a cracked plate until a surgeon can look at it.

items.name: Plated Arm (crated)
items.info: The Plated Arm in its crate, an arm of vault-tech, House Veil's cosmetic work: take a blow on the plates, turn a blade, shoulder a door, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 25. 160 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Pocket Rangefinder
items.info: A rangefinder to check the lens against when the numbers drift.

items.name: Pod Memory: Aegis
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Aegis in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Stand Down: For the scene the machines about to hurt you hesitate: a drone holds a breath, a turret tracks past you, a closing door slows, a chance for you and yours to get clear. at 20, On Your Side: You turn the machines of the place to your side for the scene: drones cover you, doors seal behind you, turrets face the other way, and whoever walks with you is theirs to protect. at 30, Every Machine: Once a day every machine in the district keeps you and yours alive for one long scene: nothing automated harms you, every old defence stands between you and the blow, and the doors of the city close on whoever hunts you. Afterwards the machines go quiet for you for a day. With Sanctuary Right in you it becomes The Machines on Your Side. Take the Aegis's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Anchor
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Anchor in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Rooted: For the scene your feet are part of the floor: a shove, a pull or a drag has to beat the ground to move you, and what you hold is hard to take. at 20, The Ground Holds: You put the ground's grip into whatever you touch for the scene: a cart, a gate, a friend, a falling body; what you anchor does not move, and what moves against it stops. at 30, The City's Weight: Once a day the ground under a whole block answers you for one long scene: nothing you choose moves, nothing you deny gets in, and a crawler that drives at you stops as if it hit a wall. Your knees are gone for the rest of the day. With Militia Writ in you it becomes The Weight in the Feet. Take the Anchor's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Assembler
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Assembler in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Clicks Home: For the scene the parts of whatever you work on know where they go: a repair goes quicker than it should, a jam clears at a touch, and a thing you build wants to run. at 20, The Old Makers: You ask a Founder fabricator, bench or press for a thing and it builds it for you in the scene from whatever it holds: a part, a tool, a weapon, a limb's crate. The makers' tools obey you. at 30, A Machine That Builds: Once a day you wake a Founder works and it builds what you need, large as a crawler, for one long scene, from the district's own scrap. You cannot lift your arms the next morning. With Works Pass in you it becomes The Part that Fits. Take the Assembler's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Blink
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Blink in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Short Step: For the scene every step you take can land a stride further than a step can: out of a grip, past a blade, through a closing door, over a gap. at 20, Across the Room: You step across a room, a yard or a wall in one fold, with what you carry, and arrive where you looked before anyone has seen you move. at 30, Anywhere in Sight: Once a day the folds come as often as you need for one long scene: anywhere you can see, as many times as the fight asks, with whoever holds your arm. Afterwards the floor keeps moving under you until you sleep. With Light Frame in you it becomes The Folded Step. Take the Blink's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Broadcast
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Broadcast in you will become. What wakes: at 10, On the Air: For the scene your voice can come out of a speaker, comm or horn in the building, as loud or as soft as you want, wherever you stand. at 20, Every Speaker: You speak and every speaker in the district carries you for the scene, to whoever you name or to all of them: a crowd turns, a crew stops, a lie goes out on a hundred horns. at 30, The City Hears: Once a day the whole city hears you, every speaker, every comm, every old horn in the Dust, for one long scene, and what you say is heard the way you meant it. Afterwards you cannot speak above a whisper until morning. With Mimic in you it becomes The Voice on the Air. Take the Broadcast's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Bulwark
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Bulwark in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Old Light: The shimmer of old field-light stands between you and harm for the scene, taking the edge off the blows aimed at you while it holds. at 20, Held Line: You raise the old defences across a doorway, a cart or a line of friends for the scene: what comes at them does not get through, and whoever holds the line behind you stands. at 30, Nothing Gets Through: Once a day the Founder defences of the place close around you and yours for one long scene: nothing thrown, fired, swung or dropped gets through, and nobody you shelter falls. Afterwards your sight greys at the edges until you sleep. With Vault Guard in you it becomes The Wall that Comes. Take the Bulwark's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Cartographer
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Cartographer in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Old Lines: For the scene you know the layout of the Founder-built part of wherever you stand: the stairs, the service runs, the sealed rooms, the way the builders went. at 20, The Deep Map: You name a Founder site under the city and know the way to it from here, turn by turn, with every door that still seals and every drop that still kills. at 30, Every Founder Site: Once a day you hold the whole Founder map at once: every site under the city, which are open, which are sealed, which are lit, and who is standing in them right now. It costs you a night's sleep. With Archivist in you it becomes The Words and the Map. Take the Cartographer's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Chorus
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Chorus in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Room's Mood: For the scene the mood you speak with leans on the people around you: calm settles some of a room, nerve steadies a crew a little, anger turns a few heads. at 20, The Crowd Turns: You turn a crowd for the scene: a mob stops, a square takes your side, a courtroom's temper breaks your way, as the mood you carry runs through every face in it. at 30, One Heart: Once a day the whole district feels what you feel for one long scene: a riot goes quiet, a house's fighters stand down, a city's worth of strangers takes your side. Afterwards you feel nothing at all until you sleep. With Warm Voice in you it becomes The Mood that Spreads. Take the Chorus's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Conduit
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Conduit in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Live Panel: You lay a hand on a dead panel, lamp or lock and it tries to run for you: a light, a latch, a lift call, for as long as your hand stays on it. at 20, Doors and Lifts: Every door, lift and gate in the building hears you for a scene: they open, close, stop and hold where you say, and whoever is inside goes where you send them. at 30, The City Answers: Once a day the old systems of a whole district do what you ask: power, doors, lifts, lamps, drones, all of it, for one long scene. Afterwards you shake for an hour and every panel you pass stays lit a moment too long. With Engineer in you it becomes The Hands and the Current. Take the Conduit's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Echo
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Echo in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Second Wind: The warmth under your skin runs hot for the scene: exhaustion, hunger and the cold bite less, and old machines near you run smoother for it. at 20, The Pod's Gift: You push the warmth out through your hands for a scene: a friend's wound closes to a scar, a dead machine turns over once, and you get back up from a blow that should have ended it. at 30, What the Pod Made: Once a day the thing the pod made of you shows itself: for one long scene you do not tire, do not bleed, do not fall, and every Founder machine in the room runs for you. Afterwards you sleep where you drop. With Athlete in you it becomes The Body that Keeps Going. Take the Echo's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Ember
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Ember in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Shared Warmth: For the scene you give off a warmth that holds the cold off you and everyone pressed close, and a dead fire in reach takes when you breathe on it. at 20, A Fire You Can Call: You call the warmth out as fire for the scene: a wall of it across a doorway, a hand of it on a lock, a line of it that nothing crosses. at 30, The Pod's Fire: Once a day the pod's heat comes out of you all at once for one long scene: a street of warmth in the deep cold, or a fire that takes a crawler, a gate, a line of them. Afterwards you are cold to the bone until you sleep. With Winter Blood in you it becomes The Warmth Kept. Take the Ember's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Lodestone
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Lodestone in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Pulled: For the scene small metal in reach leans your way on command: a dropped blade, a key, a thrown bolt; and what you throw bends a hand's width toward its mark. at 20, Every Blade: You pull every blade, bolt and loose piece of metal in the room toward you or away, for the scene: what is pointed at you drops, what you want comes, and a shot aimed at you goes wide. at 30, The Iron Hour: Once a day the metal of a whole district answers you for one long scene: every blade, every gate, every drone's frame leans where you say, and nothing made of iron is raised against you. Your bones ache for a day afterwards. With Licensed Arms in you it becomes The Pull on Metal. Take the Lodestone's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Mender
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Mender in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Warm Hands: You hold your hands over a wound and the warmth slows the bleeding and dulls the pain, on you or on whoever you touch, enough to keep going. at 20, The Old Healing: You wake the old medical systems of the place for the scene and they work through you: a crushed limb set, a poison drawn, a stopped heart started, for everyone you reach. at 30, Close the Wound: Once a day you close every wound in the room for one long scene: the dying stand, the maimed are whole, and a body gone cold an hour since takes a breath. Afterwards you cannot lift your hands until morning. With Medic in you it becomes The Warm Hands. Take the Mender's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Recall
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Recall in you will become. What wakes: at 10, One True Thing: For the scene the old records surface when you look: a true fact about a place, machine or person you study, if the Founders kept one. at 20, The Founders' Logs: You open a Founder log in your head about a place, a person's line or a machine and read it aloud for the scene: what the record says, who wrote it, what it did not say. at 30, Every Log Kept: Once a day you hold every log the Founders kept for one long scene and answer any question of the city's thousand years from them, truly, as far as the record goes. It leaves you blind for an hour and silent for a day. With Coder in you it becomes The Record that Surfaces. Take the Recall's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Recoil
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Recoil in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Thrown Back: When you are struck, the old systems throw it back: a shove of force that sends the one who hit you reeling, and your next blow carries their weight. at 20, The Floor Comes Up: You take the room's force and send it out: everyone who came at you in the scene is on the floor, their own weight on top of them, and the floor does not forgive. at 30, The Reckoning: Once a day you give back everything the day has done to you in one blow: every hit you took since you woke lands on one target at once, and the room shakes with it. You can barely stand afterwards. With Bouncer in you it becomes The Thing Thrown Back. Take the Recoil's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Ricochet
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Ricochet in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Off the Wall: For the scene everything you throw or fire can take one bounce off a wall, a pipe or a floor and come at its mark from the side, round cover, round a shield. at 20, Round the Corner: You fire or throw round a corner, over a wall or through a gap no one else could use, and the shot finds its mark as if the room were built to carry it. at 30, Every Angle: Once a day the whole room is yours for one long scene: every shot you take finds its mark off any surface you name, however many walls stand between, and nothing in cover is in cover. Afterwards your hands will not stop shaking. With Entertainer in you it becomes The Bent Angle. Take the Ricochet's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Sightline
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Sightline in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Line: For the scene the line in your sight shows you the clear shots in the room: what is in the way, what is cover, where the next one is likely to stand. at 20, Every Line: You see every line in the district for the scene: where each person in range is, what covers them and what does not, and your shots go through the gaps as if the gaps were made for them. at 30, The Builders' Eyes: Once a day you see what the Founders' eyes see for one long scene: everyone in the district, through every wall, and the one shot that ends what needs ending. Afterwards the light hurts until you sleep. With Surveyor in you it becomes The Line Drawn. Take the Sightline's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Slipstream
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Slipstream in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Push: For the scene the old currents push at your back: your strides run long, and a yard, a street or a gap is shorter for you than for the one chasing. at 20, A Step That Crosses: You take one step that crosses a street, a gulf or a shaft, carrying whoever holds your hand, and the current sets you down where you meant to be. at 30, The Long Current: Once a day you ride the old currents across the whole city for one long scene: any point you can name, as many times as the scene needs, with whoever holds on. Afterwards you cannot stand without a wall. With Dispatch Rider in you it becomes The Push at Your Back. Take the Slipstream's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Stasis
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Stasis in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Cold Hold: For the scene your touch chills a wound so it worsens slowly, slows a poison where it is, and buys a dying friend time until help comes. at 20, Held Still: You hold a body still in the cold for the scene: a friend between one breath and the next, a machine mid-motion, a falling thing in the air, until you let it go. at 30, Stop the Clock: Once a day the pod's cold closes over a whole room for one long scene: everything but you and yours stands still, mid-blow, mid-fall, mid-word, until you choose to let it move. Afterwards you cannot get warm until morning. With Firefighter in you it becomes The Cold that Holds. Take the Stasis's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Surge
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Surge in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Live Fist: Your blow carries the old current: a crack of static and a jolt that staggers whoever takes it. at 20, Through the Wall: You put the current through the thing you hit, a door, a plate, a shield or a body, and it goes down: the wall is a wall no longer. at 30, The Door Through the Wall: Once a day you put the whole current of the room into one blow: a door goes through its wall, a crawler stops, a line of them goes down together. Your hands are numb for the rest of the day. With Prizefighter in you it becomes The Charged Blow. Take the Surge's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Tracer
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Tracer in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Marked: Whatever you touch glows for you alone for the day, through walls and across crowds: a person, a crate, a coin passed hand to hand. at 20, Nothing Lost: You mark a person, a thing or a trail and the old systems follow it for you for a week: where it is, where it has been, who carried it. Nothing in the city loses what you have marked. at 30, Every Mark: Once a day you call up every mark you have ever laid, all at once, for one long scene: where each is, who holds it, what moved in the night. The weight of it leaves you sick until morning. With Bounty Writ in you it becomes The Mark Kept. Take the Tracer's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Voice
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Voice in you will become. What wakes: at 10, A Word Back: You speak to any Founder-built system close by and it answers in a word or two: what it is, what it holds, what it was told last. The old thing in the systems is listening. at 20, The Old Voice: You ask the old thing in the systems a question about the city, the Founders or a person, and it answers you as well as it can, for a scene, in a voice only you and whoever is pressed close can hear. at 30, Named by the Systems: Once a day you speak and every Founder-built system in reach treats your word as the Founders': doors stand aside, drones stand down, a sealed archive opens. The voice that answers is tired afterwards, and so are you. With Child of the Vault in you it becomes The Vault Remembers Its Own. Take the Voice's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Waypoint
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Waypoint in you will become. What wakes: at 10, The Safe Way: For the scene you know the nearest safe place from wherever you stand and the clear way to it: round the patrol, past the collapse, through the door that still holds. at 20, The Founders' Roads: You find the Founder road under or through any district for the scene, the sealed ways the builders used, and walk it with whoever follows, out of sight of the street above. at 30, Every Road Home: Once a day every Founder road in the city opens to you for one long scene: from anywhere to anywhere below the street, with whoever follows, and every sealed door on the way stands aside. Afterwards you cannot find your own door without help. With Survey Grant in you it becomes The Road Home. Take the Waypoint's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pod Memory: Whisper
items.info: A pod memory, yours alone: a dream you wake from knowing what the Whisper in you will become. What wakes: at 10, Next Room: For the scene you catch what is said in the next room, across the hall or on the far side of the square, a sentence at a time, when you turn your head. at 20, Every Comm: You listen to any comm, channel or closed room in the district for the scene, and the old systems pass you every word said in it, who said it and to whom. at 30, The City Speaks: Once a day the whole city's talk is yours for one long scene: every comm, every room, every word, sorted to the question you ask. Afterwards the silence in your own head is unbearable until morning. With Court Seat in you it becomes The Overheard Word. Take the Whisper's rungs when they are offered; a rung you skip waits for the next pick.

items.name: Pourer's Gauntlet
items.info: A heat gauntlet scorched to the elbow, Foundry-marked.

items.name: Powered Spool
items.info: Spool, powered: fitted, the wire reels in on a motor and hauls a man off his feet or you up a wall. 48 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Prospect Chip
items.info: A house chip that opens the gym door.

items.name: Protein Paste
items.info: The paste the weave eats; a tube keeps the fibres strong through a hard day.

items.name: Provisions Crate
items.info: A crate of Dust-homestead provisions, scent-sealed against the road; the stock a canteen lives on. 24 Credits, sold at Marta Quell at the Scrap Rows.
items.where: Marta Quell at the Scrap Rows

items.name: Range Card
items.info: A Founder card of ranges and drops the long eye prints its numbers against.

items.name: Ration Bar
items.info: A pressed nutrient bar; the human can eat it, which surprises the stall-holder. 2 Credits, sold at any Market Floor stall.

items.name: Recorder's Quill
items.info: A keeper's quill: its holder may write in the Archive's book.

items.name: Reek Bomb
items.info: A burst of reek gas sold under the counter: it blinds a nose, and on the street that is most noses (canids, chitin, the frogs). It deals chemical damage; the human smells something bad. 18 Credits, sold at the Market Floor's back stalls.

items.name: Reek Charge
items.info: Charge, reek: fitted, the edge weeps a chemical that burns the cut it leaves. 42 Credits, sold at the Market Floor's back stalls.

items.name: Ring Banner
items.info: A strip of the Ring's blue banner: its holder may speak at the stone.
items.where: Voice of the Ring, The Herd Road

items.name: Scatter Core
items.info: Core, scatter: fitted, the rifle throws a spread of hot shot that fills a corridor and fades past it. 45 Credits, sold at Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Scent Seal
items.info: A house's scent seal on a contract or a deed: the signature the Charter reads, and the one thing a human cannot give. Found, never sold: any house's office.

items.name: Scoped Barrel
items.info: Barrel, scoped: fitted, a Founder sight rides the barrel and holds a mark at a street's length. 50 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Screamer Charge
items.info: A thrown sonic charge that shrieks once, loud enough to drop the big-eared to their knees: felids, the small ones, the heavy hides. It deals sonic damage; the human hears a loud bang. 20 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Seat Chain
items.info: A chain of the seat's office: its holder speaks in the Deed Hall.
items.where: Voice of the Seat, House Draska

items.name: Sentry Frame
items.info: A Founder security frame on braced legs with a stabilised arm mount and a sensor head. A mounted frame braces and holds a mark; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: the vault's guard post (The Rig).

items.name: Serrated Edge
items.info: Edge, serrated: fitted, the blade saws through rope, strap and hide and never slides off. 28 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Servo Grease
items.info: A tin of the servos' grease; a fresh pack lets them fire twice as long before they lock.

items.name: Shock Baton
items.info: A loader's shock baton: a charged rod that drops a man or a drone for a breath. 15 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Shock Grip
items.info: Grip, shock: fitted, the hilt discharges into whatever the edge touches. 40 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Shooting Gloves
items.info: Padded gloves cut for the brace: the kick lands in the padding, not the wrist. 6 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Shop Sign
items.info: A lit sign over a Shaftmouth door with the human's business name on it, copied letter by letter by a signwriter who cannot read the old tongue: it says SOP. The first one the city has seen. Found, never sold: The Shop.

items.name: Short Barrel
items.info: Barrel, short: fitted, the rifle comes up fast and loses its reach. 30 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Shoulder Guard
items.info: A riveted guard over the ram plate, for the doors that hit back. 12 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Silver Shoulder Arm (crated)
items.info: The Silver Shoulder Arm in its crate, an arm of vault-tech, House Veil's cosmetic work: a reach or a flourish that draws every eye on the floor, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 25. 220 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Single-Shot Mechanism
items.info: Mechanism, single shot: fitted, one careful round at a time, never a jam. 30 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Sling Rig
items.info: A forearm sling rig: a powered cradle that throws a stone, a bolt or a bearing hard and flat across a yard. 10 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Snapback Spool
items.info: Spool, snapback: fitted, the wire whips home the instant it lets go, ready for a second throw. 44 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Spike Housing
items.info: Housing, spike: fitted, a hand's length of Founder steel comes out of the forearm on the nerve's word and goes back in. 70 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Splint Kit
items.info: Alloy splints and wraps that set a bone the lacing has already half held.

items.name: Spray Mechanism
items.info: Mechanism, spray: fitted, the rifle empties on one long pull and climbs off the mark. 70 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Spring Tuning Key
items.info: A hex key for the spring legs' tension screws: tighter for a jump, looser for a long run.

items.name: Sprung Boots
items.info: Boots cut to the sprung pads; a long run feels short. 6 Credits, sold at any Market Floor stall.

items.name: Sprung Stock
items.info: Stock, sprung: fitted, a sprung butt soaks the kick so the second shot lands near the first. 35 Credits, sold at Varga's Bench.

items.name: Stasis Ampoule
items.info: One dose that drops a dying body into the node's slow state for an hour.

items.name: Steel Canteen
items.info: A canteen; with the reclaimer, a day's water lasts three.

items.name: Steel Spring Leg (crated)
items.info: The Steel Spring Leg in its crate, a leg of vault-tech, House Veil's cosmetic work: a leap to a rail, over a counter, across a gap, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 30. 200 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Suppressor Cap
items.info: Muzzle, suppressor cap: fitted, the shot is a cough and the barrel runs hot. 24 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Sworn Seal
items.info: A small wax seal of the seat: its holder carries the house's word.

items.name: Tally Knife
items.info: The knife that scores the Tally Wall; its holder may record a digging.

items.name: Taped Grip
items.info: Grip, taped: fitted, the blade sits sure in a wet or gloved hand. 12 Credits, sold at any Market Floor stall.

items.name: Thermal Charge
items.info: Charge, thermal: fitted, the edge runs hot and cauterises what it cuts. 38 Credits, sold at Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard.
items.where: Dov Marrick at the Freight Yard

items.name: Thought Nerve
items.info: Nerve, thought: fitted, the implant fires on the thought alone, faster than a hand, and now and then on a thought you did not mean. 90 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow's bench.

items.name: Throw Mic
items.info: A collar mic the voice box throws its voice through, from across a room.

items.name: Thunder Cycle
items.info: The Thunder Cycle, a ride with a mind of its own it calls Thunder: loud, loyal, sulks when parked indoors; its one line comes up as text on its panel glass when spoken to; it keeps its counsel otherwise. Mounted it is the party's speed and 75 of armor; it fits no door built for anyone. 900 Credits, sold at Bram Tolliver at the Crawler Bay.
items.where: Bram Tolliver at the Crawler Bay

items.name: Tide Chart
items.info: A tide chart of the Stair with the drawing tides marked: its holder may log the tide.

items.name: Tint Drops
items.info: Drops that hold the eyes' colour steady when you need them not to change.

items.name: Tool Roll
items.info: A roll of drivers, probes and a current tester, the kind that opens a service hatch in under a minute.

items.name: Tower Lease Seal
items.info: A scent-sealed Charter lease for a Tether tower floor with a human palm print beside the seal; the first in a thousand years. Found, never sold: The Tower.

items.name: Tracer Cartridge
items.info: Cartridge, tracer: fitted, every round draws a line of light that the next shot follows. 18 Credits, sold at the Freight Yard.

items.name: Tunneller's Chalk
items.info: A stick of crew chalk: its marks are a claim the Long Table honours.

items.name: Turret-Lens Eye (crated)
items.info: The Turret-Lens Eye in its crate, an eye of vault-tech, Ilse Varga's precision work: a face or a shot picked out across a floor, once a fitter at a bench seats it. LOAD 15. 280 Credits, sold at Oriana Flett on the Market Floor.
items.where: Oriana Flett on the Market Floor

items.name: Twin Pulse Cuff
items.info: A cuff that hums both hearts' beat, so you know which one is working. 10 Credits, sold at Doc Sallow at Veil Gym.

items.name: Vault Lamp
items.info: A Founder emergency lamp off a gallery wall, recharged by a current tester or a human touch. 6 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Vault Walker
items.info: A Founder maintenance walker: a tall narrow frame on bird-jointed legs with a cradle for one and a toolkit rack. A mounted frame runs and climbs; it fits no door built for anyone. Found, never sold: the gallery's maintenance rail (The Rig).

items.name: Voice's Ember
items.info: A sealed glass vial with a coal still alight in it: its holder speaks at the Slow Court.
items.where: Voice of the Bench, House Ashgrave

items.name: Voice's Feather
items.info: A black feather on a silver pin: its holder speaks for the Roost.
items.where: Voice of the Roost, The Roost

items.name: Voice's Float
items.info: A glass float with a lamp in it: its holder speaks in the Breakwater Hall.
items.where: Voice of the Breakwater, The Breakwater

items.name: Voice's Freight Seal
items.info: A seal that moves any cargo through any gate in Meridian.
items.where: Voice of the Corrow, House Corrow

items.name: Voice's Lamp
items.info: A lamp lit from the Long Table's own: its holder speaks at the table.
items.where: Voice of the Long Table, The Diggers

items.name: Voice's Ring Pass
items.info: A pass that seats its holder at any rail in Shaftmouth.
items.where: Voice of the Veil, House Veil

items.name: Warden's Token
items.info: A token from the gate book: its holder passes the Winter Gate unread.

items.name: Weave Damper Vials
items.info: Three vials that calm an overdriven weave for an hour, when the hands will not stop.

items.name: Weighted Spine
items.info: Spine, weighted: fitted, the blade chops like a hatchet and tires the arm. 32 Credits, sold at the Scrap Rows.

items.name: Yard Key
items.info: A key to the yard offices and the tally boards.

abilities.name: Actuator Kick
abilities.info:
With the Lift-Actuator Leg: a kick that moves a crate, a door or a man.
[Trait: Lift-Actuator Leg]

abilities.name: Aegis: Every Machine
abilities.info:
Once a day every machine in the district keeps you and yours alive for one long scene: nothing automated harms you, every old defence stands between you and the blow, and the doors of the city close on whoever hunts you. Afterwards the machines go quiet for you for a day.
[Trait: Aegis: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Aegis: On Your Side
abilities.info:
You turn the machines of the place to your side for the scene: drones cover you, doors seal behind you, turrets face the other way, and whoever walks with you is theirs to protect.
[Trait: Aegis: Resonance]

abilities.name: Aegis: Stand Down
abilities.info:
For the scene the machines about to hurt you hesitate: a drone holds a breath, a turret tracks past you, a closing door slows, a chance for you and yours to get clear.
[Trait: Aegis: Current]

abilities.name: Anchor: Rooted
abilities.info:
For the scene your feet are part of the floor: a shove, a pull or a drag has to beat the ground to move you, and what you hold is hard to take.
[Trait: Anchor: Current]

abilities.name: Anchor: The City's Weight
abilities.info:
Once a day the ground under a whole block answers you for one long scene: nothing you choose moves, nothing you deny gets in, and a crawler that drives at you stops as if it hit a wall. Your knees are gone for the rest of the day.
[Trait: Anchor: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Anchor: The Ground Holds
abilities.info:
You put the ground's grip into whatever you touch for the scene: a cart, a gate, a friend, a falling body; what you anchor does not move, and what moves against it stops.
[Trait: Anchor: Resonance]

abilities.name: Any Gate
abilities.info:
You cross the wall at any gate, day or night, and the gatekeeper waves the party through with you.
[Trait: Gate Pass]

abilities.name: Anything Goes
abilities.info:
You use whatever is in reach as a weapon this turn, a chair, a bottle or a railing, and it hits like one.
[Trait: Brawler]

abilities.name: Assembler: A Machine That Builds
abilities.info:
Once a day you wake a Founder works and it builds what you need, large as a crawler, for one long scene, from the district's own scrap. You cannot lift your arms the next morning.
[Trait: Assembler: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Assembler: Clicks Home
abilities.info:
For the scene the parts of whatever you work on know where they go: a repair goes quicker than it should, a jam clears at a touch, and a thing you build wants to run.
[Trait: Assembler: Current]

abilities.name: Assembler: The Old Makers
abilities.info:
You ask a Founder fabricator, bench or press for a thing and it builds it for you in the scene from whatever it holds: a part, a tool, a weapon, a limb's crate. The makers' tools obey you.
[Trait: Assembler: Resonance]

abilities.name: Back Door
abilities.info:
You find the old maintenance route into a Founder system and make it do one thing its owners locked away.
[Trait: Coder]

abilities.name: Blink: Across the Room
abilities.info:
You step across a room, a yard or a wall in one fold, with what you carry, and arrive where you looked before anyone has seen you move.
[Trait: Blink: Resonance]

abilities.name: Blink: Anywhere in Sight
abilities.info:
Once a day the folds come as often as you need for one long scene: anywhere you can see, as many times as the fight asks, with whoever holds your arm. Afterwards the floor keeps moving under you until you sleep.
[Trait: Blink: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Blink: The Short Step
abilities.info:
For the scene every step you take can land a stride further than a step can: out of a grip, past a blade, through a closing door, over a gap.
[Trait: Blink: Current]

abilities.name: Brake Call
abilities.info:
Stopping a dropping cage from the floor with a call and a lever.
[Trait: House Corrow: Yardmaster]

abilities.name: Break Through
abilities.info:
You break through a door, a plate, a guard or a shield with one heavy swing.
[Trait: Breaker]

abilities.name: Broadcast: Every Speaker
abilities.info:
You speak and every speaker in the district carries you for the scene, to whoever you name or to all of them: a crowd turns, a crew stops, a lie goes out on a hundred horns.
[Trait: Broadcast: Resonance]

abilities.name: Broadcast: On the Air
abilities.info:
For the scene your voice can come out of a speaker, comm or horn in the building, as loud or as soft as you want, wherever you stand.
[Trait: Broadcast: Current]

abilities.name: Broadcast: The City Hears
abilities.info:
Once a day the whole city hears you, every speaker, every comm, every old horn in the Dust, for one long scene, and what you say is heard the way you meant it. Afterwards you cannot speak above a whisper until morning.
[Trait: Broadcast: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Built Cut
abilities.info:
One cut with the blade as it is built this turn: the LOADOUT line names the parts and the cut is theirs (a monomolecular edge opens plate, a serrated edge saws, a weighted spine chops, a shock grip discharges, an arc charge numbs, a thermal charge burns shut). No edge fitted, no cut; no hilt in hand, nothing.
[Trait: Scrapper]

abilities.name: Built Lash
abilities.info:
One throw of the wire as it is built this turn: the LOADOUT line names the parts and the throw is theirs (a cutting filament parts what it draws tight, a braided filament binds, a barbed anchor holds, a mag anchor sticks to plate, a powered spool hauls). No filament fitted, no throw; no rig on the arm, nothing.
[Trait: Runner]

abilities.name: Built Shot
abilities.info:
One shot from the rifle as it is built this turn: the LOADOUT line names the parts and the shot is theirs (a long barrel reaches, a plasma core burns, a kinetic core punches, a burst mechanism fires three, a suppressor coughs). No core fitted, no shot; no frame in hand, nothing.
[Trait: Marksman]

abilities.name: Built Strike
abilities.info:
One strike with the implant as it is built this turn: the LOADOUT line names the parts and the strike is theirs (a spike housing stabs from the forearm, a bolt housing throws, a cell feed hits hard and runs dry, a body feed never runs dry and never hits hard, a thought nerve fires before the hand could). No housing fitted, no strike; no port set, nothing.
[Trait: Tinker]

abilities.name: Bulwark: Held Line
abilities.info:
You raise the old defences across a doorway, a cart or a line of friends for the scene: what comes at them does not get through, and whoever holds the line behind you stands.
[Trait: Bulwark: Resonance]

abilities.name: Bulwark: Nothing Gets Through
abilities.info:
Once a day the Founder defences of the place close around you and yours for one long scene: nothing thrown, fired, swung or dropped gets through, and nobody you shelter falls. Afterwards your sight greys at the edges until you sleep.
[Trait: Bulwark: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Bulwark: Old Light
abilities.info:
The shimmer of old field-light stands between you and harm for the scene, taking the edge off the blows aimed at you while it holds.
[Trait: Bulwark: Current]

abilities.name: Burst Sprint
abilities.info:
You cross the whole street in one burst, faster than anything chasing you or running from you.
[Trait: Burst Servos]

abilities.name: Cable Line
abilities.info:
You cross a cable, ledge or shaft wall no one else in the room would try, and be gone.
[Trait: Runner]

abilities.name: Cable Walk
abilities.info:
Walking the shaft cables and the yard's cable runs without a line.
[Trait: House Corrow: Lift Boss]

abilities.name: Cage Count
abilities.info:
Tallying a cage's load by eye before the boards post it.
[Trait: House Corrow: Hand]

abilities.name: Call the Challenge
abilities.info:
You call the old right of challenge on a dispute: the court must let a fight settle it, and the other side must answer or yield.
[Trait: Duel Right]

abilities.name: Carried Air
abilities.info:
Working a breather and one bottle of air so it lasts the whole run.
[Trait: The Diggers: Tunneller]

abilities.name: Cartographer: Every Founder Site
abilities.info:
Once a day you hold the whole Founder map at once: every site under the city, which are open, which are sealed, which are lit, and who is standing in them right now. It costs you a night's sleep.
[Trait: Cartographer: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Cartographer: Old Lines
abilities.info:
For the scene you know the layout of the Founder-built part of wherever you stand: the stairs, the service runs, the sealed rooms, the way the builders went.
[Trait: Cartographer: Current]

abilities.name: Cartographer: The Deep Map
abilities.info:
You name a Founder site under the city and know the way to it from here, turn by turn, with every door that still seals and every drop that still kills.
[Trait: Cartographer: Resonance]

abilities.name: Champion's Call
abilities.info:
You step in as the court's champion for someone in a fight: the fight is yours now, by law, and the court watches it.
[Trait: Trial Champion]

abilities.name: Chorus: One Heart
abilities.info:
Once a day the whole district feels what you feel for one long scene: a riot goes quiet, a house's fighters stand down, a city's worth of strangers takes your side. Afterwards you feel nothing at all until you sleep.
[Trait: Chorus: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Chorus: The Crowd Turns
abilities.info:
You turn a crowd for the scene: a mob stops, a square takes your side, a courtroom's temper breaks your way, as the mood you carry runs through every face in it.
[Trait: Chorus: Resonance]

abilities.name: Chorus: The Room's Mood
abilities.info:
For the scene the mood you speak with leans on the people around you: calm settles some of a room, nerve steadies a crew a little, anger turns a few heads.
[Trait: Chorus: Current]

abilities.name: Clause Read
abilities.info:
Finding the clause in the Charter that decides the matter before anyone else has.
[Trait: The Tether Court: Petitioner]

abilities.name: Clean Breath
abilities.info:
You and one other breathe clean through smoke, gas or reek for the whole scene.
[Trait: Lung Filter]

abilities.name: Clear the Room
abilities.info:
Before a fight breaks, set the room the old way: your side starts in cover and acts first, and whoever rushes you runs into a prepared line.
[Trait: Soldier]

abilities.name: Climbing Drill: Concealment Technique
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you conceal tracks or preparation for a planned approach; trained observers can still discover the signs. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Climbing Drill: Concealment]

abilities.name: Climbing Drill: Fortification Technique
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you organise a defensible stopping place or working area with actual supplies; it does not create an impenetrable refuge. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Climbing Drill: Fortification]

abilities.name: Climbing Drill: Observation Technique
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you examine a concrete clue before choosing a route or a practical plan; this reveals no information that the evidence cannot support. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Climbing Drill: Observation]

abilities.name: Climbing Drill: Routefinding Technique
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you help a group negotiate difficult ground with a practical route and real equipment; nobody is moved or rescued automatically. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Climbing Drill: Routefinding]

abilities.name: Close Fighting Drill: Ambush Technique
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you disguise an approach and attempt an opening strike before the opponent sets their guard; discovery removes surprise. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Close Fighting Drill: Ambush]

abilities.name: Close Fighting Drill: Control Technique
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you use leverage and stance to attempt a hold or throw that contests an opponent's movement; strength and footing still matter. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Close Fighting Drill: Control]

abilities.name: Close Fighting Drill: Mobility Technique
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you step inside or outside reach while delivering a short unarmed strike; neither movement nor the hit is guaranteed. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Close Fighting Drill: Mobility]

abilities.name: Close Fighting Drill: Precision Technique
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you place a short unarmed strike or joint grip against a visible opening; anatomy and the opponent's resistance limit it. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Close Fighting Drill: Precision]

abilities.name: Cold Doesn't Bite
abilities.info:
You go through frost, ice water or a freezing night as if it were a cool day, and keep someone else alive through it too.
[Trait: Winter Blood]

abilities.name: Cold Fieldcraft: Concealment Technique
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you conceal tracks or preparation for a planned approach; trained observers can still discover the signs. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Cold Fieldcraft: Concealment]

abilities.name: Cold Fieldcraft: Fortification Technique
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you organise a defensible stopping place or working area with actual supplies; it does not create an impenetrable refuge. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Cold Fieldcraft: Fortification]

abilities.name: Cold Fieldcraft: Observation Technique
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you examine a concrete clue before choosing a route or a practical plan; this reveals no information that the evidence cannot support. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Cold Fieldcraft: Observation]

abilities.name: Cold Fieldcraft: Routefinding Technique
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you help a group negotiate difficult ground with a practical route and real equipment; nobody is moved or rescued automatically. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Cold Fieldcraft: Routefinding]

abilities.name: Collect the Due
abilities.info:
You remind a workshop whose patent its machines run on: you get a part, a repair or a favour for nothing, and a grudge with it.
[Trait: Patent Holder]

abilities.name: Combination
abilities.info:
You land three blows in the time the other one throws one: a body shot, a hook and the one they never saw.
[Trait: Prizefighter]

abilities.name: Conduit: Doors and Lifts
abilities.info:
Every door, lift and gate in the building hears you for a scene: they open, close, stop and hold where you say, and whoever is inside goes where you send them.
[Trait: Conduit: Resonance]

abilities.name: Conduit: Live Panel
abilities.info:
You lay a hand on a dead panel, lamp or lock and it tries to run for you: a light, a latch, a lift call, for as long as your hand stays on it.
[Trait: Conduit: Current]

abilities.name: Conduit: The City Answers
abilities.info:
Once a day the old systems of a whole district do what you ask: power, doors, lifts, lamps, drones, all of it, for one long scene. Afterwards you shake for an hour and every panel you pass stays lit a moment too long.
[Trait: Conduit: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Copper Touch
abilities.info:
With the Copper-Plate Hand: a panel coaxed, a fine fitting done, a lock felt out.
[Trait: Copper-Plate Hand]

abilities.name: Core Purge
abilities.info:
You vent the core's cold all at once: frost blooms off you, the fire near you dies back, and a grip on you freezes loose.
[Trait: Cold Core]

abilities.name: Corner Call
abilities.info:
A shouted fix from the corner that lands mid-exchange.
[Trait: House Veil: Cornerman]

abilities.name: Court's Favour
abilities.info:
You call on the court's interest: one door opens, one charge is dropped or one marshal looks away, and the court remembers it.
[Trait: Ward of the Court]

abilities.name: Crushing Grip
abilities.info:
You lift, throw or crush what a loader would, with your own hands.
[Trait: Myomer Weave]

abilities.name: Cut and Cover
abilities.info:
A cutter worked under the guard, legal in the ring and nowhere else.
[Trait: House Veil: Contender]

abilities.name: Dead Panel
abilities.info:
You coax a panel, lock or lift control into doing one thing it was built to do and has forgotten.
[Trait: Tinker]

abilities.name: Dead Still
abilities.info:
You hold perfectly still for one shot or one delicate job, whatever is happening around you, and it goes where you meant.
[Trait: Steady Hands]

abilities.name: Deed Lore
abilities.info:
Reading a deed and its seals: who holds what, by which charter, since when.
[Trait: House Draska: Petitioner]

abilities.name: Dig In
abilities.info:
You dig in behind cover and nothing short of a full assault gets you out this turn.
[Trait: Holdout]

abilities.name: Docket Call
abilities.info:
Moving a filing to the top of the day's docket with a word to the right clerk.
[Trait: The Tether Court: Advocate]

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.info:
You fire twice in the time of one shot, and both land where you aimed.
[Trait: Recoil Brace]

abilities.name: Drive Sense
abilities.info:
Holding a drive together across open grass with nothing to steer by.
[Trait: The Herd Road: Drover]

abilities.name: Drop and Roll
abilities.info:
You jump down any height the street has and land running.
[Trait: Shock Ankles]

abilities.name: Echo: Second Wind
abilities.info:
The warmth under your skin runs hot for the scene: exhaustion, hunger and the cold bite less, and old machines near you run smoother for it.
[Trait: Echo: Current]

abilities.name: Echo: The Pod's Gift
abilities.info:
You push the warmth out through your hands for a scene: a friend's wound closes to a scar, a dead machine turns over once, and you get back up from a blow that should have ended it.
[Trait: Echo: Resonance]

abilities.name: Echo: What the Pod Made
abilities.info:
Once a day the thing the pod made of you shows itself: for one long scene you do not tire, do not bleed, do not fall, and every Founder machine in the room runs for you. Afterwards you sleep where you drop.
[Trait: Echo: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Ember: A Fire You Can Call
abilities.info:
You call the warmth out as fire for the scene: a wall of it across a doorway, a hand of it on a lock, a line of it that nothing crosses. [Damage: burn]
[Trait: Ember: Resonance]

abilities.name: Ember: Shared Warmth
abilities.info:
For the scene you give off a warmth that holds the cold off you and everyone pressed close, and a dead fire in reach takes when you breathe on it.
[Trait: Ember: Current]

abilities.name: Ember: The Pod's Fire
abilities.info:
Once a day the pod's heat comes out of you all at once for one long scene: a street of warmth in the deep cold, or a fire that takes a crawler, a gate, a line of them. Afterwards you are cold to the bone until you sleep. [Damage: burn]
[Trait: Ember: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Eye in the Sky
abilities.info:
You put something in the air, a drone, a kite or a camera on a cable, and see the whole place from above for this turn.
[Trait: Drone Operator]

abilities.name: Far Sight
abilities.info:
You read a face, a scope or a sign at a street's length as if it were across the table.
[Trait: Long Eye]

abilities.name: Figure It Out
abilities.info:
You study a machine, lock or system for one turn and understand how it works, including what its makers hid.
[Trait: Pattern Mind]

abilities.name: Finder's Share
abilities.info:
You stake the Charter's finder's share on a find beyond the wall: a crew that takes it from you breaks the law in front of witnesses.
[Trait: Survey Grant]

abilities.name: Finding
abilities.info:
A finding filed against a desk that the court must answer.
[Trait: The Tether Court: Assessor]

abilities.name: Fine Work
abilities.info:
You do one fine job fast: a lock picked, a wire spliced or a pocket emptied before anyone looks.
[Trait: Nimble Fingers]

abilities.name: Firearm Drill: Ambush Technique
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you conceal your firing position and time an opening shot or controlled burst against a distracted target; a detected position loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Firearm Drill: Ambush]

abilities.name: Firearm Drill: Control Technique
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you use the firearm's actual available shots to contest a lane of advance; a single-shot weapon gets one shot, and ammunition, reloads and firing rate remain real limits. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Firearm Drill: Control]

abilities.name: Firearm Drill: Mobility Technique
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you fire a controlled shot while moving between established cover; movement does not provide automatic evasion or another action. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Firearm Drill: Mobility]

abilities.name: Firearm Drill: Precision Technique
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you settle a firearm on a small exposed target and fire one aimed shot or the shortest burst it can actually fire; cover and range still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Firearm Drill: Precision]

abilities.name: First Shot
abilities.info:
You shoot or throw first in a fight, before anyone else in the room can act.
[Trait: Quickdraw]

abilities.name: Flicker: Aegis
abilities.info:
One machine about to hurt you, a drone, a turret or a closing door, hesitates long enough for you to get clear.
[Trait: Aegis]

abilities.name: Flicker: Anchor
abilities.info:
For a breath your feet are a part of the floor: a shove, a pull or a blast does not move you.
[Trait: Anchor]

abilities.name: Flicker: Assembler
abilities.info:
A part you are fitting clicks into place by itself, as if it remembered where it went.
[Trait: Assembler]

abilities.name: Flicker: Blink
abilities.info:
You step a hand's width further than a step can, out of a grip or past a blade.
[Trait: Blink]

abilities.name: Flicker: Broadcast
abilities.info:
You speak and your voice comes out of a speaker, comm or old horn nearby, for a sentence, wherever you are.
[Trait: Broadcast]

abilities.name: Flicker: Bulwark
abilities.info:
A shimmer of old field-light takes the edge off one blow aimed at you, and then is gone.
[Trait: Bulwark]

abilities.name: Flicker: Cartographer
abilities.info:
For a breath you know which way is down, and which way the old builders went. Enough to pick a corridor.
[Trait: Cartographer]

abilities.name: Flicker: Chorus
abilities.info:
The mood you speak with spreads through the people closest to you for a moment: calm, nerve or anger.
[Trait: Chorus]

abilities.name: Flicker: Conduit
abilities.info:
A dead panel, lamp or lock-light wakes at your touch for a moment. It proves nothing yet and everyone who sees it remembers.
[Trait: Conduit]

abilities.name: Flicker: Echo
abilities.info:
A warmth under the skin when old machines are near; a drone hesitates a half-second before it decides about you.
[Trait: Echo]

abilities.name: Flicker: Ember
abilities.info:
You give off a warmth that keeps you and anyone pressed close to you safe from the cold for a night.
[Trait: Ember]

abilities.name: Flicker: Lodestone
abilities.info:
A small metal thing in reach leans toward you, or a thrown blade bends a hand's width toward its mark.
[Trait: Lodestone]

abilities.name: Flicker: Mender
abilities.info:
You warm your hands over a wound and the bleeding slows for a while.
[Trait: Mender]

abilities.name: Flicker: Recall
abilities.info:
A flash of an old record surfaces in your head: one true fact about the place, the machine or the person in front of you.
[Trait: Recall]

abilities.name: Flicker: Recoil
abilities.info:
When you are hit, a shove of air throws the one who hit you a step back.
[Trait: Recoil]

abilities.name: Flicker: Ricochet
abilities.info:
A thrown or fired thing bounces once off a wall and comes at its mark from the side.
[Trait: Ricochet]

abilities.name: Flicker: Sightline
abilities.info:
A faint line shows in your sight from you to whatever you look at, and you know nothing is in the way.
[Trait: Sightline]

abilities.name: Flicker: Slipstream
abilities.info:
A push of air at your back carries your next stride twice as far as it should go.
[Trait: Slipstream]

abilities.name: Flicker: Stasis
abilities.info:
You chill a wound with a touch so it stops getting worse for a while, on you or on someone else.
[Trait: Stasis]

abilities.name: Flicker: Surge
abilities.info:
You hit with a crack of static and a jolt the other one feels down to the floor.
[Trait: Surge]

abilities.name: Flicker: Tracer
abilities.info:
You see something you touched glow for you alone for a while, through a wall and across a crowd.
[Trait: Tracer]

abilities.name: Flicker: Voice
abilities.info:
A nearby comm or speaker crackles when you speak close to it, and once in a while a word comes back.
[Trait: Voice]

abilities.name: Flicker: Waypoint
abilities.info:
A pull in your chest points to the nearest safe place, and the way there is clear for a breath.
[Trait: Waypoint]

abilities.name: Flicker: Whisper
abilities.info:
You overhear one word or one name from a conversation you are not close enough to hear.
[Trait: Whisper]

abilities.name: Founder Clinic
abilities.info:
You walk into a Founder clinic or store and are fed or mended without a coin, whoever is paying for everyone else.
[Trait: Ration Right]

abilities.name: Founder Override
abilities.info:
A Founder door, lift, light or lock runs one plain order for you as if you still held the keys: open, stop, wake or seal.
[Trait: Engineer]

abilities.name: Founder Print
abilities.info:
You lay your print on a sealed Founder lock in the vault or the ruins and it opens for you.
[Trait: Keyholder]

abilities.name: Gaff Hook
abilities.info:
With the Gaff-Hook Hand: hook a crate, a rail or a collar and pull.
[Trait: Gaff-Hook Hand]

abilities.name: Glass Eye
abilities.info:
Reading a sheet of glass for the flaw before it cracks.
[Trait: House Ashgrave: Pourer]

abilities.name: Grain Eye
abilities.info:
Judging a load of grain by the handful: its weight, its age, its worth.
[Trait: The Herd Road: Elder's Hand]

abilities.name: Hear the Rock
abilities.info:
You hear a tunnel, wall or floor about to fail before it does, and get the party clear or bring it down where you choose.
[Trait: Miner]

abilities.name: Heat Work
abilities.info:
Working a hot room past the point the body says stop, and knowing the point exactly.
[Trait: House Ashgrave: Stranger]

abilities.name: Herd Order
abilities.info:
Reading who stands where in a herd, and where you stand.
[Trait: The Herd Road: Herd-Kin]

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.info:
You strike and are out of reach before the answer comes.
[Trait: Skirmisher]

abilities.name: Hold the Door
abilities.info:
You hold a doorway, stair or corridor this turn: nobody gets past you without putting you down first.
[Trait: Vault Guard]

abilities.name: Hold Your Breath
abilities.info:
You stop your breath and your heartbeat slows; your next shot or your hiding place is perfect for one turn.
[Trait: Still Breath]

abilities.name: Hush the Room
abilities.info:
You speak and a whole room goes quiet to listen, a crowd, a fight or a court, for one turn.
[Trait: Warm Voice]

abilities.name: Hydraulic Grip
abilities.info:
With the Hydraulic Forearm: crush, hold or lift what a hand cannot.
[Trait: Hydraulic Forearm]

abilities.name: Iron Stomach
abilities.info:
You eat, drink or breathe what would drop anyone else, from spoiled food to a drugged cup or a bad room's air, and carry on as if it were clean.
[Trait: Omnivore]

abilities.name: Jack In
abilities.info:
You plug into a panel, a console or a drone and read or rewrite what it does for a turn.
[Trait: Data Jack]

abilities.name: Jam It
abilities.info:
You make one machine, weapon or rig the other side depends on fail at the worst moment for them.
[Trait: Saboteur]

abilities.name: Knife Hand
abilities.info:
You throw two blades at two marks in one move, and both land.
[Trait: Thrower]

abilities.name: Knot Work
abilities.info:
Lashing and reading a crew's knot: whose pontoon, whose haul, whose claim.
[Trait: The Breakwater: Landlubber]

abilities.name: Last Warning
abilities.info:
You give one warning, and whoever ignores it starts the fight off balance while you start it ready.
[Trait: Bouncer]

abilities.name: Lawful Salvage
abilities.info:
You claim what you pull out of a Founder ruin by the Charter, and the crew that comes for it has to argue with the court first.
[Trait: Salvage Claim]

abilities.name: Ledge Run
abilities.info:
Moving ledge to ledge with no stair, fast, the body low against the rock.
[Trait: The Roost: Runner]

abilities.name: Level Head
abilities.info:
When a room is pulled by something old, a season or a panic or a voice meant to sway, you stay clear and act while everyone else is caught.
[Trait: No Season]

abilities.name: Live Off the Dust
abilities.info:
You find water, shelter or a safe trail in the Dust or the ruins for the whole party this turn.
[Trait: Ranger]

abilities.name: Live Wire
abilities.info:
You turn the room's own power against the other side: a live cable, a jolt through the floor, a junction box opened at the right time.
[Trait: Splicer]

abilities.name: Loader's Hitch
abilities.info:
Lifting and throwing with the whole frame; a crate or a man.
[Trait: House Corrow: Loader]

abilities.name: Lodestone: Every Blade
abilities.info:
You pull every blade, bolt and loose piece of metal in the room toward you or away, for the scene: what is pointed at you drops, what you want comes, and a shot aimed at you goes wide.
[Trait: Lodestone: Resonance]

abilities.name: Lodestone: Pulled
abilities.info:
For the scene small metal in reach leans your way on command: a dropped blade, a key, a thrown bolt; and what you throw bends a hand's width toward its mark.
[Trait: Lodestone: Current]

abilities.name: Lodestone: The Iron Hour
abilities.info:
Once a day the metal of a whole district answers you for one long scene: every blade, every gate, every drone's frame leans where you say, and nothing made of iron is raised against you. Your bones ache for a day afterwards.
[Trait: Lodestone: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Long Breath
abilities.info:
Holding a breath past where the body says stop, and knowing the edge.
[Trait: The Breakwater: Deckhand]

abilities.name: Long Glide
abilities.info:
Crossing a gap the long way, a line or a lean, without looking down.
[Trait: The Roost: Courier]

abilities.name: Long Throw
abilities.info:
You throw a stone, a knife or a charge across the whole yard, farther than anyone in the room could.
[Trait: Long Arm]

abilities.name: Long Walk
abilities.info:
Walking beside a crawler or a herd for days and keeping the pace.
[Trait: The Herd Road: Stray]

abilities.name: Loupe Read
abilities.info:
With the Brass Loupe Eye: a seal, a stamp or a part number read at a glance.
[Trait: Brass Loupe Eye]

abilities.name: Low Run
abilities.info:
Moving fast where the ceiling is a stoat's reach: crouched, quiet, never touching the lamps.
[Trait: The Diggers: Lamp-Hand]

abilities.name: Lungful
abilities.info:
You hold your breath through smoke, gas or deep water for as long as the job takes.
[Trait: Deep Lungs]

abilities.name: Mantis Cut
abilities.info:
With the Mantis Forearm: the folded claws unfold for one cut.
[Trait: Mantis Forearm]

abilities.name: Mastered Climbing Drill: Concealment
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you conceal tracks or preparation for a planned approach; trained observers can still discover the signs. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Climb 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Climbing Drill: Fortification
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you organise a defensible stopping place or working area with actual supplies; it does not create an impenetrable refuge. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Climb 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Climbing Drill: Observation
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you examine a concrete clue before choosing a route or a practical plan; this reveals no information that the evidence cannot support. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Climb 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Climbing Drill: Routefinding
abilities.info:
With real footholds, ladders, ropes and routes, you help a group negotiate difficult ground with a practical route and real equipment; nobody is moved or rescued automatically. Improves the next Climb action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Climb 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Close Fighting Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you disguise an approach and attempt an opening strike before the opponent sets their guard; discovery removes surprise. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Close Fighting Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you use leverage and stance to attempt a hold or throw that contests an opponent's movement; strength and footing still matter. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Close Fighting Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you step inside or outside reach while delivering a short unarmed strike; neither movement nor the hit is guaranteed. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Close Fighting Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With the body's close fighting and practical leverage, you place a short unarmed strike or joint grip against a visible opening; anatomy and the opponent's resistance limit it. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Cold Fieldcraft: Concealment
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you conceal tracks or preparation for a planned approach; trained observers can still discover the signs. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Cold Fieldcraft: Fortification
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you organise a defensible stopping place or working area with actual supplies; it does not create an impenetrable refuge. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Cold Fieldcraft: Observation
abilities.info:
