Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Cold Fieldcraft: Routefinding
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you help a group negotiate difficult ground with a practical route and real equipment; nobody is moved or rescued automatically. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Firearm Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you conceal your firing position and time an opening shot or controlled burst against a distracted target; a detected position loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Firearm Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you use the firearm's actual available shots to contest a lane of advance; a single-shot weapon gets one shot, and ammunition, reloads and firing rate remain real limits. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Firearm Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you fire a controlled shot while moving between established cover; movement does not provide automatic evasion or another action. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Firearm Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you settle a firearm on a small exposed target and fire one aimed shot or the shortest burst it can actually fire; cover and range still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Melee Weapon Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you prepare a concealed grip or an unexpected angle with a held melee weapon; discovery removes surprise. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Melee Weapon Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you use a held melee weapon's reach and leverage to contest a narrow approach; the opponent can still force a way through. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Melee Weapon Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you strike with a held melee weapon while changing position; reach, balance and footing remain real limits. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Melee Weapon Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you aim a held melee weapon at a gap in the guard, using the actual striking surface and reach rather than inventing a cutting edge. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Negotiation Drill: Adaptability
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you keep a practical conversation going while circumstances change, adapting the request without choosing anyone's response. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Negotiation Drill: Insight
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you frame a specific request around something the other person has actually said they want; refusal and boundaries remain theirs. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Negotiation Drill: Leverage
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you prepare a truthful, relevant fact for the moment it will be useful in a negotiation; it cannot become knowledge you never learned. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Negotiation Drill: Mediation
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you organise a discussion around one concrete decision and make the competing terms clear; nobody is compelled to agree. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Throwing Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you conceal a thrown weapon until an opening presents itself; a spotted approach loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Throwing Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you place available thrown weapons across a narrow route to contest an advance; you cannot throw ammunition you do not have. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Throwing Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you throw an established projectile during a change of position; it must be recovered or replaced after the throw. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Throwing Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you aim an established thrown weapon at a small exposed target; its actual weight, range and flight still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Workshop Drill: Concealed Work
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you conceal a practical modification until it is needed; it has only the functions you actually built and can be found on inspection. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Workshop Drill: Diagnosis
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you diagnose one precise fault and attempt a repair with established tools and materials; missing parts cannot be invented. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Workshop Drill: Field Repair
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you attempt a field repair or adjustment under pressure, keeping access to the real tool and part rather than bypassing the damage. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 12]

abilities.name: Mastered Workshop Drill: Preparation
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you prepare a practical obstacle or safety measure from available tools and materials; its effect depends on the actual construction. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 12]

abilities.name: Measured
abilities.info:
You know the exact range, angle and weak point of whatever you are looking at, and your next throw or shot uses it.
[Trait: Surveyor]

abilities.name: Melee Weapon Drill: Ambush Technique
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you prepare a concealed grip or an unexpected angle with a held melee weapon; discovery removes surprise. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Melee Weapon Drill: Ambush]

abilities.name: Melee Weapon Drill: Control Technique
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you use a held melee weapon's reach and leverage to contest a narrow approach; the opponent can still force a way through. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Melee Weapon Drill: Control]

abilities.name: Melee Weapon Drill: Mobility Technique
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you strike with a held melee weapon while changing position; reach, balance and footing remain real limits. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Melee Weapon Drill: Mobility]

abilities.name: Melee Weapon Drill: Precision Technique
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you aim a held melee weapon at a gap in the guard, using the actual striking surface and reach rather than inventing a cutting edge. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Melee Weapon Drill: Precision]

abilities.name: Mender: Close the Wound
abilities.info:
Once a day you close every wound in the room for one long scene: the dying stand, the maimed are whole, and a body gone cold an hour since takes a breath. Afterwards you cannot lift your hands until morning.
[Trait: Mender: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Mender: The Old Healing
abilities.info:
You wake the old medical systems of the place for the scene and they work through you: a crushed limb set, a poison drawn, a stopped heart started, for everyone you reach.
[Trait: Mender: Resonance]

abilities.name: Mender: Warm Hands
abilities.info:
You hold your hands over a wound and the warmth slows the bleeding and dulls the pain, on you or on whoever you touch, enough to keep going.
[Trait: Mender: Current]

abilities.name: Muster
abilities.info:
You call the people of a district to your lead in an emergency, and a handful come to hold the line with you this scene.
[Trait: Militia Writ]

abilities.name: Name the Price
abilities.info:
You stop a fight for one exchange by naming a price both sides could accept, and both sides stop to hear it.
[Trait: Negotiator]

abilities.name: Negotiation Drill: Adaptability Technique
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you keep a practical conversation going while circumstances change, adapting the request without choosing anyone's response. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Negotiation Drill: Adaptability]

abilities.info:

Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Negotiation Drill: Insight]

Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Negotiation Drill: Leverage]

abilities.name: Negotiation Drill: Mediation Technique
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you organise a discussion around one concrete decision and make the competing terms clear; nobody is compelled to agree. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Negotiation Drill: Mediation]

abilities.name: Never Fall
abilities.info:
You keep your feet on anything this turn: ice, a moving lift, a ledge giving way under you.
[Trait: Sure Feet]

abilities.name: Never Let Go
abilities.info:
What you hold, you keep this turn: a ledge, a cable, a collar, or a weapon someone is trying to take from you.
[Trait: Iron Grip]

abilities.name: Nobody's Name
abilities.info:
You talk past a checkpoint, a clerk or a marshal with a story nobody can check: the files have nothing on you, so the lie holds unless someone saw you do it.
[Trait: Drifter]

abilities.name: Not on File
abilities.info:
You vanish from every record that is looking for you: a checkpoint scan, a house book or a marshal's list comes up empty for this scene.
[Trait: Unregistered]

abilities.name: Off the Floor
abilities.info:
You find what you need in the middle of a fight on the floor around you: a weapon, a dressing or ammunition.
[Trait: Scavenger]

abilities.name: Old Court
abilities.info:
Arguing before the seat's bench by its own slow rules.
[Trait: House Draska: Sworn Hand]

abilities.name: Old Debt
abilities.info:
You remember who this person owes or fears, and name them at the right moment.
[Trait: Name Vault]

abilities.name: One Clean Shot
abilities.info:
You take one shot at the longest range anyone in the room could hope for, and it lands where you meant it to.
[Trait: Sharpshooter]

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.info:
You act twice this turn before anyone else in the room moves.
[Trait: Reflex Weave]

abilities.name: Overwatch
abilities.info:
You cover a doorway, a yard or a road from a distance: whoever crosses it first this turn takes your shot.
[Trait: Long Gun]

abilities.name: Patch Up
abilities.info:
You patch a hurt ally in the middle of a fight, and they get back up for one more round.
[Trait: Patcher]

abilities.name: Percussive Repair
abilities.info:
You get a stalled machine, rig or ride running again for one more push, by hand and with whatever is in reach.
[Trait: Mechanic]

abilities.name: Piston Press
abilities.info:
With the Black-Iron Pistons: a push or a lift with the whole frame behind it.
[Trait: Black-Iron Pistons]

abilities.name: Plated Guard
abilities.info:
With the Plated Arm: take a blow on the plates, turn a blade, shoulder a door.
[Trait: Plated Arm]

abilities.name: Play to the Crowd
abilities.info:
You turn the watching crowd to your side for the fight: they cheer you and get in the other one's way.
[Trait: Showman]

abilities.name: Point of Order
abilities.info:
You find the rule, clause or precedent that stops a ruling, a fine or an arrest in its tracks, at least until someone checks.
[Trait: Barrister]

abilities.name: Rail Read
abilities.info:
Reading the betting rail before the bell: who the money fears.
[Trait: House Veil: Prospect]

abilities.name: Range Store
abilities.info:
You draw a weapon or ammunition from your range's locked arms store before a job, and return it after.
[Trait: Range Deed]

abilities.name: Read the Deed
abilities.info:
You cite your family's deed to a house that leases the ground, and its people stop, check and step back from you for the scene.
[Trait: Named in the Deed]

abilities.name: Read the Mood
abilities.info:
You know what everyone in the room feels right now, and which of them is lying to you.
[Trait: Mood Gland]

abilities.name: Read the Ring
abilities.info:
One careful look catches what the room misses: the tell before the swing, the mark across the yard, the hand that moves wrong in a crowd.
[Trait: Keen Eyes]

abilities.name: Read the Walls
abilities.info:
You read Founder script, an old label or a deed's fine print and know what it was for and what it means now: the answer is true and specific.
[Trait: Archivist]

abilities.name: Recall: Every Log Kept
abilities.info:
Once a day you hold every log the Founders kept for one long scene and answer any question of the city's thousand years from them, truly, as far as the record goes. It leaves you blind for an hour and silent for a day.
[Trait: Recall: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Recall: One True Thing
abilities.info:
For the scene the old records surface when you look: a true fact about a place, machine or person you study, if the Founders kept one.
[Trait: Recall: Current]

abilities.name: Recall: The Founders' Logs
abilities.info:
You open a Founder log in your head about a place, a person's line or a machine and read it aloud for the scene: what the record says, who wrote it, what it did not say.
[Trait: Recall: Resonance]

abilities.name: Recoil: The Floor Comes Up
abilities.info:
You take the room's force and send it out: everyone who came at you in the scene is on the floor, their own weight on top of them, and the floor does not forgive. [Damage: bludgeoning]
[Trait: Recoil: Resonance]

abilities.name: Recoil: The Reckoning
abilities.info:
Once a day you give back everything the day has done to you in one blow: every hit you took since you woke lands on one target at once, and the room shakes with it. You can barely stand afterwards. [Damage: bludgeoning]
[Trait: Recoil: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Recoil: Thrown Back
abilities.info:
When you are struck, the old systems throw it back: a shove of force that sends the one who hit you reeling, and your next blow carries their weight. [Damage: bludgeoning]
[Trait: Recoil: Current]

abilities.name: Record Eye
abilities.info:
Seeing what is missing from a page: the line someone sealed out.
[Trait: The Roost: Recorder]

abilities.name: Redline
abilities.info:
You push a rig, a ride or anything with a seat past what it was built for, for one move: a jump, a ram, a turn no one else would take. The machine pays for it later.
[Trait: Pilot]

Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 6]

abilities.name: Refined Cold Fieldcraft: Observation
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you examine a concrete clue before choosing a route or a practical plan; this reveals no information that the evidence cannot support. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 6]

abilities.name: Refined Cold Fieldcraft: Routefinding
abilities.info:
With the cold city's routes, cover and supplies, you help a group negotiate difficult ground with a practical route and real equipment; nobody is moved or rescued automatically. Improves the next Cold action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Cold 6]

abilities.name: Refined Firearm Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you conceal your firing position and time an opening shot or controlled burst against a distracted target; a detected position loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Firearm Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you use the firearm's actual available shots to contest a lane of advance; a single-shot weapon gets one shot, and ammunition, reloads and firing rate remain real limits. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Firearm Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you fire a controlled shot while moving between established cover; movement does not provide automatic evasion or another action. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Firearm Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With an established firearm and compatible ammunition, you settle a firearm on a small exposed target and fire one aimed shot or the shortest burst it can actually fire; cover and range still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Melee Weapon Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you prepare a concealed grip or an unexpected angle with a held melee weapon; discovery removes surprise. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 6]

abilities.name: Refined Melee Weapon Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you use a held melee weapon's reach and leverage to contest a narrow approach; the opponent can still force a way through. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 6]

abilities.name: Refined Melee Weapon Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you strike with a held melee weapon while changing position; reach, balance and footing remain real limits. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 6]

abilities.name: Refined Melee Weapon Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With the held melee weapon actually carried, you aim a held melee weapon at a gap in the guard, using the actual striking surface and reach rather than inventing a cutting edge. Improves the next Scrap action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Scrap 6]

abilities.name: Refined Negotiation Drill: Adaptability
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you keep a practical conversation going while circumstances change, adapting the request without choosing anyone's response. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 6]

abilities.name: Refined Negotiation Drill: Insight
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you frame a specific request around something the other person has actually said they want; refusal and boundaries remain theirs. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 6]

abilities.name: Refined Negotiation Drill: Leverage
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you prepare a truthful, relevant fact for the moment it will be useful in a negotiation; it cannot become knowledge you never learned. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 6]

abilities.name: Refined Negotiation Drill: Mediation
abilities.info:
With a conversation between people with their own interests, you organise a discussion around one concrete decision and make the competing terms clear; nobody is compelled to agree. Improves the next Banter action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Banter 6]

abilities.name: Refined Throwing Drill: Ambush
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you conceal a thrown weapon until an opening presents itself; a spotted approach loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Throwing Drill: Control
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you place available thrown weapons across a narrow route to contest an advance; you cannot throw ammunition you do not have. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Throwing Drill: Mobility
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you throw an established projectile during a change of position; it must be recovered or replaced after the throw. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Throwing Drill: Precision
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you aim an established thrown weapon at a small exposed target; its actual weight, range and flight still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Aim 6]

abilities.name: Refined Workshop Drill: Concealed Work
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you conceal a practical modification until it is needed; it has only the functions you actually built and can be found on inspection. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 6]

abilities.name: Refined Workshop Drill: Diagnosis
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you diagnose one precise fault and attempt a repair with established tools and materials; missing parts cannot be invented. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 6]

abilities.name: Refined Workshop Drill: Field Repair
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you attempt a field repair or adjustment under pressure, keeping access to the real tool and part rather than bypassing the damage. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 6]

abilities.name: Refined Workshop Drill: Preparation
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you prepare a practical obstacle or safety measure from available tools and materials; its effect depends on the actual construction. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Skill: Tinker 6]

abilities.name: Restart
abilities.info:
You drop, and the second heart kicks: you get back up this turn with some of your health back.
[Trait: Second Heart]

abilities.name: Ricochet: Every Angle
abilities.info:
Once a day the whole room is yours for one long scene: every shot you take finds its mark off any surface you name, however many walls stand between, and nothing in cover is in cover. Afterwards your hands will not stop shaking.
[Trait: Ricochet: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Ricochet: Off the Wall
abilities.info:
For the scene everything you throw or fire can take one bounce off a wall, a pipe or a floor and come at its mark from the side, round cover, round a shield.
[Trait: Ricochet: Current]

abilities.name: Ricochet: Round the Corner
abilities.info:
You fire or throw round a corner, over a wall or through a gap no one else could use, and the shot finds its mark as if the room were built to carry it. [Damage: piercing]
[Trait: Ricochet: Resonance]

abilities.name: Rig Brace
abilities.info:
In the Sentry Frame, mounted, as the RIG line says: brace the frame and hold one mark across a yard; the next shot at it lands. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Sentry Frame]

abilities.name: Rig Lift
abilities.info:
In the Loader Frame, mounted, as the RIG line says: lift, carry or shove what a loading crew would (a crate, a cage door, a man off his feet). Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Loader Frame]

abilities.name: Rig Slam
abilities.info:
In the Patchwork Rig, mounted, as the RIG line says: one blow with the frame's whole weight, loud as a cage dropping. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Patchwork Rig]

abilities.name: Rig Step
abilities.info:
In the Vault Walker, mounted, as the RIG line says: a run, a climb up rails or ducting, or a reach to a high panel in one move. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Vault Walker]

abilities.name: Right Tool
abilities.info:
You find the right tool for the job in whatever is around you, and it works as if it were made for it.
[Trait: Tool Sense]

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.info:
You turn the other one's attack into your own: parry, step in, and the blade is where they just were.
[Trait: Duelist]

abilities.name: Root Access
abilities.info:
A Founder system reads you as its own staff for one command, whatever lock or rank stands in the way.
[Trait: Charter Spine]

abilities.name: Run of the Works
abilities.info:
You walk into a pump hall, a power room or a machine floor no house can lock you out of, and the crew there lets you work.
[Trait: Works Pass]

abilities.name: Run Them Down
abilities.info:
You outlast anything: what runs from you tires first, and what chases you gives up first; a chase over any distance goes your way.
[Trait: Long Runner]

abilities.name: Runner Charge
abilities.info:
On the Cage-Runner Prototype, mounted, as the RIDE line says: a charge that takes a gate, a plate or a line of people before they move. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Cage-Runner Prototype]

abilities.name: Running Fight
abilities.info:
You fight from something moving, a ride, a rig or a crawler, as well as anyone fights standing still.
[Trait: Outrider]

abilities.name: Salvage Eye
abilities.info:
Seeing what a barnacled Founder panel was before the sea took it.
[Trait: The Breakwater: Tidekeeper]

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.info:
You step into a Founder vault room and claim sanctuary: no marshal or house may drag you or the ones with you out of it by force.
[Trait: Sanctuary Right]

abilities.name: Scent Turnings
abilities.info:
Reading a turning's scent-marks to know whose dig it is and where it goes.
[Trait: The Diggers: Guest of the Lamps]

needs.variable: The Diggers: Guest of the Lamps

abilities.name: Seal Check
abilities.info:
Reading a scent seal for forgery at a glance.
[Trait: The Tether Court: Clerk of Record]

needs.variable: The Tether Court: Clerk of Record

abilities.name: Seal the Wound
abilities.info:
You stop your own bleeding in the middle of a fight and keep going.
[Trait: Clot Weave]

abilities.name: Sealed Cargo
abilities.info:
You carry one parcel under the courier's seal: no marshal, house or thief with any sense opens it on the road.
[Trait: Courier's Seal]

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.info:
When the body should quit, it does not: shake off a stagger, a choke or exhaustion and act at full strength this turn.
[Trait: Athlete]

abilities.name: Seen It Once
abilities.info:
You do something you have only seen done once, as well as the one who showed you.
[Trait: Quick Study]

abilities.name: Serve the Writ
abilities.info:
You serve the bounty writ on a wanted mark: the marshals back the arrest and the court pays when you bring them in.
[Trait: Bounty Writ]

abilities.name: Servo Snap
abilities.info:
You drive the bare-frame arms' servos past their limit for one catch, grab or strike, faster than a hand can move.
[Trait: Pod-Cut]

abilities.name: Set a Trap
abilities.info:
You leave a trap in the room, a wire, a snare or a charge, and the first one through it is caught.
[Trait: Trapper]

abilities.name: Shake It Off
abilities.info:
You get up from a wound that should keep you down, patched by your own body, and fight on.
[Trait: Fast Healer]

abilities.name: Shatter Note
abilities.info:
You push one pitched note through the box: glass breaks, everyone close staggers, and the hit is sonic.
[Trait: Voice Box]

abilities.name: Shoring
abilities.info:
Bracing a fall with whatever is to hand before the rock comes down.
[Trait: The Diggers: Tally-Keeper]

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.info:
You go through a door, a line or a man shoulder first, and keep going.
[Trait: Ram Plate]

abilities.name: Show the Licence
abilities.info:
You keep your gun where any other would lose it: a marshal, a door guard or a house checkpoint hands it back by the Charter.
[Trait: Licensed Arms]

abilities.name: Showstopper
abilities.info:
You hold every eye in the room for one turn: a song, a trick or a knife thrown into the boards, and nobody watches anything else.
[Trait: Entertainer]

abilities.name: Sightline: Every Line
abilities.info:
You see every line in the district for the scene: where each person in range is, what covers them and what does not, and your shots go through the gaps as if the gaps were made for them.
[Trait: Sightline: Resonance]

abilities.name: Sightline: The Builders' Eyes
abilities.info:
Once a day you see what the Founders' eyes see for one long scene: everyone in the district, through every wall, and the one shot that ends what needs ending. Afterwards the light hurts until you sleep.
[Trait: Sightline: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Sightline: The Line
abilities.info:
For the scene the line in your sight shows you the clear shots in the room: what is in the way, what is cover, where the next one is likely to stand.
[Trait: Sightline: Current]

abilities.name: Silver Reach
abilities.info:
With the Silver Shoulder Arm: a reach or a flourish that draws every eye on the floor.
[Trait: Silver Shoulder Arm]

abilities.name: Silver Word
abilities.info:
One sentence a listener believes and acts on, true or not.
[Trait: Silver Tongue]

abilities.name: Skimmer Drift
abilities.info:
On the Dust Skimmer, mounted, as the RIDE line says: a slide across a yard, a drift round a corner nobody takes at speed. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Dust Skimmer]

abilities.name: Sleeper's Credit
abilities.info:
You borrow against the pension: the bank under the Tether advances you what one purchase needs, and takes it back a little every week.
[Trait: Sleeper's Pension]

abilities.name: Slipstream: A Step That Crosses
abilities.info:
You take one step that crosses a street, a gulf or a shaft, carrying whoever holds your hand, and the current sets you down where you meant to be.
[Trait: Slipstream: Resonance]

abilities.name: Slipstream: The Long Current
abilities.info:
Once a day you ride the old currents across the whole city for one long scene: any point you can name, as many times as the scene needs, with whoever holds on. Afterwards you cannot stand without a wall.
[Trait: Slipstream: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Slipstream: The Push
abilities.info:
For the scene the old currents push at your back: your strides run long, and a yard, a street or a gap is shorter for you than for the one chasing.
[Trait: Slipstream: Current]

abilities.name: Slow Law
abilities.info:
Arguing before the bench: the oldest ruling first, never raising the voice.
[Trait: House Ashgrave: Assessor]

abilities.name: Slow State
abilities.info:
You drop into the node's slow state at death's door: you get no worse until someone gets to you.
[Trait: Stasis Node]

abilities.name: Spring Jump
abilities.info:
With the Steel Spring Leg: a leap to a rail, over a counter, across a gap.
[Trait: Steel Spring Leg]

abilities.name: Spring Leap
abilities.info:
You clear a gap, a rail or a whole floor in one leap and land where you chose.
[Trait: Spring Legs]

abilities.name: Squeeze Through
abilities.info:
You get through a gap, a crawl or a vent no one in the room can follow you into.
[Trait: Light Frame]

abilities.name: Stasis: Held Still
abilities.info:
You hold a body still in the cold for the scene: a friend between one breath and the next, a machine mid-motion, a falling thing in the air, until you let it go.
[Trait: Stasis: Resonance]

abilities.name: Stasis: Stop the Clock
abilities.info:
Once a day the pod's cold closes over a whole room for one long scene: everything but you and yours stands still, mid-blow, mid-fall, mid-word, until you choose to let it move. Afterwards you cannot get warm until morning.
[Trait: Stasis: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Stasis: The Cold Hold
abilities.info:
For the scene your touch chills a wound so it worsens slowly, slows a poison where it is, and buys a dying friend time until help comes.
[Trait: Stasis: Current]

abilities.name: Stay Up
abilities.info:
You take a blow that should drop you and stay on your feet, still in the fight.
[Trait: Thick Skull]

abilities.name: Strut Brace
abilities.info:
With the Metal Strut: stand through a shove, hold a door shut, carry a load up the stairs.
[Trait: Metal Strut]

abilities.name: Sucker Punch
abilities.info:
You land the first blow of a fight before the other side has decided you are a threat.
[Trait: Heavy Hands]

abilities.name: Surge: Live Fist
abilities.info:
Your blow carries the old current: a crack of static and a jolt that staggers whoever takes it. [Damage: shock]
[Trait: Surge: Current]

abilities.name: Surge: The Door Through the Wall
abilities.info:
Once a day you put the whole current of the room into one blow: a door goes through its wall, a crawler stops, a line of them goes down together. Your hands are numb for the rest of the day. [Damage: shock]
[Trait: Surge: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Surge: Through the Wall
abilities.info:
You put the current through the thing you hit, a door, a plate, a shield or a body, and it goes down: the wall is a wall no longer. [Damage: shock]
[Trait: Surge: Resonance]

abilities.name: Sworn Blade
abilities.info:
You draw your blade on the oath: anyone in the room who knows the old law hesitates before they swing at a Sworn Arm.
[Trait: Sworn Arm]

abilities.name: Sworn Word
abilities.info:
You swear to what you saw before the court or its marshals, and they treat it as fact until someone proves it false.
[Trait: Witness Right]

abilities.name: Table Talk
abilities.info:
You bring two sides who want to fight to the table for one more exchange, and both of them listen to you first.
[Trait: Diplomat]

abilities.name: Take the Hit
abilities.info:
You take a blow, a shot or a blast meant for someone next to you.
[Trait: Bodyguard]

abilities.name: Take the Seat
abilities.info:
You take your family's seat in the Tether court for one sitting, and the room has to hear what you say.
[Trait: Court Seat]

abilities.name: Talon Strike
abilities.info:
With the Clockwork Talon: a fast raking strike.
[Trait: Clockwork Talon]

abilities.name: Target Lock
abilities.info:
You mark one target: until it breaks your line of sight, your shots and throws at it land.
[Trait: Tracking Eye]

abilities.name: The Bask
abilities.info:
Ashgrave's finisher: patience; outlasting the other side in the heat until they make the mistake.
[Trait: House Ashgrave: Voice of the Bench]

needs.variable: House Ashgrave: Voice of the Bench

abilities.name: The Bench
abilities.info:
The Justice's word: a licence pulled, a desk struck, a charter sealed.
[Trait: The Tether Court: Justice of the Charter]

needs.variable: The Tether Court: Justice of the Charter

abilities.name: The Bent Angle: The Impossible Shot
abilities.info:
Once a scene you take a shot nobody could, off any number of walls, through any crowd, round any cover, and it finds exactly the mark you named. [Damage: piercing]
[Trait: The Bent Angle]

abilities.name: The Body that Keeps Going: The Long Run
abilities.info:
For a whole day you do not tire, slow or bleed out: any distance, any climb, any fight, at the pace you set at the start, with whoever can keep up.
[Trait: The Body that Keeps Going]

abilities.name: The Charged Blow: The Charged Round
abilities.info:
For a scene every blow you land carries the full current: whatever you hit goes down and does not get up until the scene is over. [Damage: shock]
[Trait: The Charged Blow]

abilities.name: The Cold that Holds: Hold Everything
abilities.info:
For a scene nothing in the place changes but what you allow: fires freeze, falls stop, wounds hold, and the fight waits for you to let it continue.
[Trait: The Cold that Holds]

abilities.name: The Con
abilities.info:
You get the other side to believe one lie long enough to act on it, and that is when you move.
[Trait: Grifter]

abilities.name: The Drop
abilities.info:
The Diggers' finisher: pulling the shoring and letting the tunnel close on whoever follows.
[Trait: The Diggers: Voice of the Long Table]

needs.variable: The Diggers: Voice of the Long Table

abilities.name: The Folded Step: Nowhere to Hold
abilities.info:
For a scene you cannot be held, cornered, caught or closed in: every grip opens, every door is a fold, and you arrive wherever you looked.
[Trait: The Folded Step]

abilities.name: The Hands and the Current: Wake the Works
abilities.info:
You put your hands on any dead Founder machine, a works, a crawler, a gate engine, and it runs for a day as if its builders were standing at the panel.
[Trait: The Hands and the Current]

abilities.name: The Line
abilities.info:
One line that turns the room: a crowd laughs, a bout waits, a door opens.
[Trait: Talker]

abilities.name: The Line Drawn: Survey the Field
abilities.info:
You read the whole field of a fight or a district before it starts: every position, every line, every way out; whoever follows your map that day is never caught in the open.
[Trait: The Line Drawn]

abilities.name: The Machines on Your Side: Sanctuary
abilities.info:
You name a place and for a day every machine in it keeps whoever you shelter alive: no drone, no turret, no door, no pursuer gets past the threshold.
[Trait: The Machines on Your Side]

abilities.name: The Mark Kept: The Writ Finds
abilities.info:
You name a person, a thing or a debt and the old systems find it for you anywhere in the city that day, and hold every door on the way open.
[Trait: The Mark Kept]

abilities.name: The Mood that Spreads: The Square Sings
abilities.info:
You turn any crowd in the city to your side for a day: a riot stands down, a market rises, a court's gallery decides the case before the judge does.
[Trait: The Mood that Spreads]

abilities.name: The Overheard Word: The Seat Hears
abilities.info:
You hear every word said about any matter you name, anywhere in the city, for a day: who said it, to whom, and what they did not say.
[Trait: The Overheard Word]

abilities.name: The Part that Fits: Build It Here
abilities.info:
You turn any bench, press or works into a Founder fabricator for a day: it builds what you describe from what it has, part, tool, weapon or frame.
[Trait: The Part that Fits]

abilities.name: The Pour
abilities.info:
Tipping a crucible without spilling, the whole body behind it.
[Trait: House Ashgrave: Hand]

abilities.name: The Pull on Metal: Every Arm
abilities.info:
For a scene every weapon in the room is yours: what is drawn on you falls, what you want comes to your hand, and nothing made of metal is raised against you or yours.
[Trait: The Pull on Metal]

abilities.name: The Push at Your Back: Ride the Current
abilities.info:
For a day you and your ride cross the city as fast as a thought: any point you name, any road, any gulf, with whoever and whatever you carry.
[Trait: The Push at Your Back]

abilities.name: The Record that Surfaces: Run the Record
abilities.info:
You answer any question of the city's thousand years from the Founders' own logs, truly and at once, for a scene: names, dates, doors, debts, what was sealed and by whom.
[Trait: The Record that Surfaces]

abilities.name: The Road Home: Open the Road
abilities.info:
You open a Founder road between any two points in the city for a day: a sealed way under the streets that only you and whoever you name can walk.
[Trait: The Road Home]

abilities.name: The Stampede
abilities.info:
The Herd Road's finisher: the whole weight of the herd moving at once.
[Trait: The Herd Road: Voice of the Ring]

needs.variable: The Herd Road: Voice of the Ring

abilities.name: The Stoop
abilities.info:
The Roost's finisher: the raptor's dive, from above, before the target looks up.
[Trait: The Roost: Voice of the Roost]

needs.variable: The Roost: Voice of the Roost

abilities.name: The Thing Thrown Back: Out the Door
abilities.info:
For a scene everyone who raises a hand to you or yours is thrown from the room, through its door, and does not come back in. [Damage: bludgeoning]
[Trait: The Thing Thrown Back]

abilities.name: The Undertow
abilities.info:
The Breakwater's finisher: taking the fight into the water, where it is theirs.
[Trait: The Breakwater: Voice of the Breakwater]

needs.variable: The Breakwater: Voice of the Breakwater

abilities.name: The Vault Remembers Its Own: Call the Vault
abilities.info:
You call the Vault itself and it answers through every system in reach: doors, drones and archives act on your word for a scene as if the Founders had never left.
[Trait: The Vault Remembers Its Own]

abilities.name: The Veil Drop
abilities.info:
The house finisher: a feint the rail has paid to see a thousand times and still falls for.
[Trait: House Veil: Voice of the Veil]

needs.variable: House Veil: Voice of the Veil

abilities.name: The Voice on the Air: Any Voice, Anywhere
abilities.info:
You speak in any voice you have heard, from any speaker in the city, for a scene, and the city takes it for the one who owns the voice.
[Trait: The Voice on the Air]

abilities.name: The Wall that Comes: Hold the Door
abilities.info:
You hold a doorway, a gate or a breach for a whole day: nothing passes you that you do not allow, and nobody behind you falls.
[Trait: The Wall that Comes]

abilities.name: The Warm Hands: The Ward
abilities.info:
You turn any room into a Founder ward for a day: every wound in it closes, every poison lifts, and nobody carried in dies.
[Trait: The Warm Hands]

abilities.name: The Warmth Kept: The Hearth
abilities.info:
You make any place warm for a day, a shaft, a homestead, a crawler's hold, however deep the cold; and the fire you carry can be called out as a wall or a weapon. [Damage: burn]
[Trait: The Warmth Kept]

abilities.name: The Weight
abilities.info:
House Draska's finisher: the whole weight of a bear, brought down once.
[Trait: House Draska: Voice of the Seat]

needs.variable: House Draska: Voice of the Seat

abilities.name: The Weight in the Feet: The Line Holds
abilities.info:
You name a line, a street, a wall or a gate, and for a whole day nothing crosses it that you deny: not a crowd, not a crawler, not a house's fighters.
[Trait: The Weight in the Feet]

abilities.name: The Words and the Map: Read the Ground
abilities.info:
You look at any Founder site and read its whole record aloud: what it was, what was done in it, what was sealed in it and why; the words and the map in one breath.
[Trait: The Words and the Map]

abilities.name: Their Voice
abilities.info:
You speak in the voice, accent or slang of someone you have heard, well enough to fool anyone who does not know them well.
[Trait: Mimic]

abilities.name: Three Moves Ahead
abilities.info:
You see the fight three moves ahead: the next blow aimed at the party misses because you called it.
[Trait: Mind Lattice]

abilities.name: Through the Smoke
abilities.info:
You go into a fire, smoke or a collapsing room and come out carrying someone, with the burns but not the fall.
[Trait: Firefighter]

abilities.name: Through Traffic
abilities.info:
You get across a crowded street, market or yard as if it were empty, and whatever you carry arrives with you.
[Trait: Dispatch Rider]

abilities.name: Throwing Drill: Ambush Technique
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you conceal a thrown weapon until an opening presents itself; a spotted approach loses surprise. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Throwing Drill: Ambush]

abilities.name: Throwing Drill: Control Technique
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you place available thrown weapons across a narrow route to contest an advance; you cannot throw ammunition you do not have. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Throwing Drill: Control]

abilities.name: Throwing Drill: Mobility Technique
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you throw an established projectile during a change of position; it must be recovered or replaced after the throw. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Throwing Drill: Mobility]

abilities.name: Throwing Drill: Precision Technique
abilities.info:
With established thrown weapons, never imaginary ammunition, you aim an established thrown weapon at a small exposed target; its actual weight, range and flight still matter. Improves the next Aim action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Throwing Drill: Precision]

abilities.name: Thrown Voice
abilities.info:
You speak from anywhere in the room you choose: another corner, a speaker, a guard's own comm.
[Trait: Voice Box]

abilities.name: Thunder Dash
abilities.info:
On the Thunder Cycle, mounted, as the RIDE line says: a burst down a row, over a rail or through a queue. Dismounted or dead, nothing.
[Trait: Thunder Cycle]

abilities.name: Tide Read
abilities.info:
Reading the tide by the stair: when it draws, how far, how long.
[Trait: The Breakwater: Diver]

abilities.name: Tracer: Every Mark
abilities.info:
Once a day you call up every mark you have ever laid, all at once, for one long scene: where each is, who holds it, what moved in the night. The weight of it leaves you sick until morning.
[Trait: Tracer: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Tracer: Marked
abilities.info:
Whatever you touch glows for you alone for the day, through walls and across crowds: a person, a crate, a coin passed hand to hand.
[Trait: Tracer: Current]

abilities.name: Tracer: Nothing Lost
abilities.info:
You mark a person, a thing or a trail and the old systems follow it for you for a week: where it is, where it has been, who carried it. Nothing in the city loses what you have marked.
[Trait: Tracer: Resonance]

abilities.name: Triage
abilities.info:

abilities.name: Trust Me

[Trait: Honest Face]

abilities.name: Turret Lens

[Trait: Turret-Lens Eye]

abilities.name: Unbreakable

abilities.name: Unbroken

abilities.name: Up and Ready

abilities.name: Up the Line

abilities.name: Vanish

abilities.name: Vault Born

abilities.name: Veil Guard

abilities.name: Voice: A Word Back
abilities.info:

abilities.name: Voice: Named by the Systems
abilities.info:
Once a day you speak and every Founder-built system in reach treats your word as the Founders': doors stand aside, drones stand down, a sealed archive opens. The voice that answers is tired afterwards, and so are you.
[Trait: Voice: Founder's Hand]

abilities.name: Voice: The Old Voice

abilities.name: Wall Watch

abilities.name: Wall Work

abilities.name: Wave Through

abilities.name: Waypoint: Every Road Home
abilities.info:
Once a day every Founder road in the city opens to you for one long scene: from anywhere to anywhere below the street, with whoever follows, and every sealed door on the way stands aside. Afterwards you cannot find your own door without help.

abilities.name: Waypoint: The Founders' Roads

abilities.name: Whisper: Every Comm

abilities.name: Whisper: Next Room

abilities.name: Whisper: The City Speaks
abilities.info:
Once a day the whole city's talk is yours for one long scene: every comm, every room, every word, sorted to the question you ask. Afterwards the silence in your own head is unbearable until morning.

abilities.name: Wind Read

abilities.name: Winter Craft

abilities.name: Workshop Drill: Diagnosis Technique

abilities.name: Workshop Drill: Field Repair Technique
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you attempt a field repair or adjustment under pressure, keeping access to the real tool and part rather than bypassing the damage. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.
[Trait: Workshop Drill: Field Repair]

abilities.name: Workshop Drill: Preparation Technique
abilities.info:
With tools, parts and working machines, you prepare a practical obstacle or safety measure from available tools and materials; its effect depends on the actual construction. Improves the next Tinker action that uses this practice. It grants no extra action, automatic hit, free ammunition or new supernatural capability.

Mounted, as the RIDE line says, it is the party's speed down any row wide enough for two wheels; it fits no door built for anyone and waits in the street, sulking. Every day in the saddle and every charge at a bay warms it; a thief would never get a word out of it.

Gives: technique Thunder Dash (a burst down a row, over a rail or through a queue).

skills.name: Aim
skills.info:
Thrown and fired things: a sling rig, a bolt gun, a wrench across a yard.

Covers: thrown, slung and fired things, a careful look at range (a mark, a board across the yard, someone in the crowd) and steering anything fast. Not: a blow at arm's length, which is Scrap; keeping the machine itself running, which is Tinker. Easy: hit a crate across the yard. Medium: put a sling stone through a drone's eye. Hard: pin a running thief's sleeve to a door. Very hard: shoot the cable a dropping lift hangs from. Extremely hard: thread a bolt through a closing Charter door.

Primary Attribute: Reflex

skills.name: Banter
skills.info:
The first language of every room in Meridian: the line that buys a drink, a pass, a second look.

Covers: the line, the bluff, the trade, the room. Not: staying calm while it fails, which is Cold. Easy: get a stall-holder to name a real price. Medium: make a crew laugh at their own lead. Hard: talk your way past Customs Hall with no paper. Very hard: win a house's Voice over at her own table. Extremely hard: make Sera Howl revise her opinion in front of her crew.

Primary Attribute: Presence

skills.name: Climb
skills.info:
Shafts, ledges, cable runs and the discipline of carried air.

Covers: shafts, ledges, cable runs, ladders and the air you carry on them; running, sneaking past, moving unseen, and the heat, smoke and cold on the way. Not: picking a lock at the top, which is Tinker. Easy: climb the Service Stair without stopping. Medium: cross a cable run above the Freight Yard. Hard: free-climb the shaft wall for twenty metres. Very hard: make the Lift Head on a half can of air. Extremely hard: climb the Tether's outer frame in the wind.

Primary Attribute: Grit

skills.name: Cold
skills.info:
Composure under stares, bets and bared teeth. The human who does not flinch is the one they remember.

Covers: composure under stares, threats, bets and a bared set of teeth, and steady hands under pressure: patching a wound, keeping a downed friend breathing. Not: winning the argument, which is Banter. Easy: hold a stranger's stare on the Market Floor. Medium: eat while a crowd watches the human eat. Hard: stand still while a ring bets on your blood. Very hard: take a Veil fighter's warning without a step back. Extremely hard: walk into a house seat alone and sit.

Primary Attribute: Nerve

skills.name: Scrap
skills.info:
Fighting with what is at hand: fists, a pipe, a blade off a scrap row, the wall behind the other one.

Covers: close fighting with hands and improvised weapons. Not: fired or thrown things, which are Aim. Easy: shove a drunk off a bar stool. Medium: win a pit bout against a green prospect. Hard: hold a stairwell against three loaders. Very hard: beat a ranked Veil fighter in the ring. Extremely hard: beat Tacca Veil on her own floor.

Primary Attribute: Might

skills.name: Tinker
skills.info:
Founder tech and the city's own: dead panels, locks, lifts, a drone's open casing.

Covers: Founder tech, locks, lifts, panels and drones, and the workings of a rig, a ride or a crawler. Not: charming the clerk who owns the panel, which is Banter; steering, which is Aim. Easy: wake a dead pod lamp. Medium: open a service hatch. Hard: reroute a lift past its stop. Very hard: talk a Vault Drone's casing open and its guns off. Extremely hard: key a Charter door nobody has keyed in three hundred years.

Primary Attribute: Wits
